try:
    import emoji
except Exception:
    emoji = None


def preprocess_crawled_comments(comments):
    processed = []

    for comment in comments:
        text = str(
            comment.get(
                "text",
                "",
            )
        )

        if "[Sticker]" in text:
            continue

        if emoji:
            text = emoji.demojize(
                text,
                language="en",
            )

        item = dict(comment)
        item["text"] = text

        processed.append(
            item
        )

    return processed


async def analyze_video(
    url,
    model_id=None,
    refresh_context=False,
):
    try:
        # =========================================================
        # 1. CRAWL COMMENTS
        # =========================================================

        comments, video_id = (
            get_all_comments(
                url,
                50,
            )
        )

        comments = (
            preprocess_crawled_comments(
                comments
            )
        )

        if not comments:
            return {
                "error":
                    "Không lấy được comment"
            }

        # =========================================================
        # 2. EXTRACT RAW TEXT
        # =========================================================

        raw_texts = [
            c["text"]
            for c in comments
            if c.get("text")
        ]

        # =========================================================
        # 3. VIDEO CONTEXT BY GEMINI FLASH VISION
        # =========================================================

        (
            video_context,
            context_cache_meta,
        ) = get_stable_video_context(
            video_url=url,
            video_id=video_id,
            comments=raw_texts,
            refresh=refresh_context,
        )

        print(
            "[CONTEXT CACHE]",
            context_cache_meta["status"],
            "video=",
            video_id,
            "fingerprint=",
            context_cache_meta["fingerprint"],
        )

        # =========================================================
        # 4. FILTER COMMENTS BY CONTEXT
        # =========================================================

        comments = (
            filter_comments_by_context(
                comments,
                video_context,
            )
        )

        if not comments:
            return {
                "error":
                    "Comments bị filter hết"
            }

        # =========================================================
        # 5. PREPARE TEXTS
        # =========================================================

        texts = [
            c["text"]
            for c in comments
        ]

        # =========================================================
        # 6. EMOTION PREDICTION
        # =========================================================

        engine = (
            model_manager.get(
                model_id
            )
        )

        preds = (
            engine.predict_batch(
                texts,
                video_context=
                    video_context,
            )
        )

        refined_preds = []

        for i, pred in enumerate(
            preds
        ):
            refined = (
                refine_prediction(
                    comments[i]["text"],
                    pred,
                    video_context,
                )
            )

            refined_preds.append(
                refined
            )

        preds = refined_preds

        # =========================================================
        # 7. ABSA
        # Chạy song song về mặt logic với emotion classification.
        # Mỗi comment nhận danh sách aspect + sentiment.
        # =========================================================

        try:
            absa_results = (
                absa_service
                .analyze_comments(
                    texts
                )
            )

            absa_summary = (
                absa_service
                .summarize(
                    absa_results
                )
            )

        except Exception as exc:
            # ABSA lỗi không làm hỏng toàn bộ /analyze.
            print(
                "[ABSA SERVICE ERROR]",
                exc,
            )

            absa_results = [
                {
                    "aspect_count": 0,
                    "aspects": [],
                    "error": str(exc),
                }
                for _ in texts
            ]

            absa_summary = {
                "comments_analyzed":
                    len(texts),

                "comments_with_aspects":
                    0,

                "total_aspects":
                    0,

                "sentiments": {
                    "POSITIVE": 0,
                    "NEUTRAL": 0,
                    "NEGATIVE": 0,
                },

                "top_aspects":
                    [],

                "error":
                    str(exc),
            }

        # =========================================================
        # 8. EMOTION SUMMARY
        # =========================================================

        pos = sum(
            1
            for p in preds
            if (
                p["label"]
                == "ENJOYMENT"
            )
        )

        neu = sum(
            1
            for p in preds
            if (
                p["label"]
                == "OTHER"
            )
        )

        neg = sum(
            1
            for p in preds
            if p["label"] in [
                "ANGER",
                "SADNESS",
                "FEAR",
                "DISGUST",
            ]
        )

        # =========================================================
        # 9. EMOTION STATS
        # =========================================================

        emotions_count = {
            label: 0
            for label in [
                "ANGER",
                "DISGUST",
                "ENJOYMENT",
                "FEAR",
                "OTHER",
                "SADNESS",
                "SURPRISE",
            ]
        }

        for p in preds:
            for lb in p[
                "all_labels"
            ]:
                if (
                    lb
                    in emotions_count
                ):
                    emotions_count[
                        lb
                    ] += 1

        # =========================================================
        # 10. AI INSIGHT
        # =========================================================

        insight = (
            analyze_video_context(
                summary={
                    "positive": pos,
                    "neutral": neu,
                    "negative": neg,
                },
                emotions=
                    emotions_count,
                video_context=
                    video_context,
                comments=
                    texts,
            )
        )

        # =========================================================
        # 11. COMMENT RESPONSE
        # =========================================================

        comment_results = []

        for i in range(
            len(preds)
        ):
            item = {
                "text":
                    comments[i][
                        "text"
                    ],

                "label":
                    preds[i][
                        "label"
                    ],

                "all_labels":
                    preds[i][
                        "all_labels"
                    ],

                "confidence":
                    round(
                        preds[i][
                            "confidence"
                        ],
                        4,
                    ),

                "probabilities": {
                    k:
                        round(
                            float(v),
                            4,
                        )
                    for k, v
                    in (
                        preds[i]
                        .get(
                            "probabilities"
                        )
                        or {}
                    ).items()
                },

                # NEW:
                # Kết quả ABSA của chính comment này.
                "absa":
                    absa_results[i],
            }

            # Giữ lại một số metadata crawler nếu có,
            # nhưng không bắt buộc frontend phải dùng.
            for key in [
                "comment_id",
                "id",
                "create_time",
                "created_at",
                "like_count",
                "likes",
                "reply_count",
            ]:
                if (
                    key
                    in comments[i]
                ):
                    item[key] = (
                        comments[i][
                            key
                        ]
                    )

            comment_results.append(
                item
            )

        # =========================================================
        # 12. RETURN
        # =========================================================

        response = {
            "video_id":
                video_id,

            "video_url":
                url,

            "model_id":
                model_id,

            # Gemini video context
            "context":
                video_context,

            # Context Stabilization diagnostics
            "context_cache":
                context_cache_meta,

            # emotion dashboard
            "summary": {
                "positive":
                    pos,
                "neutral":
                    neu,
                "negative":
                    neg,
            },

            # fine-grained emotion chart
            "emotions":
                emotions_count,

            # ABSA tổng hợp
            "absa_summary":
                absa_summary,

            # AI report
            "insight":
                insight,

            # emotion + ABSA theo từng comment
            "comments":
                comment_results,
        }

        # =========================================================
        # 13. SAVE HISTORY
        # Database lỗi không làm hỏng kết quả /analyze.
        # =========================================================

        try:
            analysis_id = (
                save_analysis_history(
                    response
                )
            )

            response[
                "analysis_id"
            ] = analysis_id

            response[
                "history_saved"
            ] = True

        except Exception as exc:
            print(
                "[HISTORY SAVE ERROR]",
                exc,
            )

            response[
                "analysis_id"
            ] = None

            response[
                "history_saved"
            ] = False

            response[
                "history_error"
            ] = str(
                exc
            )

        return response

    except Exception as e:
        print(
            f"[AI SERVICE ERROR] "
            f"{e}"
        )

        return {
            "error":
                str(e)
        }

// FILE: backend\core\comment_filter.py

def filter_comments_by_context(comments, context):
    """
    Lọc comment theo ngữ cảnh video.
    """

    tone = context.get("tone", "")

    filtered = []

    for c in comments:
        text = c["text"].lower()

        # spam
        if len(text) < 2:
            continue

        # context aware
        if tone == "sad":
            if "=))" in text and "khóc" in text:
                c["boost_negative"] = True

        filtered.append(c)

    return filtered

import json
import os


class ContextDictionary:
    def __init__(self, dict_path="assets/dic_final_cleaned.json"):
        self.dictionary = {}

        if os.path.exists(dict_path):
            with open(dict_path, "r", encoding="utf-8") as f:
                self.dictionary = json.load(f)

            print(f"[+] Loaded dictionary: {dict_path}")
        else:
            print("[!] Dictionary file not found")

    def detect_emotion_boost(self, text: str):
        text = text.lower()

        scores = {
            "ANGER": 0,
            "DISGUST": 0,
            "ENJOYMENT": 0,
            "FEAR": 0,
            "OTHER": 0,
            "SADNESS": 0,
            "SURPRISE": 0,
        }

        mapping = {
            "positive": "ENJOYMENT",
            "negative": "ANGER",
            "sadness": "SADNESS",
            "surprise": "SURPRISE"
        }

        for group_name, words in self.dictionary.items():
            label = mapping.get(group_name)

            if not label:
                continue

            for word in words:
                if word.lower() in text:
                    scores[label] += 1

        return scores
// END ------------------------------

import re

def extract_video_context(comments):
    """
    Tạo ngữ cảnh video từ comments.
    """

    full_text = " ".join(comments).lower()

    keywords = []

    rules = {
        "sad": ["buồn", "khóc", "chia tay", "đau lòng"],
        "funny": ["haha", "cười", "=))", "hài"],
        "angry": ["toxic", "ghét", "tệ", "ức chế"],
        "love": ["yêu", "cute", "dễ thương"]
    }

    scores = {}

    for label, words in rules.items():
        count = sum(full_text.count(w) for w in words)
        scores[label] = count

    dominant = max(scores, key=scores.get)

    if dominant == "sad":
        topic = "Tâm trạng / cảm xúc"
    elif dominant == "funny":
        topic = "Giải trí"
    elif dominant == "angry":
        topic = "Tranh cãi / toxic"
    else:
        topic = "Đời sống"

    return {
        "topic": topic,
        "tone": dominant,
        "scores": scores
    }
// END ------------------------------

// FILE: backend\core\context_refiner.py
// START ------------------------------
def _collapse_other(labels):
    upper = [str(l).upper() for l in labels]
    if "OTHER" in upper and len(upper) > 1:
        return ["OTHER"]
    return upper


def _set_label(prediction, new_label):
    new_label = new_label.upper()
    labels = list(prediction.get("all_labels") or [])
    if new_label not in labels:
        labels.insert(0, new_label)
    else:
        labels = [new_label] + [l for l in labels if l != new_label]

    prediction["label"] = new_label
    prediction["all_labels"] = _collapse_other(labels)


def refine_prediction(comment, prediction, context):
    """
    Context-aware sentiment correction.
    """

    text = (comment or "").lower()
    label = prediction.get("label", "")
    tone = (context or {}).get("tone", "") if isinstance(context, dict) else ""

    if tone == "sad":
        sarcasm_words = ["=))", "haha", "hahaha", "cười", "hài", "đáng đời"]
        if any(w in text for w in sarcasm_words) and label == "ENJOYMENT":
            _set_label(prediction, "DISGUST")

        sympathy_words = ["tội", "thương", "khóc", "buồn", "đau lòng", "xót"]
        if any(w in text for w in sympathy_words):
            _set_label(prediction, "SADNESS")

    if tone == "funny":
        funny_words = ["=))", "haha", "cười chết", "hài", "mắc cười"]
        if any(w in text for w in funny_words):
            _set_label(prediction, "ENJOYMENT")

    if tone == "angry":
        toxic_words = ["ngu", "toxic", "ghét", "xàm", "khùng"]
        if any(w in text for w in toxic_words):
            _set_label(prediction, "ANGER")

    # Final guard: ensure all_labels respects the OTHER-collapse rule even
    # when the adapter is older or refine_prediction didn't touch the label.
    prediction["all_labels"] = _collapse_other(prediction.get("all_labels") or [prediction.get("label", "OTHER")])
    if prediction["all_labels"]:
        prediction["label"] = prediction["all_labels"][0]

    return prediction

// END ------------------------------

from typing import Dict, List, Optional, Tuple

    "Referer": "https://www.tiktok.com/",
    "Accept-Language": "vi-VN,vi;q=0.9,en-US;q=0.8,en;q=0.7",
}


def extract_video_id(url: str) -> Optional[str]:
    """
    Lấy TikTok video ID từ URL dạng:
    https://www.tiktok.com/@username/video/123456789
    """

    if not url:
        return None

    match = re.search(r"/video/(\d+)", url)

    if not match:
        return None

    return match.group(1)


def _timestamp_to_iso(timestamp) -> Optional[str]:
    """
    Chuyển Unix timestamp TikTok thành ISO-8601 UTC.
    """

    try:
        timestamp = int(timestamp)

        if timestamp <= 0:
            return None

        return datetime.fromtimestamp(
            timestamp,
            tz=timezone.utc,
        ).isoformat()

    except (TypeError, ValueError, OSError):
        return None


def _parse_comment(comment: Dict) -> Optional[Dict]:
    """
    Chuẩn hóa một comment TikTok thành format dùng chung
    cho AI, database, ABSA và trend analysis.
    """

    if not isinstance(comment, dict):
        return None

    text = str(comment.get("text") or "").strip()

    if not text:
        return None

    user = comment.get("user") or {}

    if not isinstance(user, dict):
        user = {}

    create_time = comment.get("create_time")

    return {
        # TikTok comment ID
        "comment_id": str(
            comment.get("cid")
            or comment.get("comment_id")
            or ""
        ),

        # Nội dung comment
        "text": text,

        # Thời gian
        "created_at": (
            int(create_time)
            if str(create_time or "").isdigit()
            else None
        ),
        "created_at_iso": _timestamp_to_iso(create_time),

        # Engagement
        "like_count": int(
            comment.get("digg_count")
            or comment.get("like_count")
            or 0
        ),
        "reply_count": int(
            comment.get("reply_comment_total")
            or comment.get("reply_count")
            or 0
        ),

        # User metadata
        "author_id": str(
            user.get("uid")
            or user.get("id")
            or ""
        ),
        "author_name": str(
            user.get("nickname")
            or ""
        ),
        "author_unique_id": str(
            user.get("unique_id")
            or ""
        ),
    }


def get_all_comments(
    url: str,
    max_comments: int = 50,
) -> Tuple[List[Dict], Optional[str]]:
    """
    Crawl comments từ TikTok.

    Có hỗ trợ pagination bằng cursor.

    Returns:
        comments: List[Dict]
        video_id: str | None
    """

    video_id = extract_video_id(url)

    if not video_id:
        print("[Crawler] Không tìm thấy video ID")
        return [], None

    # Không cho giá trị bất hợp lý
    max_comments = max(1, min(int(max_comments), 5000))

    comments: List[Dict] = []

    # tránh duplicate comment
    seen_comment_ids = set()

    cursor = 0
    page_size = 20

    session = requests.Session()
    session.headers.update(DEFAULT_HEADERS)

    print(
        f"[Crawler] Start video={video_id}, "
        f"target={max_comments}"
    )

    while len(comments) < max_comments:

        remaining = max_comments - len(comments)
        count = min(page_size, remaining)

        params = {
            "aid": "1988",
            "aweme_id": video_id,
            "count": count,
            "cursor": cursor,
        }

        try:
            response = session.get(
                TIKTOK_COMMENT_API,
                params=params,
                timeout=15,
            )

            response.raise_for_status()

            data = response.json()

        except requests.RequestException as exc:
            print(
                f"[Crawler] Request error "
                f"cursor={cursor}: {exc}"
            )
            break

        except ValueError as exc:
            print(
                f"[Crawler] Invalid JSON "
                f"cursor={cursor}: {exc}"
            )
            break

        raw_comments = data.get("comments") or []

        if not raw_comments:
            print(
                f"[Crawler] Không còn comment "
                f"ở cursor={cursor}"
            )
            break

        added_this_page = 0

        for raw_comment in raw_comments:

            parsed = _parse_comment(raw_comment)

            if not parsed:
                continue

            comment_id = parsed.get("comment_id")

            # Nếu có ID thì chống duplicate
            if comment_id:
                if comment_id in seen_comment_ids:
                    continue

                seen_comment_ids.add(comment_id)

            comments.append(parsed)
            added_this_page += 1

            if len(comments) >= max_comments:
                break

        print(
            f"[Crawler] cursor={cursor} "
            f"received={len(raw_comments)} "
            f"added={added_this_page} "
            f"total={len(comments)}"
        )

        has_more = data.get("has_more")

        next_cursor = data.get("cursor")

        # TikTok có thể trả bool hoặc số
        if not has_more:
            break

        try:
            next_cursor = int(next_cursor)
        except (TypeError, ValueError):
            break

        # tránh infinite loop
        if next_cursor == cursor:
            print("[Crawler] Cursor không thay đổi, dừng crawl")
            break

        cursor = next_cursor

    print(
        f"[Crawler] Finished: "
        f"{len(comments)} comments"
    )

    return comments[:max_comments], video_id
// END ------------------------------

// FILE: backend\core\gemini_utils.py

from __future__ import annotations

import random
import re
import threading
import time
from typing import Any

from config import (
    GEMINI_CIRCUIT_DEFAULT_SECONDS,
    GEMINI_FALLBACK_MODEL,
    GEMINI_MAX_RETRIES,
    GEMINI_RETRY_BASE_SECONDS,
)

RETRYABLE_STATUS_CODES = {429, 500, 502, 503, 504}


class GeminiCircuitOpenError(RuntimeError):
    """Raised locally when a model has an active hard-quota circuit."""


_CIRCUIT_LOCK = threading.Lock()
_CIRCUIT_OPEN_UNTIL: dict[str, float] = {}


def _get_status_code(exc: Exception) -> int | None:
    for attr in ("status_code", "code"):
        value = getattr(exc, attr, None)
        try:
            if value is not None:
                return int(value)
        except (TypeError, ValueError):
            pass

    text = str(exc)
    for code in RETRYABLE_STATUS_CODES:
        if str(code) in text:
            return code
    return None


def _is_hard_quota_error(exc: Exception) -> bool:
    text = str(exc).lower()
    hard_quota_markers = (
        "exceeded your current quota",
        "check your plan and billing details",
        "billing details",
        "quota has been exhausted",
        "quotafailure",
    )
    return (
        ("resource_exhausted" in text or "429" in text)
        and any(marker in text for marker in hard_quota_markers)
    )


def _retry_delay_seconds(exc: Exception) -> int:
    text = str(exc)
    matches = [
        re.search(r"retryDelay['\"\s:]+(\d+)s", text, flags=re.I),
        re.search(r"retry\s+in\s+(\d+)h(?:(\d+)m)?(?:(\d+)(?:\.\d+)?s)?", text, flags=re.I),
        re.search(r"retry\s+in\s+(\d+)m(?:(\d+)(?:\.\d+)?s)?", text, flags=re.I),
        re.search(r"retry\s+in\s+(\d+)(?:\.\d+)?s", text, flags=re.I),
    ]

    if matches[0]:
        return max(1, int(matches[0].group(1)))
    if matches[1]:
        hours = int(matches[1].group(1) or 0)
        minutes = int(matches[1].group(2) or 0)
        seconds = int(matches[1].group(3) or 0)
        return max(1, hours * 3600 + minutes * 60 + seconds)
    if matches[2]:
        minutes = int(matches[2].group(1) or 0)
        seconds = int(matches[2].group(2) or 0)
        return max(1, minutes * 60 + seconds)
    if matches[3]:
        return max(1, int(matches[3].group(1)))
    return max(1, int(GEMINI_CIRCUIT_DEFAULT_SECONDS))


def _open_circuit(model: str, seconds: int) -> None:
    with _CIRCUIT_LOCK:
        _CIRCUIT_OPEN_UNTIL[model] = time.monotonic() + max(1, seconds)


def _circuit_remaining(model: str) -> int:
    with _CIRCUIT_LOCK:
        until = _CIRCUIT_OPEN_UNTIL.get(model, 0.0)
        remaining = until - time.monotonic()
        if remaining <= 0:
            _CIRCUIT_OPEN_UNTIL.pop(model, None)
            return 0
        return max(1, int(round(remaining)))


def reset_gemini_circuits() -> None:
    """Primarily useful for tests or after deliberately changing credentials."""
    with _CIRCUIT_LOCK:
        _CIRCUIT_OPEN_UNTIL.clear()


def _is_retryable(exc: Exception) -> bool:
    if _is_hard_quota_error(exc):
        return False

    status_code = _get_status_code(exc)
    if status_code in RETRYABLE_STATUS_CODES:
        return True

    # httpx/httpcore timeout subclasses can have messages such as
    # "The read operation timed out", which do not contain "timeout".
    exc_name = type(exc).__name__.lower()
    retryable_exception_names = (
        "timeout",
        "readtimeout",
        "connecttimeout",
        "pooltimeout",
        "networkerror",
        "connectionerror",
    )
    if any(value in exc_name for value in retryable_exception_names):
        return True

    text = str(exc).lower()
    retry_keywords = (
        "unavailable",
        "high demand",
        "temporarily unavailable",
        "timeout",
        "timed out",
        "read operation timed out",
        "read timeout",
        "deadline exceeded",
        "server error",
        "internal error",
        "rate limit",
        "connection reset",
        "connection aborted",
    )
    return any(keyword in text for keyword in retry_keywords)


def generate_content_with_retry(
    client,
    *,
    model: str,
    contents: Any,
    config=None,
):
    if client is None:
        raise RuntimeError(
            "Gemini client chưa được khởi tạo. Kiểm tra GEMINI_API_KEY."
        )

    primary_model = str(model or "").strip()
    if not primary_model:
        raise ValueError("Gemini model không được để trống.")

    models_to_try = [primary_model]
    fallback_model = str(GEMINI_FALLBACK_MODEL or "").strip()
    if fallback_model and fallback_model != primary_model:
        models_to_try.append(fallback_model)

    last_error: Exception | None = None
    circuit_errors: list[str] = []

    for current_model in models_to_try:
        remaining = _circuit_remaining(current_model)
        if remaining > 0:
            circuit_errors.append(
                f"{current_model} circuit open for ~{remaining}s"
            )
            print(
                f"[Gemini] Circuit open model={current_model}; "
                f"skip call remaining~{remaining}s"
            )
            continue

        print(f"[Gemini] Trying model={current_model}")

        for attempt in range(1, GEMINI_MAX_RETRIES + 1):
            try:
                response = client.models.generate_content(
                    model=current_model,
                    contents=contents,
                    config=config,
                )

                if response is None:
                    raise RuntimeError("Gemini returned None response.")

                print(
                    f"[Gemini] Success model={current_model} attempt={attempt}"
                )
                return response, current_model

            except Exception as exc:
                last_error = exc

                if _is_hard_quota_error(exc):
                    delay = _retry_delay_seconds(exc)
                    _open_circuit(current_model, delay)
                    print(
                        "[Gemini] Hard quota exhausted - opening circuit; "
                        f"model={current_model} cooldown~{delay}s"
                    )
                    # Hard quota is not retried for this model. A distinct fallback
                    # model may still be attempted if its own circuit is closed.
                    break

                if not _is_retryable(exc):
                    print(
                        "[Gemini] Non-retryable error: "
                        f"{type(exc).__name__}: {exc}"
                    )
                    raise

                if attempt >= GEMINI_MAX_RETRIES:
                    print(
                        f"[Gemini] Exhausted retries model={current_model}"
                    )
                    break

                wait_seconds = (
                    GEMINI_RETRY_BASE_SECONDS
                    * (2 ** (attempt - 1))
                    + random.uniform(0.0, 0.5)
                )

                print(
                    "[Gemini Retry] "
                    f"model={current_model} "
                    f"attempt={attempt}/{GEMINI_MAX_RETRIES} "
                    f"error={type(exc).__name__} "
                    f"wait={wait_seconds:.1f}s"
                )
                time.sleep(wait_seconds)

    if last_error is not None:
        raise last_error

    if circuit_errors:
        raise GeminiCircuitOpenError(
            "Gemini circuit open: " + "; ".join(circuit_errors)
        )

    raise RuntimeError("Gemini request failed without exception.")

// END ------------------------------

ALLOWED_TONES = ("sad", "funny", "angry", "love", "happy", "neutral")
ALLOWED_TONE_SET = set(ALLOWED_TONES)

VIDEO_CACHE_DIR = Path(__file__).resolve().parent.parent / ".video_cache"
VIDEO_CACHE_DIR.mkdir(exist_ok=True)


def _video_id_from_url(url: str):
    import re as _re
    match = _re.search(r"/video/(\d+)", url or "")
    return match.group(1) if match else None


def get_or_download_video(video_url: str, video_id: str = None) -> Path:
    """
    Return a cached mp4 file for the given video URL, downloading if needed.
    Used by the /video proxy endpoint to bypass TikTok CDN 403 in iframe embeds.
    """

    if not video_id:
        video_id = _video_id_from_url(video_url)

    if video_id:
        cached = VIDEO_CACHE_DIR / f"{video_id}.mp4"
        if cached.exists() and cached.stat().st_size > 0:
            return cached

    path, temp_dir = _download_tiktok_video(video_url)

    try:
        if video_id:
            cached = VIDEO_CACHE_DIR / f"{video_id}.mp4"
            shutil.copy2(path, cached)
            return cached
        return path
    finally:
        if video_id and temp_dir:
            shutil.rmtree(temp_dir, ignore_errors=True)

    "Mobile/15E148 Safari/604.1"
)


def _gemini_ready() -> bool:

def _extract_json(text: str) -> dict:
    if not text:
        return {}

    try:
        return json.loads(text)
    except Exception:
        pass

    start = text.find("{")
    end = text.rfind("}")
    if start >= 0 and end > start:
        try:
            return json.loads(text[start:end + 1])
        except Exception:
            return {}

    return {}

def _resolve_short_url(video_url: str) -> str:
    """Follow vm.tiktok.com / vt.tiktok.com shortlinks to the canonical URL."""

    if "tiktok.com" not in video_url:
        return video_url

    if "/video/" in video_url:
        return video_url

    try:
        resp = requests.head(
            video_url,
            headers={"User-Agent": DESKTOP_USER_AGENT},
            allow_redirects=True,
            timeout=10,
        )
        return resp.url or video_url
    except Exception:
        return video_url


def _download_via_ytdlp(video_url: str, temp_dir: str) -> Path:
    output_template = str(Path(temp_dir) / "video.%(ext)s")

    base_headers = {
        "User-Agent": DESKTOP_USER_AGENT,
        "Referer": "https://www.tiktok.com/",
        "Accept-Language": "en-US,en;q=0.9,vi;q=0.8",
    }

    attempts = [
        {
            "format": "mp4/best[ext=mp4]/best",
            "http_headers": base_headers,
        },
        {
            "format": "download_addr-0/play_addr-0/best",
            "http_headers": {**base_headers, "User-Agent": MOBILE_USER_AGENT},
        },
        {
            "format": "best",
            "http_headers": base_headers,
            "extractor_args": {"tiktok": {"app_version": ["34.1.2"]}},
        },
    ]

    last_error = None

    for attempt in attempts:
        options = {
            "outtmpl": output_template,
            "merge_output_format": "mp4",
            "noplaylist": True,
            "quiet": True,
            "no_warnings": True,
            "retries": 3,
            "fragment_retries": 3,
            "socket_timeout": 30,
            **attempt,
        }

        try:
            with yt_dlp.YoutubeDL(options) as downloader:
                info = downloader.extract_info(video_url, download=True)
                downloaded = downloader.prepare_filename(info)

            path = Path(downloaded)
            if not path.exists():
                mp4_path = Path(temp_dir) / "video.mp4"
                if mp4_path.exists():
                    path = mp4_path

            if path.exists() and path.stat().st_size > 0:
                return path

        except Exception as exc:
            last_error = exc
            continue

    raise RuntimeError(f"yt-dlp failed to download TikTok video: {last_error}")


def _download_via_tikwm(video_url: str, temp_dir: str) -> Path:
    """Public TikTok mirror API used as fallback when yt-dlp is blocked."""

    api_resp = requests.post(
        "https://www.tikwm.com/api/",
        data={"url": video_url, "hd": "1"},
        headers={"User-Agent": DESKTOP_USER_AGENT},
        timeout=20,
    )
    api_resp.raise_for_status()
    payload = api_resp.json()

    if payload.get("code") != 0:
        raise RuntimeError(f"tikwm error: {payload.get('msg')}")

    data = payload.get("data") or {}
    play_path = data.get("hdplay") or data.get("play") or data.get("wmplay")
    if not play_path:
        raise RuntimeError("tikwm response missing play URL")

    if play_path.startswith("/"):
        play_url = f"https://www.tikwm.com{play_path}"
    else:
        play_url = play_path

    video_resp = requests.get(
        play_url,
        headers={
            "User-Agent": DESKTOP_USER_AGENT,
            "Referer": "https://www.tikwm.com/",
        },
        timeout=60,
        stream=True,
    )
    video_resp.raise_for_status()

    out_path = Path(temp_dir) / "video.mp4"
    with open(out_path, "wb") as fh:
        for chunk in video_resp.iter_content(chunk_size=1 << 16):
            if chunk:
                fh.write(chunk)

    if not out_path.exists() or out_path.stat().st_size == 0:
        raise RuntimeError("tikwm fallback produced empty file")

    return out_path


def _download_tiktok_video(video_url: str):
    temp_dir = tempfile.mkdtemp(prefix="tiktok_video_")
    canonical_url = _resolve_short_url(video_url)

    errors = []

    try:
        path = _download_via_ytdlp(canonical_url, temp_dir)
        return path, temp_dir
    except Exception as exc:
        errors.append(f"yt-dlp: {exc}")
        print(f"[Gemini Vision] yt-dlp failed, trying fallback. {exc}")

    try:
        path = _download_via_tikwm(canonical_url, temp_dir)
        return path, temp_dir
    except Exception as exc:
        errors.append(f"tikwm: {exc}")
        print(f"[Gemini Vision] tikwm fallback failed. {exc}")

    shutil.rmtree(temp_dir, ignore_errors=True)
    raise RuntimeError(
        "Could not download TikTok video. Tried: " + " | ".join(errors)
    )


def _response_text(response) -> str:
    """Extract text from a Gemini response, handling thought_signature parts."""

    text = getattr(response, "text", None)
    if text:
        return text

    chunks = []
    for candidate in getattr(response, "candidates", None) or []:
        content = getattr(candidate, "content", None)
        for part in getattr(content, "parts", None) or []:
            value = getattr(part, "text", None)
            if value:
                chunks.append(value)

    return "".join(chunks)


def _upload_video_to_gemini(video_path: Path):
    mime_type = mimetypes.guess_type(video_path.name)[0] or "video/mp4"

    uploaded_file = gemini_client.files.upload(
        file=str(video_path),
        config=types.UploadFileConfig(mime_type=mime_type),
    )

    for _ in range(60):
        current = gemini_client.files.get(name=uploaded_file.name)
        state = getattr(current, "state", None)
        state_name = getattr(state, "name", str(state))

        if state_name == "ACTIVE":
            return current

        if state_name == "FAILED":
            raise RuntimeError("Gemini video processing failed")

        time.sleep(1)

    raise TimeoutError("Gemini video processing timed out")


def analyze_tiktok_video_context(video_url: str, comments=None) -> dict:
    """
    Use Gemini Flash vision to understand the TikTok video and return context
    for emotion prediction.
    """

    if not _gemini_ready():
        return _fallback_context(comments)

    temp_dir = None
    uploaded_file = None

    try:
        video_path, temp_dir = _download_tiktok_video(video_url)

        # Cache the file so the frontend /video proxy can stream it back
        # without TikTok CDN's 403 referer block.
        vid = _video_id_from_url(video_url)
        if vid:
            try:
                shutil.copy2(video_path, VIDEO_CACHE_DIR / f"{vid}.mp4")
            except Exception as cache_exc:
                print(f"[Gemini Vision] cache copy failed: {cache_exc}")

        uploaded_file = _upload_video_to_gemini(video_path)

        sample_comments = "\n".join((comments or [])[:20])
        prompt = _build_video_context_prompt(sample_comments)

        response = gemini_client.models.generate_content(
            model=GEMINI_VISION_MODEL,
            contents=[prompt, uploaded_file],
            config=types.GenerateContentConfig(
                response_mime_type="application/json",
            ),
        )

        data = _extract_json(_response_text(response))
        if not data:
            print("[Gemini Vision] empty/invalid JSON, falling back")
            return _fallback_context(comments)

        tone = str(data.get("tone", "neutral")).lower().strip()
        if tone not in ALLOWED_TONE_SET:
            tone = "neutral"

        raw_scores = data.get("scores")
        normalized_scores = {t: 0 for t in ALLOWED_TONES}
        if isinstance(raw_scores, dict):
            for key, value in raw_scores.items():
                k = str(key).lower().strip()
                if k in ALLOWED_TONE_SET:
                    try:
                        normalized_scores[k] = max(0, min(100, int(round(float(value)))))
                    except (TypeError, ValueError):
                        continue
        if sum(normalized_scores.values()) == 0:
            normalized_scores[tone] = 100
        else:
            top_tone = max(ALLOWED_TONES, key=lambda key: normalized_scores[key])
            if normalized_scores[top_tone] > normalized_scores[tone]:
                tone = top_tone

        raw_keywords = data.get("keywords")
        keywords = []
        if isinstance(raw_keywords, list):
            keywords = [str(k).strip() for k in raw_keywords if str(k).strip()][:8]

        return {
            "topic": str(data.get("topic") or "Khong xac dinh").strip(),
            "tone": tone,
            "scores": normalized_scores,
            "visual_summary": str(data.get("visual_summary") or "").strip(),
            "audience_context": str(data.get("audience_context") or "").strip(),
            "keywords": keywords,
            "source": "gemini_flash_vision",
        }

    except Exception as exc:
        import traceback
        print(f"[Gemini Vision Error] {type(exc).__name__}: {exc}")
        traceback.print_exc()
        context = _fallback_context(comments)
        context["source"] = "local_fallback"
        context["error"] = f"{type(exc).__name__}: {exc}"
        return context

    finally:
        if uploaded_file is not None:
            try:
                gemini_client.files.delete(name=uploaded_file.name)
            except Exception:
                pass

        if temp_dir:
            shutil.rmtree(temp_dir, ignore_errors=True)

# ============================================================
# LEGACY PUBLIC COMPATIBILITY API
# ============================================================

def build_local_emotion_report(
    summary: dict,
    emotions: dict,
    video_context=None,
    comments=None,
    **kwargs,
) -> str:
    """
    Compatibility wrapper cho các service legacy.

    Không thuộc pipeline Fact-Checking V2.
    """

    return _local_emotion_report(
        summary=summary or {},
        emotions=emotions or {},
        video_context=video_context,
    )


def generate_emotion_analyst_report(
    summary: dict,
    emotions: dict,
    video_context=None,
    comments=None,
    **kwargs,
) -> str:
    """
    Compatibility wrapper cho:
        services/analyst_cache_service.py

    Tái sử dụng Gemini analyst cũ thông qua analyze_video_context().
    """

    return analyze_video_context(
        summary=summary or {},
        emotions=emotions or {},
        video_context=video_context,
        comments=comments or [],
    )

def _local_emotion_report(summary: dict, emotions: dict, video_context=None) -> str:
    pos = summary.get("positive", 0)
    neu = summary.get("neutral", 0)
    neg = summary.get("negative", 0)
    total = max(pos + neu + neg, 1)

    pos_ratio = pos / total
    neg_ratio = neg / total

    if pos_ratio >= 0.65:
        trend = "rat tich cuc"
    elif pos_ratio >= 0.5:
        trend = "tich cuc"
    elif neg_ratio >= 0.55:
        trend = "tieu cuc manh"
    elif neg_ratio >= 0.4:
        trend = "kha tieu cuc"
    else:
        trend = "phan hoa / trung lap"

    dominant_emotion = max(emotions, key=emotions.get) if emotions else "OTHER"
    context_text = ""

    if isinstance(video_context, dict):
        context_text = (
            video_context.get("visual_summary")
            or video_context.get("audience_context")
            or video_context.get("topic")
            or ""
        )

    return f"""
TONG QUAN CAM XUC

Video dang co xu huong {trend}.

Positive: {pos} comments
Neutral: {neu} comments
Negative: {neg} comments

Cam xuc noi bat: {dominant_emotion}
Ngu canh video: {context_text}

Ty le phan hoi tieu cuc: {round(neg_ratio * 100, 1)}%

De xuat: tiep tuc theo doi cac nhom binh luan noi bat va dieu chinh noi dung theo phan ung cua nguoi xem.
""".strip()

def analyze_video_context(
    summary: dict,
    emotions: dict,
    video_context=None,
    comments=None,
) -> str:
    """
    Use Gemini to write an analyst report about viewer emotions.
    """

    if not _gemini_ready():
        return _local_emotion_report(summary, emotions, video_context)

    try:
        sample_comments = "\n".join((comments or [])[:30])
        prompt = _build_emotion_analyst_prompt(
            summary=summary,
            emotions=emotions,
            video_context=video_context,
            sample_comments=sample_comments,
        )

        response = gemini_client.models.generate_content(
            model=GEMINI_ANALYST_MODEL,
            contents=prompt,
        )

        text = _response_text(response).strip()
        if text:
            return text

    except Exception as exc:
        print(f"[Gemini Analyst Error] {exc}")

    return _local_emotion_report(summary, emotions, video_context)
# ============================================================================
# FACT-CHECKING V2: MULTIMEDIA ANALYSIS + CLAIM EXTRACTION
# ============================================================================
# This section is intentionally isolated from the legacy emotion pipeline.
# The legacy functions above stay unchanged and continue to serve /analyze.


def _extract_tiktok_post_metadata(video_url: str) -> dict:
    """
    Best-effort extraction of TikTok post metadata without downloading media.
    The post caption is treated as one possible textual modality.
    """
    canonical_url = _resolve_short_url(video_url)

    options = {
        "quiet": True,
        "no_warnings": True,
        "skip_download": True,
        "noplaylist": True,
        "http_headers": {
            "User-Agent": DESKTOP_USER_AGENT,
            "Referer": "https://www.tiktok.com/",
            "Accept-Language": "vi-VN,vi;q=0.9,en-US;q=0.8,en;q=0.7",
        },
    }

    try:
        with yt_dlp.YoutubeDL(options) as downloader:
            info = downloader.extract_info(canonical_url, download=False) or {}

        caption = (
            info.get("description")
            or info.get("title")
            or ""
        )

        return {
            "caption": str(caption).strip(),
            "uploader": str(info.get("uploader") or "").strip(),
            "uploader_id": str(info.get("uploader_id") or "").strip(),
            "upload_date": str(info.get("upload_date") or "").strip(),
            "duration": info.get("duration"),
            "webpage_url": str(info.get("webpage_url") or canonical_url).strip(),
        }
    except Exception as exc:
        print(f"[FactCheck Metadata] could not read TikTok metadata: {exc}")
        return {
            "caption": "",
            "uploader": "",
            "uploader_id": "",
            "upload_date": "",
            "duration": None,
            "webpage_url": canonical_url,
        }


def _build_fact_check_multimedia_prompt(post_metadata: dict | None = None) -> str:
    """
    Phase 2 prompt for multimedia observation + claim extraction.

    Important separation of responsibilities:
    - always analyze observable video modalities first;
    - only then decide whether a checkable/check-worthy claim exists;
    - never perform evidence retrieval or verdict prediction here.
    """
    post_metadata = post_metadata or {}
    caption_text = str(post_metadata.get("caption") or "").strip() or "(khong co caption metadata)"
    upload_date = str(post_metadata.get("upload_date") or "").strip() or "(khong co)"
    uploader = str(post_metadata.get("uploader") or "").strip() or "(khong co)"
    duration = post_metadata.get("duration")

    return f"""
# VAI TRO

Ban la module Multimedia Claim Extraction trong he thong
Multimodal Automated Fact-Checking cho video TikTok.

BUOC NAY CO HAI NHIEM VU TACH BIET:
A. BAT BUOC phan tich multimedia trong video.
B. Sau do moi xac dinh co factual claim can kiem chung hay khong.

KHONG DUOC fact-check va KHONG DUOC dua ra verdict.


# A. MULTIMEDIA EXTRACTION - BAT BUOC

Ngay ca khi video KHONG co factual claim can kiem chung,
ban VAN PHAI phan tich noi dung nhin/nghe/doc duoc.

1. VISUAL
- nguoi, nhan vat, vat the, boi canh, hanh dong;
- do hoa, bieu do, anh chen, canh phim/anime/game neu co;
- chi mo ta nhung gi quan sat duoc.

2. SPEECH
- trich loi noi co the nghe duoc;
- ghi dung y nghia;
- neu khong nghe ro thi khong tu doan.

3. OCR
- chu tren man hinh;
- phu de, tieu de, ten rieng, dia diem, ngay thang, so lieu;
- neu khong doc duoc thi khong tu tao.

4. CAPTION / POST TEXT
- caption metadata duoc cung cap ben duoi;
- day la mot modality text rieng;
- khong coi caption la su that chi vi no xuat hien.

5. CROSS-MODAL
- neu loi noi, OCR, caption va hinh anh cung bo tro hoac mau thuan nhau,
  ghi ngan gon vao cross_modal_notes.
- KHONG suy doan mot ngay/thang la loi, la tuong lai hay sai boi canh neu metadata
  khong cung cap can cu truc tiep. Khi so sanh thoi gian, chi dung metadata ben duoi.

QUY TAC BAT BUOC:
- candidate_claims CO THE la [].
- NHUNG khong duoc de dong thoi visual_observations,
  speech_segments va ocr_segments deu rong neu video thuc su
  co noi dung nhin/nghe/doc duoc.
- Neu mot modality thuc su khong co du lieu, modality do co the rong.


# CONTENT TYPE

Phan loai noi dung vao DUNG MOT gia tri:
- real_world: noi dung chu yeu noi ve su kien/thuc te doi thuc;
- fictional: phim, anime, truyen hu cau, fan-edit, parody, gameplay
  hoac noi dung hu cau ro rang;
- mixed: ket hop noi dung hu cau va factual claim doi thuc;
- uncertain: khong du thong tin de phan loai chac chan.

Neu video la fictional:
- van phai phan tich visual/speech/OCR day du;
- KHONG bien tinh tiet hu cau thanh factual claim ngoai doi thuc.


# FACT VA INTERPRETATION

FACT_OBSERVED:
nhung gi co the truc tiep nhin thay, nghe thay hoac doc duoc.

INTERPRETATION:
suy luan cua mo hinh.

KHONG bien INTERPRETATION thanh factual claim.


# B. CLAIM DETECTION / EXTRACTION

Chi dua vao candidate_claims neu noi dung:
- mang tinh factual;
- ve nguyen tac co the xac minh bang bang chung;
- co y nghia kiem chung trong boi canh doi thuc;
- khong chi la cam xuc, y kien ca nhan, cau dua, loi keu goi;
- neu claim ngan ngam tu nhieu modality, ghi source_modality = "cross_modal".

Cac nhom claim:
- statistical:
  so lieu, ty le, so luong;
- event_place_person:
  su kien, dia diem, nhan vat, to chuc;
- other_factual:
  factual claim khac;
- authenticity_context:
  claim ve nguon goc, thoi gian, dia diem, tinh xac thuc
  hoac boi canh cua anh/video.

Neu khong co claim du kha nang kiem chung:
candidate_claims = [].


# CAM TUYET DOI

KHONG DUOC:
- ket luan SUPPORTED;
- ket luan REFUTED;
- ket luan NEI;
- tao external evidence;
- dung kien thuc nen de kiem chung claim;
- bia danh tinh;
- suy doan thong tin rieng tu;
- coi caption/OCR/loi noi la su that chi vi no xuat hien.


# POST METADATA

Caption: {caption_text}
Uploader: {uploader}
Upload date (YYYYMMDD neu co): {upload_date}
Duration seconds: {duration}

Metadata chi la thong tin nguon/boi canh; khong tu dong chung minh claim dung.

# OUTPUT

Tra ve DUY NHAT JSON hop le:

{{
  "content_type": "real_world | fictional | mixed | uncertain",

  "visual_observations": [
    {{
      "timestamp": "00:00-00:05",
      "fact": "..."
    }}
  ],

  "speech_segments": [
    {{
      "timestamp": "00:00-00:05",
      "text": "..."
    }}
  ],

  "speech_transcript": "...",

  "ocr_segments": [
    {{
      "timestamp": "00:00-00:05",
      "text": "..."
    }}
  ],

  "ocr_text": "...",

  "caption": "...",

  "candidate_claims": [
    {{
      "id": "claim_01",
      "text": "...",
      "source_modality": "speech | ocr | caption | visual | cross_modal",
      "timestamp": "00:00-00:05",
      "checkable": true,
      "check_worthy": true,
      "claim_type": "statistical | event_place_person | other_factual | authenticity_context",
      "rationale": "..."
    }}
  ],

  "cross_modal_notes": [
    "..."
  ]
}}
""".strip()


def _normalize_fact_check_payload(data: dict, metadata: dict) -> dict:
    """Defensive normalization before Pydantic validation in Phase 2."""
    if not isinstance(data, dict):
        data = {}

    def _list_of_dicts(value):
        if not isinstance(value, list):
            return []
        return [item for item in value if isinstance(item, dict)]

    def _list_of_strings(value):
        if not isinstance(value, list):
            return []
        return [str(item).strip() for item in value if str(item).strip()]

    content_type = str(
        data.get("content_type") or "uncertain"
    ).strip().lower()

    if content_type not in {
        "real_world",
        "fictional",
        "mixed",
        "uncertain",
    }:
        content_type = "uncertain"

    caption = str(
        data.get("caption")
        or metadata.get("caption")
        or ""
    ).strip()

    return {
        "content_type": content_type,
        "visual_observations": _list_of_dicts(data.get("visual_observations")),
        "speech_segments": _list_of_dicts(data.get("speech_segments")),
        "speech_transcript": str(data.get("speech_transcript") or "").strip(),
        "ocr_segments": _list_of_dicts(data.get("ocr_segments")),
        "ocr_text": str(data.get("ocr_text") or "").strip(),
        "caption": caption or None,
        "candidate_claims": _list_of_dicts(data.get("candidate_claims")),
        "cross_modal_notes": _list_of_strings(data.get("cross_modal_notes")),
        "metadata": metadata,
    }

def _build_caption_fallback_claims(
    caption: str,
) -> list[dict]:
    """
    Fallback nhẹ khi VLM/Gemini tạm thời không khả dụng.

    Chỉ tạo candidate claim khi caption có dấu hiệu factual rõ ràng.
    Hàm này không thay thế claim extractor chính và không đưa ra verdict.
    """

    import re

    caption = str(caption or "").strip()
    if not caption:
        return []

    # Bỏ hashtag để claim sạch hơn.
    cleaned = re.sub(r"#\S+", " ", caption)
    cleaned = re.sub(r"\s+", " ", cleaned).strip()

    if len(cleaned) < 10:
        return []

    # Heuristic tối thiểu cho fallback.
    # Đây chỉ là cơ chế dự phòng khi VLM lỗi, không phải bộ phân loại claim chính.
    factual_patterns = [
        r"\bhiện\s+có\s+\d+",
        r"\bcó\s+\d+\b",
        r"\bnăm\s+\d{4}\b",
        r"\bngày\s+\d{1,2}[/-]\d{1,2}",
        r"\bđược\s+công\s+bố\b",
        r"\bđược\s+ban\s+hành\b",
        r"\bcông\s+bố\s+rằng\b",
    ]

    is_factual = any(
        re.search(pattern, cleaned, flags=re.IGNORECASE)
        for pattern in factual_patterns
    )

    if not is_factual:
        return []

    claim_type = (
        "statistical"
        if re.search(r"\d", cleaned)
        else "other_factual"
    )

    return [
        {
            "id": "claim_caption_01",
            "text": cleaned,
            "source_modality": "caption",
            "timestamp": None,
            "checkable": True,
            "check_worthy": True,
            "claim_type": claim_type,
            "rationale": (
                "Fallback claim được trích trực tiếp từ caption TikTok "
                "khi VLM video tạm thời không khả dụng."
            ),
        }
    ]


def _build_multimedia_fallback_result(
    metadata: dict,
    *,
    source: str,
    error: str,
) -> dict:
    """
    Tạo response fallback nhất quán cho Phase 2.

    Nếu caption có factual claim rõ ràng, pipeline vẫn có thể tiếp tục sang
    Evidence Retrieval dù visual/speech/OCR chưa có vì Gemini bị lỗi.
    """

    result = _normalize_fact_check_payload({}, metadata)

    caption = str(metadata.get("caption") or "").strip()
    fallback_claims = _build_caption_fallback_claims(caption)

    if fallback_claims:
        result["candidate_claims"] = fallback_claims
        result["source"] = "caption_fallback"
        result["cross_modal_notes"] = [
            "VLM video không khả dụng; candidate claim được lấy từ caption metadata."
        ]
        result.setdefault("metadata", {})[
            "caption_claim_fallback_used"
        ] = True
        result.setdefault("metadata", {})[
            "multimedia_failure_source"
        ] = source
    else:
        result["source"] = source

    result["error"] = error
    return result


def analyze_tiktok_multimedia(
    video_url: str,
) -> dict:
    """
    Phase 2 - Multimedia Analysis + Claim Extraction.

    TikTok URL
        -> Visual
        -> Speech
        -> OCR
        -> Caption
        -> Candidate Claims

    Không thực hiện:
    - evidence retrieval
    - verdict prediction
    - explanation generation
    """

    metadata = _extract_tiktok_post_metadata(video_url)

    # ========================================================
    # GEMINI NOT AVAILABLE
    # ========================================================
    if not _gemini_ready():
        return _build_multimedia_fallback_result(
            metadata,
            source="gemini_unavailable",
            error="GEMINI_API_KEY is missing",
        )

    temp_dir = None
    uploaded_file = None

    try:
        # ====================================================
        # 1. DOWNLOAD VIDEO
        # ====================================================
        video_path, temp_dir = _download_tiktok_video(video_url)

        # ====================================================
        # 2. CACHE VIDEO
        # ====================================================
        video_id = _video_id_from_url(video_url)

        if video_id:
            try:
                shutil.copy2(
                    video_path,
                    VIDEO_CACHE_DIR / f"{video_id}.mp4",
                )
            except Exception as cache_exc:
                print(
                    "[FactCheck Multimedia] cache copy failed: "
                    f"{cache_exc}"
                )

        # ====================================================
        # 3. UPLOAD VIDEO TO GEMINI
        # ====================================================
        uploaded_file = _upload_video_to_gemini(video_path)

        # ====================================================
        # 4. BUILD PROMPT
        # ====================================================
        prompt = _build_fact_check_multimedia_prompt(metadata)

        # ====================================================
        # 5. GEMINI + RETRY
        # ====================================================
        retry_result = generate_content_with_retry(
            gemini_client,
            model=GEMINI_VISION_MODEL,
            contents=[prompt, uploaded_file],
            config=types.GenerateContentConfig(
                response_mime_type="application/json",
            ),
        )

        # Defensive check để tránh lỗi biến chưa được khởi tạo nếu helper
        # bị sửa sai ở nơi khác.
        if (
            not isinstance(retry_result, tuple)
            or len(retry_result) != 2
        ):
            raise RuntimeError(
                "generate_content_with_retry() must return "
                "(response, model_used)."
            )

        response, model_used = retry_result

        if response is None:
            raise RuntimeError("Gemini returned None response.")

        # ====================================================
        # 6. PARSE GEMINI RESPONSE
        # ====================================================
        response_text = _response_text(response)
        data = _extract_json(response_text)

        if not data:
            raise RuntimeError(
                "Gemini returned empty or invalid multimedia JSON."
            )

        # ====================================================
        # 7. NORMALIZE
        # ====================================================
        result = _normalize_fact_check_payload(data, metadata)

        # Nếu VLM thành công nhưng bỏ sót một factual claim rất rõ trong
        # caption, dùng caption heuristic làm fallback bổ sung.
        if not result.get("candidate_claims"):
            caption_claims = _build_caption_fallback_claims(
                result.get("caption") or ""
            )
            if caption_claims:
                result["candidate_claims"] = caption_claims
                result.setdefault("cross_modal_notes", []).append(
                    "VLM không tạo candidate claim; hệ thống bổ sung một "
                    "candidate claim factual rõ ràng từ caption metadata."
                )
                result.setdefault("metadata", {})[
                    "caption_claim_fallback_used"
                ] = True

        result["source"] = "gemini_multimodal"
        result["model"] = str(model_used or GEMINI_VISION_MODEL)
        result["error"] = None

        print(
            "[FactCheck Multimedia] "
            f"OK model={result['model']} "
            f"claims={len(result.get('candidate_claims', []))}"
        )

        return result

    # ========================================================
    # ERROR FALLBACK
    # ========================================================
    except Exception as exc:
        import traceback

        print(
            "[FactCheck Multimedia Error] "
            f"{type(exc).__name__}: {exc}"
        )
        traceback.print_exc()

        return _build_multimedia_fallback_result(
            metadata,
            source="multimedia_error",
            error=f"{type(exc).__name__}: {exc}",
        )

    # ========================================================
    # CLEANUP
    # ========================================================
    finally:
        if uploaded_file is not None:
            try:
                gemini_client.files.delete(name=uploaded_file.name)
            except Exception:
                pass

        if temp_dir:
            shutil.rmtree(temp_dir, ignore_errors=True)

// END ------------------------------

// FILE: backend\core\kan_Arch_1D.py
