from __future__ import annotations

import base64
import os
from io import BytesIO
from typing import Any

from PIL import Image, UnidentifiedImageError

from config import EVIDENCE_MAX_IMAGE_BYTES, EVIDENCE_REQUEST_TIMEOUT
from fact_checking.evidence.http_utils import read_limited_bytes, safe_get
from core.vlm import circuit
from core.vlm.openai_http import generate_json, is_configured


_ALLOWED_VERDICTS = {"SUPPORTED", "REFUTED", "NEI"}
_ALLOWED_STANCES = {"support", "refute", "neutral", "context"}


def _as_dict(value: Any) -> dict[str, Any]:
    if isinstance(value, dict):
        return value
    if hasattr(value, "model_dump"):
        try:
            data = value.model_dump()
            return data if isinstance(data, dict) else {}
        except Exception:
            return {}
    return {}


def _claim_text(claim: Any) -> str:
    data = _as_dict(claim)
    return str(data.get("text") or getattr(claim, "text", "") or "").strip()


def _evidence_prompt(
    evidence: list[Any],
) -> tuple[str, list[str], list[tuple[str, str]], set[str]]:
    """
    Build the text prompt and collect image evidence references.

    Returns:
        prompt_text,
        all_candidate_ids,
        image_candidates[(evidence_id, media_url)],
        image_evidence_ids
    """
    chunks: list[str] = []
    ids: list[str] = []
    image_candidates: list[tuple[str, str]] = []
    image_ids: set[str] = set()
    max_chars = int(os.getenv("VERIFICATION_MAX_EVIDENCE_CHARS", "1800"))
    max_images = int(os.getenv("VERIFICATION_MAX_IMAGES", "3"))

    for idx, raw in enumerate(evidence, start=1):
        item = _as_dict(raw)
        evidence_id = str(item.get("id") or item.get("evidence_id") or f"evidence_{idx}")
        modality = str(item.get("modality") or "text").lower()
        title = str(item.get("title") or "")
        url = str(item.get("source_url") or "")
        domain = str(item.get("source_domain") or "")
        content = str(item.get("content") or "")[:max_chars]
        published_at = item.get("published_at")
        source_quality = item.get("source_quality")

        ids.append(evidence_id)
        chunks.append(
            "\n".join(
                [
                    f"EVIDENCE_ID: {evidence_id}",
                    f"MODALITY: {modality}",
                    f"TITLE: {title}",
                    f"SOURCE: {domain}",
                    f"URL: {url}",
                    f"PUBLISHED_AT: {published_at}",
                    f"SOURCE_QUALITY_METADATA: {source_quality}",
                    f"CONTENT: {content}",
                ]
            )
        )

        if modality == "image":
            image_ids.add(evidence_id)
            media_url = str(item.get("media_url") or "").strip()
            if len(image_candidates) < max_images:
                image_candidates.append((evidence_id, media_url))

    return "\n\n---\n\n".join(chunks), ids, image_candidates, image_ids


def _image_to_data_url(image: Image.Image) -> str:
    """Normalize a remotely fetched image to a compact JPEG data URL."""
    max_side = max(256, int(os.getenv("OPENAI_PHASE4_IMAGE_MAX_SIDE", "1280")))
    quality = max(50, min(95, int(os.getenv("OPENAI_PHASE4_IMAGE_JPEG_QUALITY", "82"))))

    normalized = image.convert("RGB")
    normalized.thumbnail((max_side, max_side))

    buffer = BytesIO()
    normalized.save(buffer, format="JPEG", quality=quality, optimize=True)
    encoded = base64.b64encode(buffer.getvalue()).decode("ascii")
    return f"data:image/jpeg;base64,{encoded}"


def _fetch_image_as_data_url(url: str) -> str:
    """
    Fetch image server-side using the project's guarded HTTP helper.

    This avoids asking the OpenAI API to download third-party CDN URLs itself,
    which is unreliable for slow/blocked/redirecting image hosts.
    """
    if not url:
        raise ValueError("missing media_url")

    timeout = float(os.getenv("OPENAI_PHASE4_IMAGE_FETCH_TIMEOUT", str(EVIDENCE_REQUEST_TIMEOUT)))
    max_bytes = int(os.getenv("OPENAI_PHASE4_IMAGE_MAX_BYTES", str(EVIDENCE_MAX_IMAGE_BYTES)))

    response = None
    try:
        response = safe_get(
            url,
            timeout=timeout,
            headers={"User-Agent": "Mozilla/5.0"},
            stream=True,
        )
        response.raise_for_status()

        content_type = str(response.headers.get("content-type") or "").lower()
        if content_type and not content_type.startswith("image/"):
            raise ValueError(f"unexpected content-type: {content_type}")

        raw = read_limited_bytes(response, max_bytes)
        with Image.open(BytesIO(raw)) as image:
            image.load()
            return _image_to_data_url(image)
    except (UnidentifiedImageError, OSError, ValueError) as exc:
        raise RuntimeError(f"image decode/validation failed: {exc}") from exc
    finally:
        if response is not None:
            try:
                response.close()
            except Exception:
                pass


def _prepare_image_attachments(
    image_candidates: list[tuple[str, str]],
) -> tuple[list[str], set[str], list[str]]:
    """
    Materialize image evidence to data URLs.

    One failed image must not fail the whole claim. The verifier continues with
    successfully attached images and/or text evidence.
    """
    data_urls: list[str] = []
    attached_ids: set[str] = set()
    failures: list[str] = []

    for evidence_id, media_url in image_candidates:
        try:
            data_urls.append(_fetch_image_as_data_url(media_url))
            attached_ids.add(evidence_id)
        except Exception as exc:
            failures.append(f"{evidence_id}: {type(exc).__name__}: {exc}")

    return data_urls, attached_ids, failures


def _multimedia_context(multimedia: Any) -> str:
    data = _as_dict(multimedia)
    visual = data.get("visual_observations") or []
    visual_text = []
    for item in visual[:8]:
        if isinstance(item, dict):
            visual_text.append(f"[{item.get('timestamp')}] {item.get('fact')}")
    return "\n".join(
        [
            f"CAPTION: {data.get('caption') or ''}",
            f"SPEECH_TRANSCRIPT: {str(data.get('speech_transcript') or '')[:5000]}",
            f"OCR_TEXT: {str(data.get('ocr_text') or '')[:3500]}",
            "VISUAL_OBSERVATIONS:\n" + "\n".join(visual_text),
        ]
    )


def _reasoning_text(reasoning_support: Any) -> str:
    data = _as_dict(reasoning_support)
    return str(data.get("reasoning_support") or "")[:6000]


def _normalize_verification(
    data: dict[str, Any],
    *,
    candidate_ids: list[str],
    model: str,
    attached_image_ids: set[str],
) -> dict[str, Any]:
    verdict = str(data.get("verdict") or "").strip().upper()
    if verdict not in _ALLOWED_VERDICTS:
        raise ValueError(f"Invalid verdict from VLM: {verdict!r}")

    confidence_raw = data.get("confidence")
    try:
        confidence = float(confidence_raw)
    except Exception:
        confidence = 0.0
    confidence = max(0.0, min(1.0, confidence))

    allowed = set(candidate_ids)
    evidence_ids = [
        str(x)
        for x in (data.get("evidence_ids") or [])
        if str(x) in allowed
    ]

    assessments: list[dict[str, Any]] = []
    for item in data.get("evidence_assessments") or []:
        if not isinstance(item, dict):
            continue
        evidence_id = str(item.get("evidence_id") or "")
        if evidence_id not in allowed:
            continue
        stance = str(item.get("stance") or "neutral").lower()
        if stance not in _ALLOWED_STANCES:
            stance = "neutral"
        try:
            item_conf = float(item.get("confidence", 0.0))
        except Exception:
            item_conf = 0.0
        assessments.append(
            {
                "evidence_id": evidence_id,
                "stance": stance,
                "confidence": max(0.0, min(1.0, item_conf)),
                "rationale": str(item.get("rationale") or "").strip(),
            }
        )

    limitations = [
        str(x).strip()
        for x in (data.get("limitations") or [])
        if str(x).strip()
    ]

    coverage = str(data.get("evidence_coverage") or "").strip().upper()
    if coverage not in {"COMPLETE", "PARTIAL", "INSUFFICIENT"}:
        # Conservative default: the verifier must explicitly assert COMPLETE
        # before a SUPPORTED prediction is accepted.
        coverage = "INSUFFICIENT"

    # Research-hardening guard:
    # SUPPORTED requires complete coverage by EXTERNAL retrieved evidence.
    # Source-video caption/OCR/speech/frames are context for interpreting the
    # claim only and must never be used to self-confirm it.
    if verdict == "SUPPORTED" and coverage != "COMPLETE":
        verdict = "NEI"
        confidence = min(confidence, 0.65)
        limitations.append(
            "SUPPORTED was downgraded to NEI because external retrieved evidence "
            "did not completely cover every material component of the claim."
        )

    # A truthfulness decision must cite at least one retrieved evidence item.
    # If retrieval completed but the model cites none, this is evidence
    # insufficiency, not a technical failure.
    if verdict in {"SUPPORTED", "REFUTED"} and not evidence_ids:
        verdict = "NEI"
        confidence = min(confidence, 0.55)
        coverage = "INSUFFICIENT"
        limitations.append(
            "No external retrieved evidence item was cited for the proposed verdict."
        )

    # multimodal_used means the final verdict actually CITES at least one
    # successfully attached image evidence item. Merely sending an image to the
    # model or using source-video multimedia context does not count.
    multimodal_used = bool(set(evidence_ids) & set(attached_image_ids))

    return {
        "status": "SUCCESS",
        "verdict": verdict,
        "confidence": confidence,
        "evidence_ids": evidence_ids,
        "evidence_assessments": assessments,
        "evidence_coverage": coverage,
        "rationale": str(data.get("rationale") or "").strip(),
        "uncertainty": str(data.get("uncertainty") or "").strip(),
        "limitations": limitations,
        "multimodal_used": multimodal_used,
        "model": model,
        "provider": "openai",
    }


def verify_openai(
    *,
    claim: Any,
    multimedia: Any,
    evidence: list[Any],
    reasoning_support: Any,
) -> dict[str, Any]:
    if not evidence:
        return {
            "status": "UNAVAILABLE",
            "verdict": None,
            "confidence": None,
            "evidence_ids": [],
            "evidence_assessments": [],
            "rationale": "Không thể xác minh vì Evidence Retrieval không cung cấp evidence khả dụng.",
            "uncertainty": "INSUFFICIENT_COLLECTION",
            "limitations": ["No usable retrieved evidence."],
            "multimodal_used": False,
            "model": "",
            "provider": "openai",
        }

    if not is_configured():
        raise RuntimeError("OPENAI_API_KEY is not configured")

    evidence_text, all_candidate_ids, image_candidates, image_ids = _evidence_prompt(evidence)
    image_data_urls, attached_image_ids, image_transport_failures = _prepare_image_attachments(
        image_candidates
    )

    # Image evidence that could not be materialized must not be cited as visual
    # evidence. Text evidence remains usable, so verification can continue.
    candidate_ids = [
        evidence_id
        for evidence_id in all_candidate_ids
        if evidence_id not in image_ids or evidence_id in attached_image_ids
    ]

    if not candidate_ids:
        raise RuntimeError(
            "No usable evidence remained after image transport preparation"
        )

    image_transport_note = ""
    if image_candidates:
        failed_ids = [
            item.split(":", 1)[0]
            for item in image_transport_failures
        ]
        image_transport_note = "\n".join(
            [
                "# IMAGE ATTACHMENT STATUS",
                f"Attached image evidence IDs: {sorted(attached_image_ids) or '(none)'}",
                f"Unavailable image evidence IDs: {failed_ids or '(none)'}",
                (
                    "Do not infer visual facts from unavailable image evidence. "
                    "Continue verification from the remaining usable evidence."
                ),
            ]
        )

    claim_text = _claim_text(claim)
    reasoning_text = _reasoning_text(reasoning_support)
    context_text = _multimedia_context(multimedia)

    prompt = f"""
# ROLE
You are the Phase 4 evidence-grounded verifier for a multimodal fact-checking system.

# HARD RULES
- Decide truthfulness ONLY from EXTERNAL RETRIEVED EVIDENCE below.
- SOURCE MULTIMEDIA CONTEXT is provided only to interpret what the TikTok claim means, resolve references, and recover its time anchor. It is NOT evidence that the claim is true or false.
- Never support/refute a claim because the source video, caption, OCR, speech transcript, frame, uploader, or on-screen graphic repeats the same claim.
- SUPPORTED: external retrieved evidence completely confirms every material component of the atomic claim.
- REFUTED: external retrieved evidence contradicts the core proposition.
- NEI: evidence collection succeeded, but external retrieved evidence is incomplete or insufficient to support or refute.
- For conjunctions, lists, quantities, or multi-person claims, SUPPORTED requires external evidence covering ALL material components. Partial corroboration => NEI.
- A technical/API/retrieval failure is NEVER NEI. (Technical failure is handled outside this prompt.)
- Do not treat source_quality metadata as truth by itself.
- Respect dates/temporal anchors and distinguish historical vs current-state claims.
- evidence_ids MUST be selected only from the provided EVIDENCE_ID values.
- evidence_coverage MUST be COMPLETE, PARTIAL, or INSUFFICIENT and refers only to external retrieved evidence.
- Do not reveal private chain-of-thought. Return concise evidence-grounded rationales only.

# CLAIM
{claim_text}

# SOURCE MULTIMEDIA CONTEXT — INTERPRETATION ONLY, NOT TRUTH EVIDENCE
{context_text}

# CONCEPTUAL REASONING SUPPORT
{reasoning_text or '(none)'}

# RETRIEVED EVIDENCE
{evidence_text}

{image_transport_note}

# OUTPUT
Return ONLY a JSON object:
{{
  "verdict": "SUPPORTED | REFUTED | NEI",
  "confidence": 0.0,
  "evidence_coverage": "COMPLETE | PARTIAL | INSUFFICIENT",
  "evidence_ids": ["..."],
  "evidence_assessments": [
    {{
      "evidence_id": "...",
      "stance": "support | refute | neutral | context",
      "confidence": 0.0,
      "rationale": "short evidence-grounded rationale"
    }}
  ],
  "rationale": "concise explanation of why the evidence implies the verdict",
  "uncertainty": "remaining uncertainty, if any",
  "limitations": ["..."]
}}
""".strip()

    models_raw = os.getenv("OPENAI_VERIFICATION_MODELS", os.getenv("OPENAI_VLM_MODELS", "gpt-6-luna"))
    models = [x.strip() for x in models_raw.split(",") if x.strip()] or ["gpt-6-luna"]
    errors: list[str] = []

    for model in models:
        if circuit.is_open("openai", model):
            remain = circuit.remaining_seconds("openai", model)
            errors.append(f"{model}: circuit_open remaining~{remain:.0f}s")
            continue
        try:
            data = generate_json(
                model=model,
                prompt=prompt,
                image_urls=image_data_urls,
                max_output_tokens=int(os.getenv("OPENAI_PHASE4_MAX_OUTPUT_TOKENS", "3000")),
                timeout_seconds=float(os.getenv("OPENAI_VLM_TIMEOUT", "120")),
                image_detail=os.getenv("OPENAI_IMAGE_DETAIL", "low"),
            )
            result = _normalize_verification(
                data,
                candidate_ids=candidate_ids,
                model=model,
                attached_image_ids=attached_image_ids,
            )
            if image_transport_failures:
                result["limitations"] = list(result.get("limitations") or []) + [
                    (
                        f"{len(image_transport_failures)} image evidence item(s) could not "
                        "be attached to the VLM; verification continued with remaining evidence."
                    )
                ]
            return result
        except Exception as exc:
            errors.append(f"{model}: {type(exc).__name__}: {exc}")

    raise RuntimeError("OpenAI Phase 4 failed: " + " | ".join(errors))

// END ------------------------------

// FILE: backend\fact_checking\verification\verification_schema.py
// START ------------------------------
from __future__ import annotations

from typing import Literal, Optional

from pydantic import BaseModel, ConfigDict, Field

from fact_checking.schemas import StageStatus


Verdict = Literal["SUPPORTED", "REFUTED", "NEI"]
EvidenceStance = Literal["support", "refute", "neutral"]


class EvidenceAssessment(BaseModel):
    model_config = ConfigDict(extra="ignore")

    evidence_id: str
    stance: EvidenceStance = "neutral"
    confidence: float = Field(default=0.0, ge=0.0, le=1.0)
    rationale: str = ""


class VerificationResult(BaseModel):
    model_config = ConfigDict(extra="ignore")

    # Operational status is intentionally separate from the semantic verdict.
    # Provider/model failure must never be represented as NEI.
    status: StageStatus = "SUCCESS"
    verdict: Optional[Verdict] = None
    confidence: Optional[float] = Field(default=None, ge=0.0, le=1.0)

    evidence_ids: list[str] = Field(default_factory=list)
    evidence_assessments: list[EvidenceAssessment] = Field(default_factory=list)

    rationale: str = ""
    uncertainty: str = ""
    limitations: list[str] = Field(default_factory=list)

    multimodal_used: bool = False
    model: str = ""

// END ------------------------------

// FILE: backend\fact_checking\verification\verification_service.py
// START ------------------------------
from __future__ import annotations

import asyncio

from config import GEMINI_ANALYST_MODEL, VERIFICATION_BATCH_ENABLED, VERIFICATION_BATCH_MAX_CLAIMS
from fact_checking.evidence.evidence_schema import EvidenceItem
from fact_checking.schemas import CandidateClaim, MultimediaAnalysis
from fact_checking.verification.verification_schema import (
    EvidenceAssessment,
    VerificationResult,
)


ALLOWED_VERDICTS = {"SUPPORTED", "REFUTED", "NEI"}
ALLOWED_STANCES = {"support", "refute", "neutral"}


def _clamp_score(value, default: float = 0.0) -> float:
    try:
        score = float(value)
    except (TypeError, ValueError):
        score = default
    return max(0.0, min(1.0, score))


def nei_no_evidence_result(reason: str) -> VerificationResult:
    """Semantic NEI: retrieval ran, but usable evidence is insufficient."""
    return VerificationResult(
        status="SUCCESS",
        verdict="NEI",
        confidence=0.0,
        rationale=reason,
        uncertainty=reason,
        limitations=["No usable retrieved evidence was available after a completed retrieval stage."],
        multimodal_used=False,
        model="",
    )


def unavailable_verification_result(reason: str, limitations: list[str] | None = None) -> VerificationResult:
    """Operational failure: no truthfulness label is emitted."""
    return VerificationResult(
        status="UNAVAILABLE",
        verdict=None,
        confidence=None,
        rationale="Không thể hoàn tất bước xác minh do thành phần phụ thuộc không khả dụng.",
        uncertainty=reason,
        limitations=limitations or [reason],
        multimodal_used=False,
        model="",
    )


def failed_verification_result(reason: str) -> VerificationResult:
    return VerificationResult(
        status="FAILED",
        verdict=None,
        confidence=None,
        rationale="Bước xác minh gặp lỗi xử lý nội bộ và không phát sinh verdict.",
        uncertainty=reason,
        limitations=[reason],
        multimodal_used=False,
        model="",
    )


def _normalize_result(raw: dict, evidence: list[EvidenceItem]) -> VerificationResult:
    valid_ids = {item.id for item in evidence}
    verdict = str(raw.get("verdict") or "NEI").upper().strip()
    if verdict not in ALLOWED_VERDICTS:
        verdict = "NEI"

    confidence = _clamp_score(raw.get("confidence"))
    evidence_ids = []

    if isinstance(raw.get("evidence_ids"), list):
        for value in raw["evidence_ids"]:
            evidence_id = str(value).strip()
            if evidence_id in valid_ids and evidence_id not in evidence_ids:
                evidence_ids.append(evidence_id)

    assessments = []
    if isinstance(raw.get("evidence_assessments"), list):
        for row in raw["evidence_assessments"]:
            if not isinstance(row, dict):
                continue
            evidence_id = str(row.get("evidence_id") or "").strip()
            if evidence_id not in valid_ids:
                continue
            stance = str(row.get("stance") or "neutral").lower().strip()
            if stance not in ALLOWED_STANCES:
                stance = "neutral"
            assessments.append(
                EvidenceAssessment(
                    evidence_id=evidence_id,
                    stance=stance,
                    confidence=_clamp_score(row.get("confidence")),
                    rationale=str(row.get("rationale") or "").strip(),
                )
            )

    if not evidence_ids:
        for assessment in assessments:
            if assessment.stance != "neutral" and assessment.evidence_id not in evidence_ids:
                evidence_ids.append(assessment.evidence_id)

    rationale = str(raw.get("rationale") or "").strip()
    uncertainty = str(raw.get("uncertainty") or "").strip()
    limitations = []
    if isinstance(raw.get("limitations"), list):
        limitations = [
            str(item).strip()
            for item in raw["limitations"]
            if str(item).strip()
        ][:10]

    attached_image_count = int(raw.get("_attached_image_count") or 0)
    multimodal_used = bool(raw.get("multimodal_used")) and attached_image_count > 0

    # Evidence-grounding guardrail: decisive labels require attributable evidence.
    if verdict in {"SUPPORTED", "REFUTED"} and not evidence_ids:
        verdict = "NEI"
        confidence = min(confidence, 0.35)
        limitations.append("Decisive verdict had no valid cited evidence ID and was downgraded to NEI.")
        uncertainty = uncertainty or "Không có evidence ID hợp lệ cho kết luận quyết định."

    expected_stance = {"SUPPORTED": "support", "REFUTED": "refute"}.get(verdict)
    if expected_stance:
        has_matching_stance = any(
            assessment.evidence_id in evidence_ids
            and assessment.stance == expected_stance
            for assessment in assessments
        )
        if not has_matching_stance:
            verdict = "NEI"
            confidence = min(confidence, 0.35)
            limitations.append("Cited evidence assessments did not contain a stance matching the decisive verdict.")
            uncertainty = uncertainty or "Evidence stance chưa đủ nhất quán cho kết luận quyết định."

    if verdict == "NEI" and not uncertainty:
        uncertainty = "Bằng chứng hiện có chưa đủ để support hoặc refute claim một cách chắc chắn."

    return VerificationResult(
        status="SUCCESS",
        verdict=verdict,
        confidence=confidence,
        evidence_ids=evidence_ids,
        evidence_assessments=assessments,
        rationale=rationale,
        uncertainty=uncertainty,
        limitations=limitations,
        multimodal_used=multimodal_used,
        model=str(raw.get("_model") or GEMINI_ANALYST_MODEL),
    )


def _looks_operationally_unavailable(exc: Exception) -> bool:
    text = str(exc).lower()
    markers = (
        "429",
        "resource_exhausted",
        "503",
        "unavailable",
        "high demand",
        "timeout",
        "deadline exceeded",
        "connection",
        "circuit open",
        "geminicircuitopenerror",
    )
    return any(marker in text for marker in markers)


async def verify_claim(
    claim: CandidateClaim,
    multimedia: MultimediaAnalysis,
    evidence: list[EvidenceItem],
    reasoning_support: dict,
) -> VerificationResult:
    """
    Phase 4: claim + retrieved multimodal evidence -> SUPPORTED/REFUTED/NEI.

    The reasoning-support text is an intermediate evidence integration aid;
    the final verdict remains constrained to retrieved evidence IDs.
    """
    if not evidence:
        return nei_no_evidence_result(
            "Evidence Retrieval hoàn tất nhưng không thu được bằng chứng đủ để xác minh claim."
        )

    try:
        from fact_checking.verification.vlm_verifier import verify_with_vlm_sync

        raw = await asyncio.to_thread(
            verify_with_vlm_sync,
            claim,
            multimedia,
            evidence,
            reasoning_support,
        )
    except Exception as exc:
        reason = f"Verifier error: {type(exc).__name__}: {exc}"
        if _looks_operationally_unavailable(exc):
            return unavailable_verification_result(reason)
        return failed_verification_result(reason)

    return _normalize_result(raw, evidence)



async def verify_claims_batch(
    jobs: list[tuple[CandidateClaim, list[EvidenceItem], dict]],
    multimedia: MultimediaAnalysis,
) -> dict[str, VerificationResult]:
    """Quota-aware batch verification. No sequential retry after batch failure."""
    if not jobs:
        return {}

    # Preserve the simple path for one claim and for explicitly disabled batch mode.
    if not VERIFICATION_BATCH_ENABLED or len(jobs) == 1:
        results: dict[str, VerificationResult] = {}
        for claim, evidence, reasoning_support in jobs:
            results[claim.id] = await verify_claim(
                claim=claim,
                multimedia=multimedia,
                evidence=evidence,
                reasoning_support=reasoning_support,
            )
        return results

    if len(jobs) > VERIFICATION_BATCH_MAX_CLAIMS:
        # Split into bounded batches, not one request per claim.
        results: dict[str, VerificationResult] = {}
        for start in range(0, len(jobs), VERIFICATION_BATCH_MAX_CLAIMS):
            part = jobs[start:start + VERIFICATION_BATCH_MAX_CLAIMS]
            results.update(await verify_claims_batch(part, multimedia))
        return results

    try:
        from fact_checking.verification.vlm_verifier import verify_batch_with_vlm_sync
        raw_by_id = await asyncio.to_thread(
            verify_batch_with_vlm_sync,
            jobs,
            multimedia,
        )
    except Exception as exc:
        reason = f"Batch verifier error: {type(exc).__name__}: {exc}"
        factory = unavailable_verification_result if _looks_operationally_unavailable(exc) else failed_verification_result
        return {claim.id: factory(reason) for claim, _, _ in jobs}

    results: dict[str, VerificationResult] = {}
    for claim, evidence, _ in jobs:
        raw = raw_by_id.get(claim.id)
        if not raw:
            results[claim.id] = failed_verification_result(
                f"Batch verifier omitted claim_id={claim.id}"
            )
            continue
        results[claim.id] = _normalize_result(raw, evidence)
    return results

// END ------------------------------

// FILE: backend\fact_checking\verification\verification_service_multivlm.py
// START ------------------------------
from __future__ import annotations

import os
from typing import Any

from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

from core.vlm import circuit
from fact_checking.verification.multivlm_verifier import verify_openai
from fact_checking.verification.verification_service import verify_claim as _legacy_verify_claim


class VerificationResultV23(BaseModel):
    status: str = "SUCCESS"
    verdict: str | None = None
    confidence: float | None = None
    evidence_ids: list[str] = Field(default_factory=list)
    evidence_assessments: list[dict[str, Any]] = Field(default_factory=list)
    evidence_coverage: str | None = None
    rationale: str = ""
    uncertainty: str = ""
    limitations: list[str] = Field(default_factory=list)
    multimodal_used: bool = False
    model: str = ""
    provider: str | None = None


def failed_verification_result(reason: str) -> VerificationResultV23:
    """Internal/retrieval execution failure. Never convert this to NEI."""
    return VerificationResultV23(
        status="FAILED",
        verdict=None,
        confidence=None,
        evidence_coverage=None,
        rationale="Không thể hoàn tất bước xác minh do lỗi kỹ thuật nội bộ.",
        uncertainty=str(reason or "INTERNAL_FAILURE"),
        limitations=[str(reason or "Internal verification failure.")],
        multimodal_used=False,
        model="",
        provider=None,
    )


def unavailable_verification_result(
    reason: str,
    *,
    limitations: list[str] | None = None,
) -> VerificationResultV23:
    """Dependency/provider unavailable. Verdict must remain null."""
    return VerificationResultV23(
        status="UNAVAILABLE",
        verdict=None,
        confidence=None,
        evidence_coverage=None,
        rationale="Không thể hoàn tất bước xác minh do dependency/provider không khả dụng.",
        uncertainty=str(reason or "UNAVAILABLE"),
        limitations=list(limitations or [str(reason or "Verification unavailable.")]),
        multimodal_used=False,
        model="",
        provider=None,
    )


def nei_no_evidence_result(reason: str) -> VerificationResultV23:
    """Retrieval completed normally but external evidence was insufficient."""
    return VerificationResultV23(
        status="SUCCESS",
        verdict="NEI",
        confidence=0.5,
        evidence_ids=[],
        evidence_assessments=[],
        evidence_coverage="INSUFFICIENT",
        rationale=str(reason or "External evidence is insufficient to support or refute the claim."),
        uncertainty="INSUFFICIENT_EXTERNAL_EVIDENCE",
        limitations=["Evidence retrieval completed but did not provide sufficient external evidence."],
        multimodal_used=False,
        model="deterministic-guard",
        provider="system",
    )



def _bool_env(name: str, default: bool) -> bool:
    raw = os.getenv(name)
    if raw is None:
        return default
    return raw.strip().lower() in {"1", "true", "yes", "on"}


def _provider_order() -> list[str]:
    raw = os.getenv("VLM_VERIFICATION_PROVIDER_ORDER", os.getenv("VLM_PROVIDER_ORDER", "openai,gemini"))
    order = [x.strip().lower() for x in raw.split(",") if x.strip()]
    return order or ["openai", "gemini"]


def _remember_gemini_quota(text: str) -> None:
    if "429" not in text and "RESOURCE_EXHAUSTED" not in text:
        return
    retry = circuit.parse_retry_after_seconds(text, 300)
    for model in {
        os.getenv("GEMINI_VISION_MODEL", "gemini-3.8-flash"),
        os.getenv("GEMINI_FALLBACK_MODEL", "gemini-3.7-flash"),
    }:
        if model:
            circuit.open_circuit("gemini", model, seconds=retry, reason=text)


async def verify_claim(
    *,
    claim: Any,
    multimedia: Any,
    evidence: list[Any],
    reasoning_support: Any,
) -> VerificationResultV23:
    """Drop-in replacement for Phase 4 verification_service.verify_claim."""
    if not evidence:
        return VerificationResultV23(
            status="UNAVAILABLE",
            verdict=None,
            confidence=None,
            rationale=(
                "Không thể hoàn tất verification vì Evidence Retrieval "
                "không cung cấp evidence khả dụng."
            ),
            uncertainty="INSUFFICIENT_COLLECTION",
            limitations=["No usable retrieved evidence."],
            multimodal_used=False,
            provider=None,
        )

    failures: list[str] = []
    for provider in _provider_order():
        if provider == "openai":
            try:
                return VerificationResultV23(
                    **verify_openai(
                        claim=claim,
                        multimedia=multimedia,
                        evidence=evidence,
                        reasoning_support=reasoning_support,
                    )
                )
            except Exception as exc:
                failures.append(f"openai: {type(exc).__name__}: {exc}")
                continue

        if provider == "gemini":
            if _bool_env("VLM_STRICT_EXTERNAL_GROUNDING", True):
                failures.append(
                    "gemini: skipped in strict research mode because the legacy "
                    "Gemini verifier has not yet been hardened to external-evidence-only grounding"
                )
                continue
            gemini_models = [
                os.getenv("GEMINI_VISION_MODEL", "gemini-3.8-flash"),
                os.getenv("GEMINI_FALLBACK_MODEL", "gemini-3.7-flash"),
            ]
            if all(circuit.is_open("gemini", m) for m in gemini_models if m):
                failures.append("gemini: persistent circuit open")
                continue
            try:
                legacy = await _legacy_verify_claim(
                    claim=claim,
                    multimedia=multimedia,
                    evidence=evidence,
                    reasoning_support=reasoning_support,
                )
                data = legacy.model_dump() if hasattr(legacy, "model_dump") else dict(legacy)
                if str(data.get("status") or "").upper() in {"FAILED", "UNAVAILABLE"}:
                    text = " | ".join(
                        [
                            str(data.get("uncertainty") or ""),
                            " ".join(str(x) for x in (data.get("limitations") or [])),
                        ]
                    )
                    _remember_gemini_quota(text)
                    failures.append(f"gemini: {text}")
                    continue
                data["provider"] = "gemini"
                return VerificationResultV23(**data)
            except Exception as exc:
                text = f"{type(exc).__name__}: {exc}"
                _remember_gemini_quota(text)
                failures.append(f"gemini: {text}")
                continue

    return VerificationResultV23(
        status="UNAVAILABLE",
        verdict=None,
        confidence=None,
        evidence_ids=[],
        evidence_assessments=[],
        rationale="Không thể hoàn tất bước xác minh do tất cả VLM provider đều không khả dụng.",
        uncertainty=" | ".join(failures),
        limitations=failures,
        multimodal_used=False,
        model="",
        provider=None,
    )


# ============================================================
# v2.3.1 - BATCH COMPATIBILITY
# ============================================================

def _candidate_value(item: Any, key: str, default: Any = None) -> Any:
    """Read a field from dict/Pydantic/object candidates defensively."""
    if isinstance(item, dict):
        return item.get(key, default)
    if hasattr(item, key):
        return getattr(item, key, default)
    if hasattr(item, "model_dump"):
        try:
            data = item.model_dump()
            if isinstance(data, dict):
                return data.get(key, default)
        except Exception:
            pass
    return default


def _extract_batch_inputs(args: tuple[Any, ...], kwargs: dict[str, Any]) -> tuple[list[Any], Any]:
    """
    Compatibility layer for the v2.2 pipeline.

    Supports common call styles such as:
      verify_claims_batch(candidates, multimedia=multimedia)
      verify_claims_batch(multimedia, candidates)
      verify_claims_batch(candidates=..., multimedia=...)
      verify_claims_batch(items=..., multimedia=...)
    """
    multimedia = kwargs.get("multimedia")

    candidates = None
    for key in (
        "candidates",
        "verification_candidates",
        "items",
        "batch",
        "claim_items",
        "claim_results",
    ):
        value = kwargs.get(key)
        if isinstance(value, list):
            candidates = value
            break

    # Positional compatibility: locate the first list-like batch.
    if candidates is None:
        for arg in args:
            if isinstance(arg, list):
                candidates = arg
                break

    # If multimedia wasn't passed by name, use the first non-list positional value.
    if multimedia is None:
        for arg in args:
            if not isinstance(arg, list):
                multimedia = arg
                break

    # Alternate call style: separate claims/evidence/reasoning arrays.
    if candidates is None and isinstance(kwargs.get("claims"), list):
        claims = kwargs.get("claims") or []
        evidences = (
            kwargs.get("evidence")
            or kwargs.get("evidences")
            or kwargs.get("evidence_list")
            or kwargs.get("evidence_by_claim")
            or []
        )
        reasonings = (
            kwargs.get("reasoning_support")
            or kwargs.get("reasoning_supports")
            or kwargs.get("reasoning_list")
            or kwargs.get("reasoning_by_claim")
            or []
        )
        candidates = []
        for idx, claim in enumerate(claims):
            ev = evidences[idx] if isinstance(evidences, list) and idx < len(evidences) else []
            rs = reasonings[idx] if isinstance(reasonings, list) and idx < len(reasonings) else {}
            candidates.append({
                "claim": claim,
                "evidence": ev,
                "reasoning_support": rs,
            })

    return list(candidates or []), multimedia


async def verify_claims_batch(
    *args: Any,
    **kwargs: Any,
) -> dict[str, VerificationResultV23]:
    """
    Batch Multi-VLM verifier tương thích pipeline v2.2.

    Trả về:
        {
            "claim_01": VerificationResultV23(...),
            "claim_02": VerificationResultV23(...),
            ...
        }

    Technical/provider failure:
        status = UNAVAILABLE
        verdict = None
    """
    candidates, multimedia = _extract_batch_inputs(args, kwargs)

    results: dict[str, VerificationResultV23] = {}

    for index, item in enumerate(candidates, start=1):
        claim = _candidate_value(item, "claim")
        evidence = _candidate_value(item, "evidence", []) or []
        reasoning_support = (
            _candidate_value(item, "reasoning_support", {})
            or {}
        )

        # Hỗ trợ tuple/list:
        # (claim, evidence, reasoning_support[, multimedia])
        if claim is None and isinstance(item, (tuple, list)):
            if len(item) >= 1:
                claim = item[0]

            if len(item) >= 2:
                evidence = item[1] or []

            if len(item) >= 3:
                reasoning_support = item[2] or {}

            if multimedia is None and len(item) >= 4:
                multimedia = item[3]

        # ----------------------------------------------------
        # XÁC ĐỊNH CLAIM ID
        # ----------------------------------------------------
        claim_id = ""

        if claim is not None:
            claim_id = str(
                _candidate_value(
                    claim,
                    "id",
                    "",
                )
                or ""
            ).strip()

        # Một số batch candidate có claim_id trực tiếp
        if not claim_id:
            claim_id = str(
                _candidate_value(
                    item,
                    "claim_id",
                    "",
                )
                or ""
            ).strip()

        # Fallback cuối cùng
        if not claim_id:
            claim_id = f"claim_{index:02d}"

        # ----------------------------------------------------
        # INVALID CANDIDATE
        # ----------------------------------------------------
        if claim is None:
            results[claim_id] = VerificationResultV23(
                status="UNAVAILABLE",
                verdict=None,
                confidence=None,
                rationale=(
                    "Không thể xác minh vì batch candidate thiếu claim."
                ),
                uncertainty="INVALID_BATCH_CANDIDATE",
                limitations=[
                    "Missing claim in verification batch candidate."
                ],
                multimodal_used=False,
                model="",
                provider=None,
            )
            continue

        # ----------------------------------------------------
        # VERIFY
        # ----------------------------------------------------
        result = await verify_claim(
            claim=claim,
            multimedia=multimedia,
            evidence=(
                list(evidence)
                if isinstance(evidence, (list, tuple))
                else []
            ),
            reasoning_support=reasoning_support,
        )

        results[claim_id] = result

    return results

// END ------------------------------

// FILE: backend\fact_checking\verification\vlm_verifier.py
// START ------------------------------
from __future__ import annotations

import json
from io import BytesIO

try:
    from google import genai
    from google.genai import types
except ImportError:  # Allows offline/unit-test imports.
    genai = None
    types = None

from config import (
    GEMINI_ANALYST_MODEL,
    GEMINI_API_KEY,
    VERIFICATION_BATCH_EVIDENCE_CHARS,
    VERIFICATION_BATCH_MAX_IMAGES_TOTAL,
    VERIFICATION_MAX_EVIDENCE_CHARS,
    VERIFICATION_MAX_IMAGES,
)
from core.gemini_utils import generate_content_with_retry
from fact_checking.evidence.evidence_schema import EvidenceItem
from fact_checking.evidence.image_retriever import load_remote_image
from fact_checking.schemas import CandidateClaim, MultimediaAnalysis


_client = genai.Client(api_key=GEMINI_API_KEY) if (genai is not None and GEMINI_API_KEY) else None


def _extract_json(text: str) -> dict:
    if not text:
        return {}
    try:
        return json.loads(text)
    except Exception:
        pass
    start = text.find("{")
    end = text.rfind("}")
    if start >= 0 and end > start:
        try:
            return json.loads(text[start:end + 1])
        except Exception:
            pass
    return {}


def _response_text(response) -> str:
    text = getattr(response, "text", None)
    if text:
        return text
    chunks = []
    for candidate in getattr(response, "candidates", None) or []:
        content = getattr(candidate, "content", None)
        for part in getattr(content, "parts", None) or []:
            value = getattr(part, "text", None)
            if value:
                chunks.append(value)
    return "".join(chunks)


def _multimedia_context(claim: CandidateClaim, multimedia: MultimediaAnalysis) -> dict:
    return {
        "phase2_status": multimedia.status,
        "claim_source_modality": claim.source_modality,
        "claim_timestamp": claim.timestamp,
        "claim_type": claim.claim_type,
        "visual_observations": [
            item.model_dump() for item in multimedia.visual_observations[:20]
        ],
        "speech_segments": [
            item.model_dump() for item in multimedia.speech_segments[:30]
        ],
        "ocr_segments": [
            item.model_dump() for item in multimedia.ocr_segments[:30]
        ],
        "caption": multimedia.caption,
        "cross_modal_notes": multimedia.cross_modal_notes[:15],
    }


def _evidence_payload(evidence: list[EvidenceItem]) -> list[dict]:
    rows = []
    for item in evidence:
        rows.append(
            {
                "id": item.id,
                "modality": item.modality,
                "title": item.title,
                "source_url": item.source_url,
                "source_domain": item.source_domain,
                "provider": item.provider,
                "source_quality": item.source_quality,
                "content": item.content[:VERIFICATION_MAX_EVIDENCE_CHARS],
                "retrieval_score": round(float(item.retrieval_score), 4),
                "rerank_score": (
                    round(float(item.rerank_score), 4)
                    if item.rerank_score is not None
                    else None
                ),
                "relevance_score": round(float(item.relevance_score), 4),
            }
        )
    return rows


def _image_part(item: EvidenceItem):
    if item.modality != "image" or not item.media_url:
        return None
    image = load_remote_image(item.media_url)
    if image is None:
        return None
    buffer = BytesIO()
    image.save(buffer, format="JPEG", quality=90)
    return types.Part.from_bytes(data=buffer.getvalue(), mime_type="image/jpeg")


def _build_prompt(
    claim: CandidateClaim,
    multimedia: MultimediaAnalysis,
    evidence: list[EvidenceItem],
    reasoning_support: dict,
) -> str:
    return f"""
# VAI TRÒ
Bạn là module Multimodal Claim Verification trong hệ thống kiểm chứng thông tin dựa trên bằng chứng.

# CLAIM
{claim.text}

# NGỮ CẢNH MULTIMEDIA GỐC TỪ TIKTOK
{json.dumps(_multimedia_context(claim, multimedia), ensure_ascii=False)}

# RETRIEVED EVIDENCE
{json.dumps(_evidence_payload(evidence), ensure_ascii=False)}

# CONCEPTUAL REASONING SUPPORT
Key concepts:
{json.dumps(reasoning_support.get('key_concepts') or [], ensure_ascii=False)}

Reasoning-support text:
{str(reasoning_support.get('reasoning_support') or '').strip() or '(không có)'}

Semantic-consistency diagnostic:
{json.dumps(reasoning_support.get('semantic_consistency') or {}, ensure_ascii=False)}

# NHÃN
Chọn đúng một nhãn:
- SUPPORTED: evidence đủ và trực tiếp hỗ trợ nội dung cốt lõi của claim.
- REFUTED: evidence đủ và trực tiếp mâu thuẫn/bác bỏ nội dung cốt lõi của claim.
- NEI: evidence không đủ, gián tiếp, xung đột, hoặc chưa xác minh được chi tiết cốt lõi.

# QUY TẮC BẮT BUỘC
- Chỉ dùng evidence được cung cấp. Không dùng kiến thức nền bên ngoài.
- Ngữ cảnh TikTok cho biết claim được thể hiện như thế nào; nó không tự động chứng minh claim đúng.
- Không coi comment/social reaction là authoritative evidence.
- Chỉ dẫn evidence bằng ID có trong RETRIEVED EVIDENCE.
- SUPPORTED/REFUTED phải có ít nhất một evidence_id hợp lệ và assessment stance tương ứng.
- relevance_score chỉ là điểm liên quan retrieval, không phải xác suất claim đúng.
- Nếu text/image evidence mâu thuẫn, nêu rõ trong uncertainty.
- Không viết chain-of-thought nội bộ; chỉ viết rationale ngắn, kiểm tra được và bám evidence.

# OUTPUT
Trả duy nhất JSON hợp lệ:
{{
  "verdict": "SUPPORTED | REFUTED | NEI",
  "confidence": 0.0,
  "evidence_ids": ["text_...", "image_..."],
  "evidence_assessments": [
    {{
      "evidence_id": "text_...",
      "stance": "support | refute | neutral",
      "confidence": 0.0,
      "rationale": "giải thích ngắn dựa trên evidence"
    }}
  ],
  "rationale": "giải thích ngắn cho verdict, nêu evidence ID",
  "uncertainty": "điểm chưa đủ hoặc mâu thuẫn",
  "limitations": ["..."],
  "multimodal_used": true
}}
""".strip()


def verify_with_vlm_sync(
    claim: CandidateClaim,
    multimedia: MultimediaAnalysis,
    evidence: list[EvidenceItem],
    reasoning_support: dict,
) -> dict:
    if _client is None or types is None:
        raise RuntimeError("Gemini client is unavailable")

    contents: list = [
        _build_prompt(
            claim=claim,
            multimedia=multimedia,
            evidence=evidence,
            reasoning_support=reasoning_support,
        )
    ]

    image_count = 0
    for item in evidence:
        if image_count >= VERIFICATION_MAX_IMAGES:
            break
        if item.modality != "image" or not item.media_url:
            continue
        try:
            image_part = _image_part(item)
        except Exception:
            image_part = None
        if image_part is None:
            continue

        contents.append(
            f"IMAGE_EVIDENCE_ID={item.id}; TITLE={item.title}; SOURCE={item.source_domain}"
        )
        contents.append(image_part)
        image_count += 1

    response, model_used = generate_content_with_retry(
        _client,
        model=GEMINI_ANALYST_MODEL,
        contents=contents,
        config=types.GenerateContentConfig(response_mime_type="application/json"),
    )

    data = _extract_json(_response_text(response))
    if not data:
        raise RuntimeError("Verifier returned invalid JSON")

    data["_attached_image_count"] = image_count
    data["_model"] = str(model_used or GEMINI_ANALYST_MODEL)
    return data



def _batch_claim_payload(claim, evidence: list[EvidenceItem], reasoning_support: dict) -> dict:
    return {
        "claim_id": claim.id,
        "claim": claim.text,
        "claim_type": claim.claim_type,
        "source_modality": claim.source_modality,
        "evidence": [
            {
                "id": item.id,
                "modality": item.modality,
                "title": item.title,
                "source_domain": item.source_domain,
                "source_quality": item.source_quality,
                "content": item.content[:VERIFICATION_BATCH_EVIDENCE_CHARS],
                "relevance_score": round(float(item.relevance_score), 4),
                "temporal_relation": item.metadata.get("temporal_relation"),
                "temporal_score": item.metadata.get("temporal_score"),
            }
            for item in evidence
        ],
        "key_concepts": reasoning_support.get("key_concepts") or [],
        "reasoning_support": str(reasoning_support.get("reasoning_support") or "")[:2500],
    }


def verify_batch_with_vlm_sync(
    jobs: list[tuple[CandidateClaim, list[EvidenceItem], dict]],
    multimedia: MultimediaAnalysis,
) -> dict[str, dict]:
    """Verify multiple claims in one Gemini request to reduce quota pressure."""
    if _client is None or types is None:
        raise RuntimeError("Gemini client is unavailable")
    if not jobs:
        return {}

    payload = [
        _batch_claim_payload(claim, evidence, reasoning_support)
        for claim, evidence, reasoning_support in jobs
    ]

    multimedia_summary = {
        "phase2_status": multimedia.status,
        "caption": multimedia.caption,
        "upload_date": (multimedia.metadata or {}).get("upload_date"),
        "cross_modal_notes": multimedia.cross_modal_notes[:10],
    }

    prompt = f"""
# VAI TRÒ
Bạn là module batch Multimodal Claim Verification trong hệ thống fact-checking dựa trên evidence.

# NGỮ CẢNH TIKTOK
{json.dumps(multimedia_summary, ensure_ascii=False)}

# CLAIM JOBS
{json.dumps(payload, ensure_ascii=False)}

# NHÃN
SUPPORTED / REFUTED / NEI.

# QUY TẮC
- Xử lý từng claim_id độc lập.
- Chỉ dùng evidence nằm trong job tương ứng; không dùng kiến thức nền ngoài evidence.
- TikTok context mô tả claim, không tự chứng minh claim đúng.
- SUPPORTED/REFUTED phải cite evidence ID hợp lệ của chính claim đó và stance phải khớp.
- Chú ý temporal_relation/temporal_score với claim phụ thuộc thời điểm.
- Nếu evidence xung đột hoặc không đủ, chọn NEI.
- Không viết chain-of-thought; rationale ngắn và kiểm tra được.

# OUTPUT
Trả duy nhất JSON:
{{
  "results": [
    {{
      "claim_id": "claim_01",
      "verdict": "SUPPORTED | REFUTED | NEI",
      "confidence": 0.0,
      "evidence_ids": ["text_...", "image_..."],
      "evidence_assessments": [
        {{"evidence_id":"text_...","stance":"support | refute | neutral","confidence":0.0,"rationale":"..."}}
      ],
      "rationale": "...",
      "uncertainty": "...",
      "limitations": ["..."],
      "multimodal_used": true
    }}
  ]
}}
""".strip()

    contents: list = [prompt]
    attached_counts: dict[str, int] = {claim.id: 0 for claim, _, _ in jobs}
    total_images = 0
    for claim, evidence, _ in jobs:
        for item in evidence:
            if total_images >= VERIFICATION_BATCH_MAX_IMAGES_TOTAL:
                break
            if item.modality != "image" or not item.media_url:
                continue
            try:
                image_part = _image_part(item)
            except Exception:
                image_part = None
            if image_part is None:
                continue
            contents.append(
                f"CLAIM_ID={claim.id}; IMAGE_EVIDENCE_ID={item.id}; "
                f"TITLE={item.title}; SOURCE={item.source_domain}"
            )
            contents.append(image_part)
            attached_counts[claim.id] += 1
            total_images += 1

    response, model_used = generate_content_with_retry(
        _client,
        model=GEMINI_ANALYST_MODEL,
        contents=contents,
        config=types.GenerateContentConfig(response_mime_type="application/json"),
    )
    data = _extract_json(_response_text(response))
    if not data or not isinstance(data.get("results"), list):
        raise RuntimeError("Batch verifier returned invalid JSON")

    out: dict[str, dict] = {}
    for row in data["results"]:
        if not isinstance(row, dict):
            continue
        claim_id = str(row.get("claim_id") or "").strip()
        if claim_id not in attached_counts:
            continue
        normalized = dict(row)
        normalized["_attached_image_count"] = attached_counts[claim_id]
        normalized["_model"] = str(model_used or GEMINI_ANALYST_MODEL)
        out[claim_id] = normalized
    return out

// END ------------------------------

"""Offline configuration/dependency checks for the thesis fact-check pipeline."""
from __future__ import annotations

import importlib.util

from config import (
    BRAVE_SEARCH_API_KEY,
    EVIDENCE_SEARCH_PROVIDER,
    GEMINI_API_KEY,
    IMAGE_RETRIEVAL_MODEL,
    TEXT_RETRIEVAL_MODEL,
)


def _module(name: str) -> bool:
    return importlib.util.find_spec(name) is not None


def main() -> None:
    rows = {
        "gemini_api_key_configured": bool(GEMINI_API_KEY),
        "brave_api_key_configured": bool(BRAVE_SEARCH_API_KEY),
        "search_provider": EVIDENCE_SEARCH_PROVIDER,
        "google_genai_installed": _module("google.genai"),
        "transformers_installed": _module("transformers"),
        "torch_installed": _module("torch"),
        "yt_dlp_installed": _module("yt_dlp"),
        "beautifulsoup4_installed": _module("bs4"),
        "pillow_installed": _module("PIL"),
        "text_retrieval_model": TEXT_RETRIEVAL_MODEL,
        "image_retrieval_model": IMAGE_RETRIEVAL_MODEL,
    }

    print("=== Fact-check Thesis Environment Doctor ===")
    for key, value in rows.items():
        print(f"{key}: {value}")

    if not rows["gemini_api_key_configured"]:
        print("WARN: GEMINI_API_KEY missing -> Phase 2/4 will be unavailable/degraded.")
    if EVIDENCE_SEARCH_PROVIDER in {"brave", "brave_then_gemini"} and not rows["brave_api_key_configured"]:
        print("WARN: BRAVE_SEARCH_API_KEY missing -> image retrieval unavailable and web retrieval may rely on Gemini fallback.")


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

    AutoModelForSequenceClassification,

BACKEND_DIR = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]

VNCORENLP_DIR = (
    BACKEND_DIR
    / "assets"
    / "vncorenlp"
)

# Default deploy = V2.
#
# Rollback without deleting any model:
#   PowerShell:
#       $env:ABSA_RUNTIME_VERSION="v1"
#       uvicorn main:app --reload
#
# Restore V2:
#       $env:ABSA_RUNTIME_VERSION="v2"
#

        "ABSA_RUNTIME_VERSION",
        "v2",
    )
    .strip()

)

if ABSA_RUNTIME_VERSION not in {

    raise ValueError(
        "ABSA_RUNTIME_VERSION chỉ hỗ trợ "
        "'v1' hoặc 'v2'."
    )

    if ABSA_RUNTIME_VERSION == "v2"
    else "ate_phobert_v1"
