        Pending:
        <strong>
        ${data.pending}
        </strong>
        </div>

        <div class="stat">
        Done:
        <strong>
        ${data.done}
        </strong>
        </div>

        <div class="stat">
        Review:
        <strong>
        ${data.review}
        </strong>
        </div>

        <div class="stat">
        Has Aspect:
        <strong>
        ${data.has_aspect}
        </strong>
        </div>

        <div class="stat">
        No Aspect:
        <strong>
        ${data.no_aspect}
        </strong>
        </div>
    `;
}


// ============================================================
// FILTER
// ============================================================

async function setFilter(
    filterName,
    button
) {

    currentFilter =
        filterName;

    document
        .querySelectorAll(
            ".filter-button"
        )
        .forEach(
            b =>
                b.classList.remove(
                    "active"
                )
        );

    if (button) {
        button.classList.add(
            "active"
        );
    }

    const response =
        await fetch(
            `/api/list?filter=${filterName}`
        );

    const data =
        await response.json();

    filteredItems =
        data.items || [];

    filteredPosition = 0;

    if (
        filteredItems.length === 0
    ) {

        current = null;

        document.getElementById(
            "comment"
        ).innerText =
            "Không có comment trong filter này.";

        return;
    }

    await loadFilteredPosition(
        0
    );
}


// ============================================================
// LOAD
// ============================================================

async function loadFilteredPosition(
    position
) {

    if (
        position < 0
        ||
        position >=
            filteredItems.length
    ) {
        return;
    }

    filteredPosition =
        position;

    const item =
        filteredItems[
            position
        ];

    const response =
        await fetch(
            `/api/comment/${item.index}`
        );

    const data =
        await response.json();

    loadData(
        data
    );
}


function loadData(data) {

    current =
        data;

    aspects =
        data.aspects || [];

    selection =
        null;

    document.getElementById(
        "comment"
    ).innerText =
        data.text;

    document.getElementById(
        "selectedText"
    ).innerText =
        "Chưa chọn";

    document.getElementById(
        "commentMeta"
    ).innerText =
        `Dataset index: ${
            data.index + 1
        } / ${data.total}
        | Filter:
        ${
            filteredPosition + 1
        } / ${
            filteredItems.length
        }`;

    const status =
        data.annotation_status
        || "pending";

    const statusElement =
        document.getElementById(
            "annotationStatus"
        );

    statusElement.innerText =
        `Status: ${
            status.toUpperCase()
        }`;

    statusElement.className =
        "status-line";

    if (
        status === "done"
    ) {

        statusElement.classList.add(
            "done-text"
        );

    } else if (
        status === "review"
    ) {

        statusElement.classList.add(
            "review-text"
        );

    } else {

        statusElement.classList.add(
            "pending-text"
        );
    }

    renderAspects();
}


// ============================================================
// TEXT SELECTION
// ============================================================

document.addEventListener(
    "mouseup",
    function() {

        if (!current)
            return;

        const element =
            document.getElementById(
                "comment"
            );

        const sel =
            window.getSelection();

        if (
            !sel
            ||
            sel.rangeCount === 0
        )
            return;

        const selected =
            sel.toString();

        if (
            !selected.trim()
        )
            return;

        if (
            !element.contains(
                sel.anchorNode
            )
        )
            return;

        const range =
            sel.getRangeAt(0);

        const preRange =
            range.cloneRange();

        preRange.selectNodeContents(
            element
        );

        preRange.setEnd(
            range.startContainer,
            range.startOffset
        );

        const start =
            preRange
            .toString()
            .length;

        const end =
            start
            + selected.length;

        selection = {

            term:
                selected,

            start:
                start,

            end:
                end
        };

        document.getElementById(
            "selectedText"
        ).innerText =
            selected;
    }
);


// ============================================================
// ASPECT
// ============================================================

function addAspect(
    polarity
) {

    if (!selection) {

        alert(
            "Hãy bôi đen aspect trước."
        );

        return;
    }

    aspects.push({

        term:
            selection.term,

        start:
            selection.start,

        end:
            selection.end,

        polarity:
            polarity
    });

    selection =
        null;

    document.getElementById(
        "selectedText"
    ).innerText =
        "Chưa chọn";

    renderAspects();
}


function removeAspect(
    index
) {

    aspects.splice(
        index,
        1
    );

    renderAspects();
}


function cyclePolarity(
    index
) {

    const order = [
        "POSITIVE",
        "NEUTRAL",
        "NEGATIVE"
    ];

    const currentPolarity =
        aspects[index]
        .polarity;

    const currentIndex =
        order.indexOf(
            currentPolarity
        );

    aspects[index]
        .polarity =
        order[
            (
                currentIndex + 1
            )
            %
            order.length
        ];

    renderAspects();
}


function renderAspects() {

    const container =
        document.getElementById(
            "aspects"
        );

    container.innerHTML =
        "";

    aspects.forEach(
        (
            aspect,
            index
        ) => {

            const div =
                document.createElement(
                    "div"
                );

            const polarity =
                aspect.polarity
                .toLowerCase();

            div.className =
                `aspect-item
                 aspect-${polarity}`;

            div.innerHTML = `

                <div>

                    <strong>
                    ${aspect.term}
                    </strong>

                    →

                    ${aspect.polarity}

                    <small>
                    [${aspect.start},
                    ${aspect.end}]
                    </small>

                </div>

                <div>

                    <button
                    onclick="
                    cyclePolarity(
                        ${index}
                    )
                    ">
                    Change
                    </button>

                    <button
                    onclick="
                    removeAspect(
                        ${index}
                    )
                    ">
                    X
                    </button>

                </div>
            `;

            container.appendChild(
                div
            );
        }
    );
}


// ============================================================
// SAVE
// ============================================================

async function save(
    hasAspect,
    status
) {

    if (!current)
        return false;

    const payload = {

        comment_id:
            String(
                current.comment_id
            ),

        has_aspect:
            hasAspect,

        aspects:
            hasAspect
                ? aspects
                : [],

        annotation_status:
            status
    };

    const response =
        await fetch(
            "/api/save",
            {

                method:
                    "POST",

                headers: {
                    "Content-Type":
                        "application/json"
                },

                body:
                    JSON.stringify(
                        payload
                    )
            }
        );

    if (!response.ok) {

        const error =
            await response.json();

        alert(
            JSON.stringify(
                error
            )
        );

        return false;
    }

    await refreshStats();

    return true;
}


async function saveDone() {

    if (
        aspects.length === 0
    ) {

        alert(
            "Không có aspect. "
            + "Nếu thật sự không có target "
            + "hãy chọn No Aspect."
        );

        return;
    }

    const success =
        await save(
            true,
            "done"
        );

    if (success) {
        await reloadFilterAfterSave();
    }
}


async function saveNoAspect() {

    aspects = [];

    const success =
        await save(
            false,
            "done"
        );

    if (success) {
        await reloadFilterAfterSave();
    }
}


async function saveReview() {

    const success =
        await save(
            aspects.length > 0,
            "review"
        );

    if (success) {
        await reloadFilterAfterSave();
    }
}


async function reloadFilterAfterSave() {

    const previousPosition =
        filteredPosition;

    const response =
        await fetch(
            `/api/list?filter=${
                currentFilter
            }`
        );

    const data =
        await response.json();

    filteredItems =
        data.items || [];

    if (
        filteredItems.length === 0
    ) {

        document.getElementById(
            "comment"
        ).innerText =
            "Đã xử lý hết filter này.";

        current = null;

        return;
    }

    let newPosition =
        previousPosition;

    if (
        newPosition >=
        filteredItems.length
    ) {

        newPosition =
            filteredItems.length
            - 1;
    }

    await loadFilteredPosition(
        newPosition
    );
}


// ============================================================
// NAVIGATION
// ============================================================

function previousFiltered() {

    if (
        filteredPosition > 0
    ) {

        loadFilteredPosition(
            filteredPosition - 1
        );
    }
}


function nextFiltered() {

    if (
        filteredPosition
        <
        filteredItems.length - 1
    ) {

        loadFilteredPosition(
            filteredPosition + 1
        );
    }
}


// ============================================================
// START
// ============================================================

async function start() {

    await refreshStats();

    const allButton =
        document.querySelector(
            ".filter-button"
        );

    await setFilter(
        "all",
        allButton
    );
}

start();

</script>

</body>

</html>
"""
// END ------------------------------

// FILE: backend\train\absa\collect_raw.py

import json
import sys
import time
from pathlib import Path


# ============================================================
# PATHS
# ============================================================

BACKEND_DIR = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[2]

if str(BACKEND_DIR) not in sys.path:
    sys.path.insert(0, str(BACKEND_DIR))


from core.crawler import get_all_comments


CURRENT_DIR = Path(__file__).resolve().parent

URL_FILE = CURRENT_DIR / "video_urls.txt"

OUTPUT_DIR = BACKEND_DIR / "data" / "absa" / "raw"
OUTPUT_FILE = OUTPUT_DIR / "raw_comments.jsonl"


# ============================================================
# CONFIG
# ============================================================

COMMENTS_PER_VIDEO = 200

SLEEP_BETWEEN_VIDEOS = 2


# ============================================================
# LOAD URLS
# ============================================================

def load_urls():
    if not URL_FILE.exists():
        raise FileNotFoundError(
            f"Không tìm thấy file: {URL_FILE}"
        )

    urls = []

    with open(URL_FILE, "r", encoding="utf-8") as f:
        for line in f:
            url = line.strip()

            if not url:
                continue

            if url.startswith("#"):
                continue

            urls.append(url)

    return urls


# ============================================================
# LOAD EXISTING IDS
# ============================================================

def load_existing_comment_ids():
    ids = set()

    if not OUTPUT_FILE.exists():
        return ids

    with open(OUTPUT_FILE, "r", encoding="utf-8") as f:
        for line in f:
            line = line.strip()

            if not line:
                continue

            try:
                row = json.loads(line)

                comment_id = str(
                    row.get("comment_id") or ""
                )

                if comment_id:
                    ids.add(comment_id)

            except json.JSONDecodeError:
                continue

    return ids


# ============================================================
# SAVE COMMENT
# ============================================================

def build_dataset_row(
    comment,
    video_id,
    video_url,
):
    """
    Chỉ lưu dữ liệu cần thiết cho nghiên cứu ABSA.

    Không đưa thông tin cá nhân của tác giả comment
    vào dataset train.
    """

    return {
        "comment_id": comment.get("comment_id"),
        "video_id": video_id,
        "video_url": video_url,

        "text": comment.get("text", ""),

        "created_at": comment.get("created_at"),
        "created_at_iso": comment.get("created_at_iso"),

        "like_count": comment.get(
            "like_count",
            0
        ),

        "reply_count": comment.get(
            "reply_count",
            0
        ),
    }


# ============================================================
# MAIN
# ============================================================

def main():

    OUTPUT_DIR.mkdir(
        parents=True,
        exist_ok=True
    )

    urls = load_urls()

    existing_ids = load_existing_comment_ids()

    print("=" * 60)
    print("ABSA RAW DATA COLLECTOR")
    print("=" * 60)

    print(f"Videos: {len(urls)}")
    print(
        f"Existing comments: "
        f"{len(existing_ids)}"
    )

    total_new = 0

    with open(
        OUTPUT_FILE,
        "a",
        encoding="utf-8"
    ) as output:

        for index, url in enumerate(
            urls,
            start=1
        ):

            print()
            print(
                f"[{index}/{len(urls)}]"
            )
            print(url)

            comments, video_id = (
                get_all_comments(
                    url,
                    max_comments=COMMENTS_PER_VIDEO
                )
            )

            if not comments:
                print(
                    "[!] Không lấy được comment"
                )
                continue

            added = 0

            for comment in comments:

                comment_id = str(
                    comment.get(
                        "comment_id"
                    )
                    or ""
                )

                # --------------------------------------------
                # DUPLICATE CHECK
                # --------------------------------------------

                if (
                    comment_id
                    and comment_id
                    in existing_ids
                ):
                    continue

                text = str(
                    comment.get("text")
                    or ""
                ).strip()

                if len(text) < 2:
                    continue

                row = build_dataset_row(
                    comment=comment,
                    video_id=video_id,
                    video_url=url,
                )

                output.write(
                    json.dumps(
                        row,
                        ensure_ascii=False
                    )
                    + "\n"
                )

                if comment_id:
                    existing_ids.add(
                        comment_id
                    )

                added += 1
                total_new += 1

            output.flush()

            print(
                f"[+] Added: {added}"
            )

            print(
                f"[+] Dataset total: "
                f"{len(existing_ids)}"
            )

            time.sleep(
                SLEEP_BETWEEN_VIDEOS
            )

    print()
    print("=" * 60)

    print(
        f"New comments: {total_new}"
    )

    print(
        f"Saved to: {OUTPUT_FILE}"
    )

    print("=" * 60)


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

// FILE: backend\train\absa\compare_absa_v1_v2.py

import json

from config_ate_v2 import BACKEND_DIR


V1_FILE = BACKEND_DIR / "evaluation_outputs" / "absa_v1" / "metrics.json"
V2_FILE = BACKEND_DIR / "evaluation_outputs" / "absa_v2_end_to_end_frozen" / "metrics.json"
OUT_FILE = BACKEND_DIR / "evaluation_outputs" / "absa_v1_vs_v2.md"


def load_json(path):
    with open(path, "r", encoding="utf-8") as f:
        return json.load(f)


def pct(x):
    return f"{x * 100:.2f}%"


def pp(v1, v2):
    return f"{(v2 - v1) * 100:+.2f} pp"


def main():
    v1 = load_json(V1_FILE)
    v2 = load_json(V2_FILE)

    a1 = v1["ate_exact_char_span"]
    a2 = v2["ate_exact_char_span"]

    s1 = v1["asc_oracle_gold_aspect"]
    s2 = v2["asc_oracle_gold_aspect"]

    e1 = v1["end_to_end_exact_span_sentiment"]
    e2 = v2["end_to_end_exact_span_sentiment"]

    lines = [
        "# ABSA V1 vs V2",
        "",
        "## ATE - Exact Character Span",
        "",
        "| Metric | V1 | V2 | Delta |",
        "|---|---:|---:|---:|",
        f"| Precision | {pct(a1['precision'])} | {pct(a2['precision'])} | {pp(a1['precision'], a2['precision'])} |",
        f"| Recall | {pct(a1['recall'])} | {pct(a2['recall'])} | {pp(a1['recall'], a2['recall'])} |",
        f"| F1 | {pct(a1['f1'])} | {pct(a2['f1'])} | {pp(a1['f1'], a2['f1'])} |",
        f"| FP | {a1['fp']} | {a2['fp']} | {a2['fp'] - a1['fp']:+d} |",
        f"| FN | {a1['fn']} | {a2['fn']} | {a2['fn'] - a1['fn']:+d} |",
        "",
        "## ASC - Gold Aspect / Oracle ATE",
        "",
        "| Metric | V1 | V2 | Delta |",
        "|---|---:|---:|---:|",
        f"| Accuracy | {pct(s1['accuracy'])} | {pct(s2['accuracy'])} | {pp(s1['accuracy'], s2['accuracy'])} |",
        f"| Macro-F1 | {pct(s1['macro_f1'])} | {pct(s2['macro_f1'])} | {pp(s1['macro_f1'], s2['macro_f1'])} |",
        f"| NEGATIVE F1 | {pct(s1['per_class']['NEGATIVE']['f1'])} | {pct(s2['per_class']['NEGATIVE']['f1'])} | {pp(s1['per_class']['NEGATIVE']['f1'], s2['per_class']['NEGATIVE']['f1'])} |",
        f"| NEUTRAL F1 | {pct(s1['per_class']['NEUTRAL']['f1'])} | {pct(s2['per_class']['NEUTRAL']['f1'])} | {pp(s1['per_class']['NEUTRAL']['f1'], s2['per_class']['NEUTRAL']['f1'])} |",
        f"| POSITIVE F1 | {pct(s1['per_class']['POSITIVE']['f1'])} | {pct(s2['per_class']['POSITIVE']['f1'])} | {pp(s1['per_class']['POSITIVE']['f1'], s2['per_class']['POSITIVE']['f1'])} |",
        "",
        "## End-to-End ABSA",
        "",
        "Exact match = `(start, end, sentiment)`.",
        "",
        "| Metric | V1 | V2 | Delta |",
        "|---|---:|---:|---:|",
        f"| Precision | {pct(e1['precision'])} | {pct(e2['precision'])} | {pp(e1['precision'], e2['precision'])} |",
        f"| Recall | {pct(e1['recall'])} | {pct(e2['recall'])} | {pp(e1['recall'], e2['recall'])} |",
        f"| F1 | {pct(e1['f1'])} | {pct(e2['f1'])} | {pp(e1['f1'], e2['f1'])} |",
        "",
        "Frozen-test results are for final comparison, not further tuning.",
    ]

    OUT_FILE.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    OUT_FILE.write_text("\n".join(lines), encoding="utf-8")

    print("Saved:", OUT_FILE)


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

import json
import torch
from torch.utils.data import Dataset
from config_asc import LABEL2ID, MAX_LENGTH

class ABSASentimentDataset(Dataset):
    def __init__(self, file_path, tokenizer, max_length=MAX_LENGTH):
        self.tokenizer = tokenizer
        self.max_length = max_length
        with open(file_path, 'r', encoding='utf-8') as f:
            self.samples = json.load(f)

    def __len__(self):
        return len(self.samples)

    def __getitem__(self, index):
        sample = self.samples[index]
        encoded = self.tokenizer(
            sample['text'],
            sample['aspect'],
            truncation='only_first',
            max_length=self.max_length,
            padding='max_length',
            return_attention_mask=True,
        )
        return {
            'input_ids': torch.tensor(encoded['input_ids'], dtype=torch.long),
            'attention_mask': torch.tensor(encoded['attention_mask'], dtype=torch.long),
            'labels': torch.tensor(LABEL2ID[sample['label']], dtype=torch.long),
        }

import json

import torch
from torch.utils.data import Dataset

from config_asc_v2 import (
    LABEL2ID,
    MAX_LENGTH,
)


class ASCV2Dataset(Dataset):
    """
    PhoBERT pair input:

        sequence A = segmented comment
        sequence B = segmented aspect term

    This makes the target explicit when one comment has
    multiple aspects with different sentiments.
    """

    def __init__(
        self,
        path,
        tokenizer,
    ):
        with open(
            path,
            "r",
            encoding="utf-8",
        ) as f:
            self.samples = json.load(
                f
            )

        self.tokenizer = tokenizer

    def __len__(self):
        return len(
            self.samples
        )

    def __getitem__(
        self,
        index,
    ):
        sample = self.samples[
            index
        ]

        encoded = self.tokenizer(
            sample[
                "segmented_text"
            ],

            sample[
                "segmented_aspect"
            ],

            max_length=
                MAX_LENGTH,

            truncation=True,

            padding=
                "max_length",

            return_tensors=
                "pt",
        )

        return {
            "input_ids":
                encoded[
                    "input_ids"
                ][
                    0
                ],

            "attention_mask":
                encoded[
                    "attention_mask"
                ][
                    0
                ],

            "labels":
                torch.tensor(
                    LABEL2ID[
                        sample[
                            "label"
                        ]
                    ],
                    dtype=torch.long,
                ),

            "sample_index":
                torch.tensor(
                    index,
                    dtype=torch.long,
                ),
        }

// FILE: backend\train\absa\dataset_ate.py
// START ------------------------------
import json
import re

import torch

from torch.utils.data import Dataset

from config_ate import (
    LABEL2ID,
    MAX_LENGTH,
)


TOKEN_PATTERN = re.compile(
    r"\w+|[^\w\s]",
    flags=re.UNICODE,
)


def tokenize_text_with_offsets(text):

    tokens = []

    offsets = []

    for match in TOKEN_PATTERN.finditer(text):

        tokens.append(
            match.group()
        )

        offsets.append(
            (
                match.start(),
                match.end(),
            )
        )

    return tokens, offsets


class ABSATokenDataset(Dataset):

    def __init__(
        self,
        file_path,
        tokenizer,
        max_length=MAX_LENGTH,
    ):

        self.tokenizer = tokenizer

        self.max_length = max_length

        with open(
            file_path,
            "r",
            encoding="utf-8",
        ) as f:

            self.samples = json.load(f)

    def __len__(self):

        return len(
            self.samples
        )

    def _encode_words(
        self,
        words,
        bio_labels,
    ):

        token_ids = []

        label_ids = []

        word_ids = []

        for word_index, (
            word,
            label,
        ) in enumerate(
            zip(
                words,
                bio_labels,
            )
        ):

            pieces = (
                self.tokenizer.encode(
                    word,
                    add_special_tokens=False,
                )
            )

            if not pieces:

                pieces = [
                    self.tokenizer.unk_token_id
                ]

            original_label_id = (
                LABEL2ID[label]
            )

            for piece_index, piece_id in enumerate(
                pieces
            ):

                token_ids.append(
                    piece_id
                )

                word_ids.append(
                    word_index
                )

                if piece_index == 0:

                    label_ids.append(
                        original_label_id
                    )

                else:

                    # B-ASP tiếp tục thành I-ASP
                    if label == "B-ASP":

                        label_ids.append(
                            LABEL2ID["I-ASP"]
                        )

                    else:

                        label_ids.append(
                            original_label_id
                        )

        return (
            token_ids,
            label_ids,
            word_ids,
        )

    def __getitem__(
        self,
        index,
    ):

        sample = self.samples[
            index
        ]

        words = sample[
            "tokens"
        ]

        labels = sample[
            "bio_labels"
        ]

        (
            content_ids,
            content_labels,
            content_word_ids,
        ) = self._encode_words(
            words,
            labels,
        )

        special_count = (
            self.tokenizer
            .num_special_tokens_to_add(
                pair=False
            )
        )

        max_content_length = (
            self.max_length
            - special_count
        )

        content_ids = (
            content_ids[
                :max_content_length
            ]
        )

        content_labels = (
            content_labels[
                :max_content_length
            ]
        )

        content_word_ids = (
            content_word_ids[
                :max_content_length
            ]
        )

        input_ids = (
            self.tokenizer
            .build_inputs_with_special_tokens(
                content_ids
            )
        )

        special_mask = (
            self.tokenizer
            .get_special_tokens_mask(
                content_ids,
                already_has_special_tokens=False,
            )
        )

        final_labels = []

        final_word_ids = []

        content_position = 0

        for is_special in special_mask:

            if is_special:

                final_labels.append(
                    -100
                )

                final_word_ids.append(
                    -1
                )

            else:

                final_labels.append(
                    content_labels[
                        content_position
                    ]
                )

                final_word_ids.append(
                    content_word_ids[
                        content_position
                    ]
                )

                content_position += 1

        attention_mask = [
            1
            for _ in input_ids
        ]

        padding_length = (
            self.max_length
            - len(input_ids)
        )

        if padding_length > 0:

            input_ids += [
                self.tokenizer.pad_token_id
            ] * padding_length

            attention_mask += [
                0
            ] * padding_length

            final_labels += [
                -100
            ] * padding_length

            final_word_ids += [
                -1
            ] * padding_length

        return {
            "input_ids":
                torch.tensor(
                    input_ids,
                    dtype=torch.long,
                ),

            "attention_mask":
                torch.tensor(
                    attention_mask,
                    dtype=torch.long,
                ),

            "labels":
                torch.tensor(
                    final_labels,
                    dtype=torch.long,
                ),

            "word_ids":
                torch.tensor(
                    final_word_ids,
                    dtype=torch.long,
                ),
        }
// END ------------------------------

// FILE: backend\train\absa\dataset_ate_v2.py
// START ------------------------------
import json

import torch
from torch.utils.data import Dataset

from config_ate_v2 import (
    LABEL2ID,
    MAX_LENGTH,
)


class ATEV2Dataset(Dataset):
    """
    VnCoreNLP word-level supervision -> PhoBERT BPE pieces.

    Important:
    - each `word_form` is already Vietnamese word-segmented
      (e.g. "màn_hình", "điện_thoại")
    - we encode each segmented word with PhoBERT BPE
    - first BPE piece inherits the word BIO label
    - subsequent pieces:
        B-ASP -> I-ASP
        I-ASP -> I-ASP
        O     -> O
    """

    def __init__(
        self,
        path,
        tokenizer,
    ):
        with open(
            path,
            "r",
            encoding="utf-8",
        ) as f:
            self.samples = json.load(
                f
            )

        self.tokenizer = tokenizer

        self.pad_id = (
            tokenizer.pad_token_id
            if tokenizer.pad_token_id
            is not None
            else 1
        )

    def __len__(self):
        return len(
            self.samples
        )

    def _encode_word(
        self,
        word_form,
    ):
        ids = self.tokenizer.encode(
            word_form,
            add_special_tokens=False,
        )

        if not ids:
            ids = [
                self.tokenizer.unk_token_id
            ]

        return ids

    def __getitem__(
        self,
        index,
    ):
        sample = self.samples[
            index
        ]

        segments = sample[
            "segments"
        ]

        segment_labels = sample[
            "segment_labels"
        ]

        segment_ignore = sample[
            "segment_ignore"
        ]

        token_ids = []

        labels = []

        segment_ids = []

        for (
            segment_index,
            (
                segment,
                label,
                ignored,
            ),
        ) in enumerate(
            zip(
                segments,
                segment_labels,
                segment_ignore,
            )
        ):
            pieces = self._encode_word(
                segment[
                    "word_form"
                ]
            )

            for piece_index, piece_id in enumerate(
                pieces
            ):
                token_ids.append(
                    piece_id
                )

                segment_ids.append(
                    segment_index
                )

                if ignored:
                    labels.append(
                        -100
                    )
                    continue

                current_label = label

                if (
                    piece_index > 0
                    and label == "B-ASP"
                ):
                    current_label = (
                        "I-ASP"
                    )

                labels.append(
                    LABEL2ID[
                        current_label
                    ]
                )

        # Reserve PhoBERT special tokens.
        max_body_length = (
            MAX_LENGTH
            - self.tokenizer.num_special_tokens_to_add(
                pair=False
            )
        )

        token_ids = token_ids[
            :max_body_length
        ]

        labels = labels[
            :max_body_length
        ]

        segment_ids = segment_ids[
            :max_body_length
        ]

        input_ids = (
            self.tokenizer
            .build_inputs_with_special_tokens(
                token_ids
            )
        )

        special_mask = (
            self.tokenizer
            .get_special_tokens_mask(
                token_ids,
                already_has_special_tokens=False,
            )
        )

        final_labels = []
        final_segment_ids = []

        body_cursor = 0

        for is_special in special_mask:
            if is_special:
                final_labels.append(
                    -100
                )

                final_segment_ids.append(
                    -1
                )
            else:
                final_labels.append(
                    labels[
                        body_cursor
                    ]
                )

                final_segment_ids.append(
                    segment_ids[
                        body_cursor
                    ]
                )

                body_cursor += 1

        attention_mask = [
            1
        ] * len(
            input_ids
        )

        pad_length = (
            MAX_LENGTH
            - len(
                input_ids
            )
        )

        if pad_length > 0:
            input_ids.extend(
                [
                    self.pad_id
                ]
                * pad_length
            )

            attention_mask.extend(
                [0]
                * pad_length
            )

            final_labels.extend(
                [-100]
                * pad_length
            )

            final_segment_ids.extend(
                [-1]
                * pad_length
            )

        return {
            "input_ids":
                torch.tensor(
                    input_ids,
                    dtype=torch.long,
                ),

            "attention_mask":
                torch.tensor(
                    attention_mask,
                    dtype=torch.long,
                ),

            "labels":
                torch.tensor(
                    final_labels,
                    dtype=torch.long,
                ),

            "segment_ids":
                torch.tensor(
                    final_segment_ids,
                    dtype=torch.long,
                ),

            "sample_index":
                torch.tensor(
                    index,
                    dtype=torch.long,
                ),
        }

// END ------------------------------

// FILE: backend\train\absa\evaluate_absa_v2_end_to_end.py
// START ------------------------------

import json

from config_ate_v2 import BACKEND_DIR, TEST_SOURCE
from config_asc_v2 import LABEL2ID
from inference_ate_v2 import ATEPhoBERTV2
from inference_asc_v2 import ASCPhoBERTV2
from metrics_ate_v2 import exact_span_metrics
from metrics_asc_v2 import classification_metrics


OUTPUT_DIR = BACKEND_DIR / "evaluation_outputs" / "absa_v2_end_to_end"


def safe_div(a, b):
    return a / b if b else 0.0


def prf(tp, fp, fn):
    p = safe_div(tp, tp + fp)
    r = safe_div(tp, tp + fn)
    f1 = safe_div(2 * p * r, p + r)
    return {
        "precision": p,
        "recall": r,
        "f1": f1,
        "tp": tp,
        "fp": fp,
        "fn": fn,
    }


def load_json(path):
    with open(path, "r", encoding="utf-8") as f:
        return json.load(f)


def norm(label):
    return str(label or "").strip().upper()


def main():
    OUTPUT_DIR.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)

    data = load_json(TEST_SOURCE)
    ate_engine = ATEPhoBERTV2()
    asc_engine = ASCPhoBERTV2()

    ate_gold_all = []
    ate_pred_all = []

    oracle_gold = []
    oracle_pred = []

    matched_gold = []
    matched_pred = []

    e2e_tp = e2e_fp = e2e_fn = 0

    breakdown = {
        "gold_aspects": 0,
        "ate_exact_tp": 0,
        "ate_false_positive": 0,
        "ate_false_negative": 0,
        "matched_span_sentiment_correct": 0,
        "matched_span_sentiment_wrong": 0,
    }

    errors = {
        "ate_false_negatives": [],
        "ate_false_positives": [],
        "matched_span_sentiment_errors": [],
        "end_to_end_errors": [],
    }

    for i, item in enumerate(data, start=1):
        text = str(item.get("text", "") or "")
        gold_aspects = item.get("aspects") or []

        gold_spans = set()
        gold_by_span = {}
        gold_triples = set()

        for aspect in gold_aspects:
            start = int(aspect["start"])
            end = int(aspect["end"])
            sentiment = norm(aspect.get("polarity"))

            span = (start, end)
            gold_spans.add(span)
            gold_by_span[span] = sentiment
            gold_triples.add((start, end, sentiment))

            # ASC Oracle: gold aspect -> ASC V2
            result = asc_engine.predict(text, text[start:end])
            pred_sentiment = norm(result["sentiment"])

            oracle_gold.append(LABEL2ID[sentiment])
            oracle_pred.append(LABEL2ID[pred_sentiment])

        breakdown["gold_aspects"] += len(gold_spans)

        # ATE V2
        ate_result = ate_engine.predict(text)
        predicted_aspects = ate_result["aspects"]

        pred_spans = {
            (int(a["start"]), int(a["end"]))
            for a in predicted_aspects
        }

        ate_gold_all.append(gold_spans)
        ate_pred_all.append(pred_spans)

        tp_spans = gold_spans & pred_spans
        fp_spans = pred_spans - gold_spans
        fn_spans = gold_spans - pred_spans

        breakdown["ate_exact_tp"] += len(tp_spans)
        breakdown["ate_false_positive"] += len(fp_spans)
        breakdown["ate_false_negative"] += len(fn_spans)

        for start, end in sorted(fn_spans):
            errors["ate_false_negatives"].append({
                "comment_id": item.get("comment_id"),
                "text": text,
                "term": text[start:end],
                "start": start,
                "end": end,
                "gold_sentiment": gold_by_span[(start, end)],
            })

        for start, end in sorted(fp_spans):
            errors["ate_false_positives"].append({
                "comment_id": item.get("comment_id"),
                "text": text,
                "term": text[start:end],
                "start": start,
                "end": end,
            })

        # End-to-end: ATE V2 -> ASC V2
        pred_triples = set()
        pred_detail = []

        for predicted_aspect in predicted_aspects:
            start = int(predicted_aspect["start"])
            end = int(predicted_aspect["end"])
            term = text[start:end]

            asc_result = asc_engine.predict(text, term)
            pred_sentiment = norm(asc_result["sentiment"])

            pred_triples.add((start, end, pred_sentiment))

            pred_detail.append({
                "term": term,
                "start": start,
                "end": end,
                "sentiment": pred_sentiment,
                "ate_confidence": predicted_aspect.get("confidence"),
                "asc_confidence": asc_result.get("confidence"),
                "asc_probabilities": asc_result.get("probabilities"),
            })

            span = (start, end)
            if span in gold_by_span:
                gold_sentiment = gold_by_span[span]

                matched_gold.append(LABEL2ID[gold_sentiment])
                matched_pred.append(LABEL2ID[pred_sentiment])

                if gold_sentiment == pred_sentiment:
                    breakdown["matched_span_sentiment_correct"] += 1
                else:
                    breakdown["matched_span_sentiment_wrong"] += 1
                    errors["matched_span_sentiment_errors"].append({
                        "comment_id": item.get("comment_id"),
                        "text": text,
                        "term": term,
                        "start": start,
                        "end": end,
                        "gold": gold_sentiment,
                        "pred": pred_sentiment,
                        "probabilities": asc_result.get("probabilities"),
                    })

        cur_tp = len(gold_triples & pred_triples)
        cur_fp = len(pred_triples - gold_triples)
        cur_fn = len(gold_triples - pred_triples)

        e2e_tp += cur_tp
        e2e_fp += cur_fp
        e2e_fn += cur_fn

        if cur_fp or cur_fn:
            errors["end_to_end_errors"].append({
                "comment_id": item.get("comment_id"),
                "video_id": item.get("video_id"),
                "text": text,
                "gold": [
                    {
                        "term": text[start:end],
                        "start": start,
                        "end": end,
                        "sentiment": sentiment,
                    }
                    for start, end, sentiment in sorted(gold_triples)
                ],
                "pred": pred_detail,
            })

        if i % 20 == 0 or i == len(data):
            print(
                f"[{i}/{len(data)}] "
                f"ATE TP={breakdown['ate_exact_tp']} "
                f"FP={breakdown['ate_false_positive']} "
                f"FN={breakdown['ate_false_negative']} | "
                f"E2E TP={e2e_tp} FP={e2e_fp} FN={e2e_fn}"
            )

    ate_metrics = exact_span_metrics(ate_gold_all, ate_pred_all)
    asc_oracle = classification_metrics(oracle_gold, oracle_pred)

    asc_on_exact = (
        classification_metrics(matched_gold, matched_pred)
        if matched_gold
        else {"accuracy": 0.0, "macro_f1": 0.0}
    )

    e2e = prf(e2e_tp, e2e_fp, e2e_fn)

    breakdown["end_to_end_tp"] = e2e_tp
    breakdown["end_to_end_fp"] = e2e_fp
    breakdown["end_to_end_fn"] = e2e_fn
    breakdown["asc_accuracy_on_exact_ate_matches"] = safe_div(
        breakdown["matched_span_sentiment_correct"],
        breakdown["matched_span_sentiment_correct"]
        + breakdown["matched_span_sentiment_wrong"],
    )

    metrics = {
        "dataset": {
            "test_file": str(TEST_SOURCE),
            "comments": len(data),
            "gold_aspects": breakdown["gold_aspects"],
        },
        "models": {
            "ate": "ate_phobert_v2",
            "asc": "asc_phobert_v2",
        },
        "ate_exact_char_span": ate_metrics,
        "asc_oracle_gold_aspect": asc_oracle,
        "asc_on_exact_ate_matches": asc_on_exact,
        "end_to_end_exact_span_sentiment": e2e,
        "error_propagation": breakdown,
    }

    with open(OUTPUT_DIR / "metrics.json", "w", encoding="utf-8") as f:
        json.dump(metrics, f, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2)

    with open(OUTPUT_DIR / "errors.json", "w", encoding="utf-8") as f:
        json.dump(errors, f, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2)

    print()
    print("=" * 72)
    print("ABSA V2 END-TO-END RESULTS")
    print("=" * 72)
    print(f"ATE V2 F1               : {ate_metrics['f1']:.4f}")
    print(f"ASC V2 Oracle Macro-F1  : {asc_oracle['macro_f1']:.4f}")
    print(f"ASC exact-span Accuracy : {asc_on_exact.get('accuracy', 0):.4f}")
    print(f"End-to-End V2 Precision : {e2e['precision']:.4f}")
    print(f"End-to-End V2 Recall    : {e2e['recall']:.4f}")
    print(f"End-to-End V2 F1        : {e2e['f1']:.4f}")
    print("Saved:", OUTPUT_DIR)


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

// END ------------------------------

import json

from config_ate_v2 import (
    TEST_FILE as ATE_TEST_FILE,
    BACKEND_DIR,
)

from config_asc_v2 import (
    TEST_FILE as ASC_TEST_FILE,
    LABEL2ID,
)

from metrics_ate_v2 import (
    exact_span_metrics,
    labels_to_char_spans,
)

from metrics_asc_v2 import (
    classification_metrics,
)

from frozen_eval_utils import (
    set_deterministic,
    load_json,
    load_ate,
    load_asc,
    predict_ate_from_frozen_segments,
    predict_asc_from_frozen_text,
)


OUTPUT_DIR = (
    BACKEND_DIR
    / "evaluation_outputs"
    / "absa_v2_end_to_end_frozen"
)


def safe_div(a, b):
    return a / b if b else 0.0


def prf(tp, fp, fn):
    p = safe_div(
        tp,
        tp + fp,
    )

    r = safe_div(
        tp,
        tp + fn,
    )

    f1 = safe_div(
        2 * p * r,
        p + r,
    )

    return {
        "precision":
            p,
        "recall":
            r,
        "f1":
            f1,
        "tp":
            tp,
        "fp":
            fp,
        "fn":
            fn,
    }


def main():
    set_deterministic()

    ate_data = load_json(
        ATE_TEST_FILE
    )

    asc_data = load_json(
        ASC_TEST_FILE
    )

    # Frozen ASC input per exact gold aspect.
    asc_by_key = {
        (
            str(
                item.get(
                    "comment_id"
                )
            ),
            int(
                item[
                    "start"
                ]
            ),
            int(
                item[
                    "end"
                ]
            ),
        ):
            item
        for item
        in asc_data
    }

    (
        ate_tokenizer,
        ate_model,
        threshold,
    ) = load_ate()

    (
        asc_tokenizer,
        asc_model,
    ) = load_asc()

    ate_gold_all = []
    ate_pred_all = []

    oracle_gold = []
    oracle_pred = []

    matched_gold = []
    matched_pred = []

    e2e_tp = 0
    e2e_fp = 0
    e2e_fn = 0

    errors = {
        "ate_false_negatives": [],
        "ate_false_positives": [],
        "matched_span_sentiment_errors": [],
    }

    # ASC oracle from its own frozen preprocessed test file.
    for item in asc_data:
        result = (
            predict_asc_from_frozen_text(
                asc_tokenizer,
                asc_model,
                item[
                    "segmented_text"
                ],
                item[
                    "segmented_aspect"
                ],
            )
        )

        oracle_gold.append(
            LABEL2ID[
                item[
                    "label"
                ]
            ]
        )

        oracle_pred.append(
            LABEL2ID[
                result[
                    "sentiment"
                ]
            ]
        )

    for item in ate_data:
        text = item["text"]

        labels = (
            predict_ate_from_frozen_segments(
                ate_tokenizer,
                ate_model,
                threshold,
                item[
                    "segments"
                ],
            )
        )

        pred_spans = set(
            labels_to_char_spans(
                labels,
                item[
                    "segments"
                ],
            )
        )

        gold_by_span = {
            (
                int(
                    a[
                        "start"
                    ]
                ),
                int(
                    a[
                        "end"
                    ]
                ),
            ):
                str(
                    a[
                        "polarity"
                    ]
                )
                .strip()
                .upper()
            for a
            in (
                item.get(
                    "aspects"
                )
                or []
            )
        }

        gold_spans = set(
            gold_by_span
        )

        ate_gold_all.append(
            gold_spans
        )

        ate_pred_all.append(
            pred_spans
        )

        exact_spans = (
            gold_spans
            & pred_spans
        )

        fp_spans = (
            pred_spans
            - gold_spans
        )

        fn_spans = (
            gold_spans
            - pred_spans
        )

        # Every ATE false span is automatically one end-to-end FP,
        # regardless of the sentiment assigned to it.
        e2e_fp += len(
            fp_spans
        )

        # Every missed gold span is automatically one end-to-end FN.
        e2e_fn += len(
            fn_spans
        )

        for start, end in sorted(
            fp_spans
        ):
            errors[
                "ate_false_positives"
            ].append({
                "comment_id":
                    item.get(
                        "comment_id"
                    ),
                "text":
                    text,
                "term":
                    text[
                        start:
                        end
                    ],
                "start":
                    start,
                "end":
                    end,
            })

        for start, end in sorted(
            fn_spans
        ):
            errors[
                "ate_false_negatives"
            ].append({
                "comment_id":
                    item.get(
                        "comment_id"
                    ),
                "text":
                    text,
                "term":
                    text[
                        start:
                        end
                    ],
                "start":
                    start,
                "end":
                    end,
                "gold_sentiment":
                    gold_by_span[
                        (
                            start,
                            end,
                        )
                    ],
            })

        # ASC is evaluated only where ATE got the exact gold span.
        # For these spans, reuse the frozen ASC processed input that
        # was created before model evaluation.
        for start, end in sorted(
            exact_spans
        ):
            key = (
                str(
                    item.get(
                        "comment_id"
                    )
                ),
                start,
                end,
            )

            asc_item = (
                asc_by_key.get(
                    key
                )
            )

            if asc_item is None:
                raise RuntimeError(
                    "Không tìm thấy frozen ASC sample "
                    f"cho key={key}"
                )

            asc_result = (
                predict_asc_from_frozen_text(
                    asc_tokenizer,
                    asc_model,
                    asc_item[
                        "segmented_text"
                    ],
                    asc_item[
                        "segmented_aspect"
                    ],
                )
            )

            gold_sentiment = (
                gold_by_span[
                    (
                        start,
                        end,
                    )
                ]
            )

            pred_sentiment = (
                asc_result[
                    "sentiment"
                ]
            )

            matched_gold.append(
                LABEL2ID[
                    gold_sentiment
                ]
            )

            matched_pred.append(
                LABEL2ID[
                    pred_sentiment
                ]
            )

            if (
                gold_sentiment
                == pred_sentiment
            ):
                e2e_tp += 1
            else:
                # Correct span but wrong sentiment:
                # one predicted triple is FP and
                # one gold triple is FN.
                e2e_fp += 1
                e2e_fn += 1

                errors[
                    "matched_span_sentiment_errors"
                ].append({
                    "comment_id":
                        item.get(
                            "comment_id"
                        ),
                    "text":
                        text,
                    "term":
                        text[
                            start:
                            end
                        ],
                    "start":
                        start,
                    "end":
                        end,
                    "gold":
                        gold_sentiment,
                    "pred":
                        pred_sentiment,
                    "probabilities":
                        asc_result[
                            "probabilities"
                        ],
                })

    ate_metrics = (
        exact_span_metrics(
            ate_gold_all,
            ate_pred_all,
        )
    )

    asc_oracle = (
        classification_metrics(
            oracle_gold,
            oracle_pred,
        )
    )

    asc_exact = (
        classification_metrics(
            matched_gold,
            matched_pred,
        )
        if matched_gold
        else {
            "accuracy":
                0.0,
            "macro_f1":
                0.0,
        }
    )

    e2e = prf(
        e2e_tp,
        e2e_fp,
        e2e_fn,
    )

    metrics = {
        "dataset": {
            "comments":
                len(
                    ate_data
                ),
            "gold_aspects":
                sum(
                    len(
                        x
                    )
                    for x
                    in ate_gold_all
                ),
        },
        "models": {
            "ate":
                "ate_phobert_v2",
            "asc":
                "asc_phobert_v2",
        },
        "protocol": {
            "ate_input":
                str(
                    ATE_TEST_FILE
                ),
            "asc_input":
                str(
                    ASC_TEST_FILE
                ),
            "segmentation":
                "frozen_preprocessed",
            "device":
                "cpu",
            "ate_threshold":
                threshold,
        },
        "ate_exact_char_span":
            ate_metrics,
        "asc_oracle_gold_aspect":
            asc_oracle,
        "asc_on_exact_ate_matches":
            asc_exact,
        "end_to_end_exact_span_sentiment":
            e2e,
        "error_propagation": {
            "gold_aspects":
                sum(
                    len(
                        x
                    )
                    for x
                    in ate_gold_all
                ),
            "ate_exact_tp":
                ate_metrics[
                    "tp"
                ],
            "ate_false_positive":
                ate_metrics[
                    "fp"
                ],
            "ate_false_negative":
                ate_metrics[
                    "fn"
                ],
            "matched_span_sentiment_correct":
                e2e_tp,
            "matched_span_sentiment_wrong":
                (
                    len(
                        matched_gold
                    )
                    - e2e_tp
                ),
            "end_to_end_tp":
                e2e_tp,
            "end_to_end_fp":
                e2e_fp,
            "end_to_end_fn":
                e2e_fn,
            "asc_accuracy_on_exact_ate_matches":
                safe_div(
                    e2e_tp,
                    len(
                        matched_gold
                    ),
                ),
        },
    }

    OUTPUT_DIR.mkdir(
        parents=True,
        exist_ok=True,
    )

    with open(
        OUTPUT_DIR
        / "metrics.json",
        "w",
        encoding="utf-8",
    ) as f:
        json.dump(
            metrics,
            f,
            ensure_ascii=False,
            indent=2,
        )

    with open(
        OUTPUT_DIR
        / "errors.json",
        "w",
        encoding="utf-8",
    ) as f:
        json.dump(
            errors,
            f,
            ensure_ascii=False,
            indent=2,
        )

    print(
        json.dumps(
            metrics,
            ensure_ascii=False,
            indent=2,
        )
    )


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

// FILE: backend\train\absa\evaluate_asc.py
// START ------------------------------
import json
import torch
from torch.utils.data import DataLoader
from transformers import AutoTokenizer, AutoModelForSequenceClassification
from config_asc import TEST_FILE, MODEL_OUTPUT_DIR, BATCH_SIZE, DEVICE
from dataset_asc import ABSASentimentDataset
from metrics_asc import compute_metrics

@torch.no_grad()
def main():
    print('=' * 70)
    print('PhoBERT ASC V1 - TEST EVALUATION')
    print('=' * 70)
    print('Device:', DEVICE)
    tokenizer = AutoTokenizer.from_pretrained(MODEL_OUTPUT_DIR)
    model = AutoModelForSequenceClassification.from_pretrained(MODEL_OUTPUT_DIR).to(DEVICE)
    model.eval()
    dataset = ABSASentimentDataset(TEST_FILE, tokenizer)
    loader = DataLoader(dataset, batch_size=BATCH_SIZE, shuffle=False)
    y_true, y_pred = [], []
    for batch in loader:
        input_ids = batch['input_ids'].to(DEVICE)
        attention_mask = batch['attention_mask'].to(DEVICE)
        labels = batch['labels'].to(DEVICE)
        preds = model(input_ids=input_ids, attention_mask=attention_mask).logits.argmax(dim=-1)
        y_true.extend(labels.cpu().tolist())
        y_pred.extend(preds.cpu().tolist())
    metrics = compute_metrics(y_true, y_pred)
    print(f"Accuracy    : {metrics['accuracy']:.4f}")
    print(f"Macro P     : {metrics['macro_precision']:.4f}")
    print(f"Macro R     : {metrics['macro_recall']:.4f}")
    print(f"Macro F1    : {metrics['macro_f1']:.4f}")
    print(f"Weighted F1 : {metrics['weighted_f1']:.4f}")
    print('\nPer-class:')
    for label, row in metrics['per_class'].items():
        print(f"{label:8} P={row['precision']:.4f} R={row['recall']:.4f} F1={row['f1']:.4f} N={row['support']}")
    print('\nConfusion matrix labels:', metrics['confusion_matrix_labels'])
    for row in metrics['confusion_matrix']:
        print(row)
    output_file = MODEL_OUTPUT_DIR / 'test_metrics.json'
    with open(output_file, 'w', encoding='utf-8') as f:
        json.dump(metrics, f, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2)
    print('\nSaved:', output_file)

if __name__ == '__main__':
    main()

// END ------------------------------

// FILE: backend\train\absa\evaluate_asc_v2.py
// START ------------------------------
import json

from config_asc_v2 import (
    TEST_FILE,
    EVAL_OUTPUT_DIR,
    LABEL2ID,
    ID2LABEL,
)

from inference_asc_v2 import (
    ASCPhoBERTV2,
)

from metrics_asc_v2 import (
    classification_metrics,
)


def load_json(path):
    with open(
        path,
        "r",
        encoding="utf-8",
    ) as f:
        return json.load(
            f
        )


def main():
    data = load_json(
        TEST_FILE
    )

// FILE: backend\train\absa\evaluate_ate.py
// START ------------------------------
import json

import torch

from torch.utils.data import DataLoader

from transformers import (
    AutoTokenizer,
    AutoModelForTokenClassification,
)

from config_ate import (
    TEST_FILE,
    MODEL_OUTPUT_DIR,
    BATCH_SIZE,
    DEVICE,
    ID2LABEL,
)

from dataset_ate import (
    ABSATokenDataset,
)

from metrics_ate import (
    span_metrics,
)


def collapse_to_words(
    pred_ids,
    gold_ids,
    word_ids,
):

    pred_sequence = []
    gold_sequence = []

    seen_words = set()

    for pred, gold, word_id in zip(
        pred_ids,
        gold_ids,
        word_ids,
    ):

        word_id = int(word_id)

        if word_id < 0:
            continue

        if word_id in seen_words:
            continue

        seen_words.add(word_id)

        if int(gold) == -100:
            continue

        pred_sequence.append(
            ID2LABEL[int(pred)]
        )

        gold_sequence.append(
            ID2LABEL[int(gold)]
        )

    return (
        pred_sequence,
        gold_sequence,
    )


@torch.no_grad()
def evaluate():

    print("=" * 70)
    print("PhoBERT ATE V1 - TEST EVALUATION")
    print("=" * 70)

    print(
        "Device:",
        DEVICE,
    )

    tokenizer = (
        AutoTokenizer
        .from_pretrained(
            MODEL_OUTPUT_DIR
        )
    )

    model = (
        AutoModelForTokenClassification
        .from_pretrained(
            MODEL_OUTPUT_DIR
        )
    )

    model.to(
        DEVICE
    )

    model.eval()

    dataset = ABSATokenDataset(
        TEST_FILE,
        tokenizer,
    )

    loader = DataLoader(
        dataset,
        batch_size=BATCH_SIZE,
        shuffle=False,
    )

    all_predictions = []
    all_gold = []

    for batch in loader:

        input_ids = (
            batch["input_ids"]
            .to(DEVICE)
        )

        attention_mask = (
            batch["attention_mask"]
            .to(DEVICE)
        )

        labels = (
            batch["labels"]
            .cpu()
            .numpy()
        )

        word_ids = (
            batch["word_ids"]
            .cpu()
            .numpy()
        )

        outputs = model(
            input_ids=input_ids,
            attention_mask=attention_mask,
        )

        predictions = (
            outputs.logits
            .argmax(dim=-1)
            .cpu()
            .numpy()
        )

        for i in range(
            predictions.shape[0]
        ):

            pred_seq, gold_seq = (
                collapse_to_words(
                    predictions[i],
                    labels[i],
                    word_ids[i],
                )
            )

            all_predictions.append(
                pred_seq
            )

            all_gold.append(
                gold_seq
            )

    metrics = span_metrics(
        all_gold,
        all_predictions,
    )

    predicted_spans = (
        metrics["tp"]
        + metrics["fp"]
    )

    gold_spans = (
        metrics["tp"]
        + metrics["fn"]
    )

    print()
    print("Exact Span Metrics")
    print("-" * 40)

    print(
        f"Precision : "
        f"{metrics['precision']:.4f}"
    )

    print(
        f"Recall    : "
        f"{metrics['recall']:.4f}"
    )

    print(
        f"F1        : "
        f"{metrics['f1']:.4f}"
    )

    print()
    print(
        f"TP        : "
        f"{metrics['tp']}"
    )

    print(
        f"FP        : "
        f"{metrics['fp']}"
    )

    print(
        f"FN        : "
        f"{metrics['fn']}"
    )

    print(
        f"Gold spans: "
        f"{gold_spans}"
    )

    print(
        f"Pred spans: "
        f"{predicted_spans}"
    )

    result = {
        **metrics,

        "gold_spans":
            gold_spans,

        "predicted_spans":
            predicted_spans,
    }

    output_file = (
        MODEL_OUTPUT_DIR
        / "test_metrics.json"
    )

    with open(
        output_file,
        "w",
        encoding="utf-8",
    ) as f:

        json.dump(
            result,
            f,
            ensure_ascii=False,
            indent=2,
        )

    print()
    print(
        "Saved:",
        output_file,
    )


if __name__ == "__main__":
    evaluate()

import json

from config_ate_v2 import (
    TEST_SOURCE,

    ATEPhoBERTV2,

)


def load_json(path):
    with open(
        path,
        "r",
        encoding="utf-8",
    ) as f:
        return json.load(
            f
        )


def main():
    data = load_json(
        TEST_SOURCE
    )

    engine = (
        ATEPhoBERTV2()
    )

    gold_all = []
    pred_all = []

    errors = []

    for index, item in enumerate(
        data,
        start=1,
    ):
        text = str(
            item.get(
                "text",
                "",
            )
            or ""
        )

        gold = {
            (
                int(
                    aspect[
                        "start"
                    ]
                ),
                int(
                    aspect[
                        "end"
                    ]
                ),
            )
            for aspect in (
                item.get(
                    "aspects"
                )
                or []
            )
        }

        result = engine.predict(
            text
        )

        pred = {
            (
                int(
                    aspect[
                        "start"
                    ]
                ),
                int(
                    aspect[
                        "end"
                    ]
                ),
            )
            for aspect in (
                result[
                    "aspects"
                ]
            )
        }

        gold_all.append(
            gold
        )

        pred_all.append(
            pred
        )

        if gold != pred:
            errors.append({
                "comment_id":
                    item.get(
                        "comment_id"
                    ),

                "video_id":
                    item.get(
                        "video_id"
                    ),

                "text":
                    text,

                "gold": [
                    {
                        "term":
                            text[
                                start:
                                end
                            ],

                        "start":
                            start,

                        "end":
                            end,
                    }
                    for (
                        start,
                        end,
                    )
                    in sorted(
                        gold
                    )
                ],

                "pred":
                    result[
                        "aspects"
                    ],
            })

        if (
            index % 20
            == 0
            or index
            == len(
                data
            )
        ):
            print(
                f"[{index}/{len(data)}]"
            )

    metrics = exact_span_metrics(
        gold_all,
        pred_all,
    )

    metrics[
        "comments"
    ] = len(
        data
    )

    metrics[
        "gold_spans"
    ] = sum(
        len(
            value
        )
        for value in gold_all
    )

    metrics[
        "predicted_spans"
    ] = sum(
        len(
            value
        )
        for value in pred_all
    )

    metrics[
        "threshold"
    ] = engine.threshold

    EVAL_OUTPUT_DIR.mkdir(
        parents=True,
        exist_ok=True,
    )

    with open(
        EVAL_OUTPUT_DIR
        / "test_metrics.json",
        "w",
        encoding="utf-8",
    ) as f:
        json.dump(
            metrics,
            f,
            ensure_ascii=False,
            indent=2,
        )

    with open(
        EVAL_OUTPUT_DIR
        / "test_errors.json",
        "w",
        encoding="utf-8",
    ) as f:
        json.dump(
            errors,
            f,
            ensure_ascii=False,
            indent=2,
        )

    print()
    print("=" * 72)
    print("ATE V2 TEST - EXACT CHARACTER SPAN")
    print("=" * 72)
    print(
        json.dumps(
            metrics,
            ensure_ascii=False,
            indent=2,
        )
    )

    print()
    print(
        "Saved:",
        EVAL_OUTPUT_DIR,
    )


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

import json

from config_ate_v2 import (
    TEST_FILE,
    BACKEND_DIR,
)

from metrics_ate_v2 import (
    exact_span_metrics,
    labels_to_char_spans,
)

from frozen_eval_utils import (
    set_deterministic,
    load_json,
    load_ate,
    predict_ate_from_frozen_segments,
)


OUTPUT_DIR = (
    BACKEND_DIR
    / "evaluation_outputs"
    / "ate_phobert_v2_frozen"
)


def main():
    set_deterministic()

    data = load_json(
        TEST_FILE
    )

    (
        tokenizer,
        model,
        threshold,
    ) = load_ate()

    gold_all = []
    pred_all = []
    errors = []

    for item in data:
        text = item["text"]
        segments = item["segments"]

        labels = (
            predict_ate_from_frozen_segments(
                tokenizer,
                model,
                threshold,
                segments,
            )
        )

        pred = set(
            labels_to_char_spans(
                labels,
                segments,
            )
        )

        gold = {
            (
                int(a["start"]),
                int(a["end"]),
            )
            for a
            in (
                item.get("aspects")
                or []
            )
        }

        gold_all.append(gold)
        pred_all.append(pred)

        if gold != pred:
            errors.append({
                "comment_id":
                    item.get(
                        "comment_id"
                    ),
                "text":
                    text,
                "gold":
                    [
                        {
                            "term":
                                text[s:e],
                            "start":
                                s,
                            "end":
                                e,
                        }
                        for s, e
                        in sorted(gold)
                    ],
                "pred":
                    [
                        {
                            "term":
                                text[s:e],
                            "start":
                                s,
                            "end":
                                e,
                        }
                        for s, e
                        in sorted(pred)
                    ],
            })

    metrics = exact_span_metrics(
        gold_all,
        pred_all,
    )

    metrics.update({
        "comments":
            len(data),
        "gold_spans":
            sum(
                len(x)
                for x
                in gold_all
            ),
        "predicted_spans":
            sum(
                len(x)
                for x
                in pred_all
            ),
        "threshold":
            threshold,
        "evaluation_input":
            str(TEST_FILE),
        "segmentation":
            "frozen_processed_v2",
        "device":
            "cpu",
    })

    OUTPUT_DIR.mkdir(
        parents=True,
        exist_ok=True,
    )

    with open(
        OUTPUT_DIR
        / "test_metrics.json",
        "w",
        encoding="utf-8",
    ) as f:
        json.dump(
            metrics,
            f,
            ensure_ascii=False,
            indent=2,
        )

    with open(
        OUTPUT_DIR
        / "test_errors.json",
        "w",
        encoding="utf-8",
    ) as f:
        json.dump(
            errors,
            f,
            ensure_ascii=False,
            indent=2,
        )

    print(
        json.dumps(
            metrics,
            ensure_ascii=False,
            indent=2,
        )
    )


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

// FILE: backend\train\absa\frozen_eval_utils.py
// START ------------------------------
import json
import random

import numpy as np
import torch

from transformers import (
    AutoModelForTokenClassification,
    AutoModelForSequenceClassification,
    AutoTokenizer,
)

from config_ate_v2 import (
    MODEL_OUTPUT_DIR as ATE_MODEL_DIR,
    LABEL2ID as ATE_LABEL2ID,
    MAX_LENGTH as ATE_MAX_LENGTH,
)

from config_asc_v2 import (
    MODEL_OUTPUT_DIR as ASC_MODEL_DIR,
    ID2LABEL as ASC_ID2LABEL,
    MAX_LENGTH as ASC_MAX_LENGTH,
)


DEVICE = torch.device("cpu")


def set_deterministic(seed=42):
    random.seed(seed)
    np.random.seed(seed)
    torch.manual_seed(seed)

    try:
        torch.use_deterministic_algorithms(True)
    except Exception:
        pass


def load_json(path):
    with open(path, "r", encoding="utf-8") as f:
        return json.load(f)


def load_ate():
    tokenizer = AutoTokenizer.from_pretrained(
        ATE_MODEL_DIR
    )

    model = (
        AutoModelForTokenClassification
        .from_pretrained(
            ATE_MODEL_DIR
        )
        .to(DEVICE)
    )

    model.eval()

    config_path = (
        ATE_MODEL_DIR
        / "inference_config.json"
    )

    threshold = 0.50

    if config_path.exists():
        cfg = json.loads(
            config_path.read_text(
                encoding="utf-8"
            )
        )

        threshold = float(
            cfg.get(
                "aspect_threshold",
                0.50,
            )
        )

    return (
        tokenizer,
        model,
        threshold,
    )


def encode_ate_segments(
    tokenizer,
    segments,
):
    token_ids = []
    segment_ids = []

    for segment_index, segment in enumerate(
        segments
    ):
        pieces = tokenizer.encode(
            segment["word_form"],
            add_special_tokens=False,
        )

        if not pieces:
            pieces = [
                tokenizer.unk_token_id
            ]

        for piece_id in pieces:
            token_ids.append(piece_id)
            segment_ids.append(
                segment_index
            )

    max_body = (
        ATE_MAX_LENGTH
        - tokenizer.num_special_tokens_to_add(
            pair=False
        )
    )

    token_ids = token_ids[:max_body]
    segment_ids = segment_ids[:max_body]

    input_ids = (
        tokenizer
        .build_inputs_with_special_tokens(
            token_ids
        )
    )

    special_mask = (
        tokenizer
        .get_special_tokens_mask(
            token_ids,
            already_has_special_tokens=False,
        )
    )

    final_segment_ids = []
    body_cursor = 0

    for is_special in special_mask:
        if is_special:
            final_segment_ids.append(-1)
        else:
            final_segment_ids.append(
                segment_ids[
                    body_cursor
                ]
            )
            body_cursor += 1

    attention_mask = [
        1
    ] * len(input_ids)

    return (
        torch.tensor(
            [input_ids],
            dtype=torch.long,
            device=DEVICE,
        ),
        torch.tensor(
            [attention_mask],
            dtype=torch.long,
            device=DEVICE,
        ),
        final_segment_ids,
    )


@torch.no_grad()
def predict_ate_from_frozen_segments(
    tokenizer,
    model,
    threshold,
    segments,
):
    (
        input_ids,
        attention_mask,
        segment_ids,
    ) = encode_ate_segments(
        tokenizer,
        segments,
    )

    outputs = model(
        input_ids=input_ids,
        attention_mask=attention_mask,
    )

    probs = (
        torch.softmax(
            outputs.logits[0],
            dim=-1,
        )
        .cpu()
    )

    first_piece_probs = {}

    for token_index, segment_id in enumerate(
        segment_ids
    ):
        if (
            segment_id < 0
            or segment_id in first_piece_probs
        ):
            continue

        first_piece_probs[
            segment_id
        ] = probs[
            token_index
        ].tolist()

    labels = []

    for segment_index in range(
        len(segments)
    ):
        values = first_piece_probs.get(
            segment_index
        )

        if values is None:
            labels.append("O")
            continue

        o_prob = values[
            ATE_LABEL2ID["O"]
        ]

        b_prob = values[
            ATE_LABEL2ID["B-ASP"]
        ]

        i_prob = values[
            ATE_LABEL2ID["I-ASP"]
        ]

        aspect_prob = max(
            b_prob,
            i_prob,
        )

        if (
            aspect_prob < threshold
            or o_prob >= aspect_prob
        ):
            labels.append("O")
        elif b_prob >= i_prob:
            labels.append("B-ASP")
        else:
            labels.append("I-ASP")

    return labels


def load_asc():
    tokenizer = AutoTokenizer.from_pretrained(
        ASC_MODEL_DIR
    )

    model = (
        AutoModelForSequenceClassification
        .from_pretrained(
            ASC_MODEL_DIR
        )
        .to(DEVICE)
    )

    model.eval()

    return tokenizer, model


@torch.no_grad()
def predict_asc_from_frozen_text(
    tokenizer,
    model,
    segmented_text,
    segmented_aspect,
):
    encoded = tokenizer(
        segmented_text,
        segmented_aspect,
        max_length=ASC_MAX_LENGTH,
        truncation=True,
        padding="max_length",
        return_tensors="pt",
    )

    encoded = {
        key: value.to(DEVICE)
        for key, value
        in encoded.items()
    }

    outputs = model(
        **encoded
    )

    probs = (
        torch.softmax(
            outputs.logits[0],
            dim=-1,
        )
        .cpu()
        .tolist()
    )

    pred_id = int(
        torch.argmax(
            outputs.logits[0]
        ).item()
    )

    return {
        "sentiment":
            ASC_ID2LABEL[
                pred_id
            ],
        "confidence":
            probs[pred_id],
        "probabilities": {
            ASC_ID2LABEL[i]:
                value
            for i, value
            in enumerate(probs)
        },
    }

// END ------------------------------

// FILE: backend\train\absa\inference_asc_v2.py
