    data?.analysis_id &&
    data?.created_at &&
    data?.model_versions
  );

  const groupedModels = useMemo(
    () => ({
      inference: models.filter((model) => model.group === "inference"),
      sequence: models.filter((model) => model.group === "sequence"),
    }),
    [models]
  );

  const handleAnalyze = async () => {
    if (!url) return;

    setLoading(true);
    setData(null);

    try {
      const res = await analyzeVideo(url, selectedModelId);
      setData(res);
    } catch {
      setData({ error: "Lỗi gọi API" });
    }

    setLoading(false);
  };

  const handleRefreshContext = async () => {
    if (!url) return;

    const accepted = window.confirm(
      "Làm mới Gemini Context sẽ gọi Gemini Vision lại và tạo một phiên phân tích mới. Tiếp tục?"
    );

    if (!accepted) return;

    setRefreshingContext(true);
    setLoading(true);
    setData(null);

    try {
      const response = await fetch(
        `${API_BASE_URL}/analyze`,
        {
          method: "POST",
          headers: {
            "Content-Type": "application/json",
          },
          body: JSON.stringify({
            url,
            model_id: selectedModelId || null,
            refresh_context: true,
          }),
        }
      );

      const result = await response.json();

      if (!response.ok) {
        throw new Error(
          result?.detail ||
          `HTTP ${response.status}`
        );
      }

      setData(result);
    } catch (error) {
      console.error(error);

      setData({
        error:
          "Không thể refresh Gemini Context.",
      });
    } finally {
      setRefreshingContext(false);
      setLoading(false);
    }
  };

  // ============================================================
  // HISTORY
  // ============================================================

  const loadHistory = async () => {
    setHistoryLoading(true);
    setHistoryError("");

    try {
      const response = await fetch(
        `${API_BASE_URL}/history?limit=30&offset=0`
      );

      if (!response.ok) {
        throw new Error(`HTTP ${response.status}`);
      }

      const result = await response.json();

      setHistoryItems(
        Array.isArray(result.items)
          ? result.items
          : []
      );
    } catch (error) {
      console.error(error);
      setHistoryError("Không tải được lịch sử phân tích.");
      setHistoryItems([]);
    } finally {
      setHistoryLoading(false);
    }
  };

  const openHistory = async () => {
    setHistoryOpen(true);
    await loadHistory();
  };

  const openHistoryDetail = async (analysisId: number) => {
    setHistoryDetailLoadingId(analysisId);
    setHistoryError("");

    try {
      const response = await fetch(
        `${API_BASE_URL}/history/${analysisId}`
      );

      if (!response.ok) {
        throw new Error(`HTTP ${response.status}`);
      }

      const result = await response.json();

      setData(result);
      setUrl(result.video_url || "");

      if (
        result.model_id &&
        models.some((model) => model.id === result.model_id)
      ) {
        setSelectedModelId(result.model_id);
      }

      setHistoryOpen(false);

      window.scrollTo({
        top: 0,
        behavior: "smooth",
      });
    } catch (error) {
      console.error(error);
      setHistoryError("Không tải được chi tiết phiên phân tích.");
    } finally {
      setHistoryDetailLoadingId(null);
    }
  };

  const removeHistoryItem = async (
    analysisId: number,
    event: React.MouseEvent
  ) => {
    event.stopPropagation();

    const accepted = window.confirm(
      `Xóa phiên phân tích #${analysisId}?`
    );

    if (!accepted) return;

    try {
      const response = await fetch(
        `${API_BASE_URL}/history/${analysisId}`,
        {
          method: "DELETE",
        }
      );

      if (!response.ok) {
        throw new Error(`HTTP ${response.status}`);
      }

      setHistoryItems((current) =>
        current.filter(
          (item) => item.analysis_id !== analysisId
        )
      );

      setCompareSelection((current) =>
        current.filter(
          (id) => id !== analysisId
        )
      );

      if (
        compareData?.analysis_a?.analysis_id === analysisId ||
        compareData?.analysis_b?.analysis_id === analysisId
      ) {
        setCompareData(null);
      }

      if (data?.analysis_id === analysisId) {
        setData(null);
      }
    } catch (error) {
      console.error(error);
      setHistoryError("Không xóa được phiên phân tích.");
    }
  };

  const toggleCompareSelection = (analysisId: number) => {
    setHistoryError("");

    setCompareSelection((current) => {
      if (current.includes(analysisId)) {
        return current.filter(
          (id) => id !== analysisId
        );
      }

      if (current.length >= 2) {
        setHistoryError(
          "Compare V1 chỉ chọn tối đa 2 phiên."
        );
        return current;
      }

      return [
        ...current,
        analysisId,
      ];
    });
  };

  const runCompare = async () => {
    if (compareSelection.length !== 2) {
      setHistoryError(
        "Hãy chọn đúng 2 phiên để so sánh."
      );
      return;
    }

    const [analysisIdA, analysisIdB] =
      compareSelection;

    setCompareLoading(true);
    setCompareError("");
    setHistoryError("");

    try {
      const response = await fetch(
        `${API_BASE_URL}/compare?analysis_id_a=${analysisIdA}&analysis_id_b=${analysisIdB}`
      );

      const result = await response.json();

      if (!response.ok) {
        throw new Error(
          result?.detail ||
          `HTTP ${response.status}`
        );
      }

      setCompareData(result);
      setHistoryOpen(false);

      window.scrollTo({
        top: 0,
        behavior: "smooth",
      });
    } catch (error: any) {
      console.error(error);

      setHistoryError(
        error?.message ||
        "Không so sánh được 2 phiên."
      );
    } finally {
      setCompareLoading(false);
    }
  };

  const closeCompare = () => {
    setCompareData(null);
    setCompareError("");
    setCompareSelection([]);
  };

  const formatDelta = (value: number) => {
    const number = Number(
      value || 0
    );

    if (number > 0) {
      return `+${number}`;
    }

    return String(number);
  };

  const consistencyColor = (percent: number) => {
    const value = Number(
      percent || 0
    );

    if (value >= 95) {
      return "#16a34a";
    }

    if (value >= 80) {
      return "#d97706";
    }

    return "#dc2626";
  };

  const openTrend = async (videoId: string) => {
    if (!videoId) return;

    setTrendLoading(true);
    setTrendError("");
    setHistoryError("");

    try {
      const response = await fetch(
        `${API_BASE_URL}/trend/${encodeURIComponent(videoId)}?limit=20`
      );

      const result = await response.json();

      if (!response.ok) {
        throw new Error(
          result?.detail ||
          `HTTP ${response.status}`
        );
      }

      setTrendData(result);
      setHistoryOpen(false);

      window.scrollTo({
        top: 0,
        behavior: "smooth",
      });
    } catch (error: any) {
      console.error(error);

      const message =
        error?.message ||
        "Không tải được Trend.";

      if (historyOpen) {
        setHistoryError(message);
      } else {
        setTrendError(message);
      }
    } finally {
      setTrendLoading(false);
    }
  };

  const closeTrend = () => {
    setTrendData(null);
    setTrendError("");
  };

  const trendPointLabel = (
    createdAt: string,
    analysisId: number
  ) => {
    if (!createdAt) {
      return `#${analysisId}`;
    }

    const date = new Date(createdAt);

    if (Number.isNaN(date.getTime())) {
      return `#${analysisId}`;
    }

    return `#${analysisId} ${date.toLocaleTimeString("vi-VN", {
      hour: "2-digit",
      minute: "2-digit",
    })}`;
  };

  const trendColor = (percent: number | null | undefined) => {
    if (percent === null || percent === undefined) {
      return "#64748b";
    }

    const value = Number(percent);

    if (value >= 95) return "#16a34a";
    if (value >= 80) return "#d97706";
    return "#dc2626";
  };

  const formatHistoryTime = (value: string) => {
    if (!value) return "";

    const date = new Date(value);

    if (Number.isNaN(date.getTime())) {
      return value;
    }

    return date.toLocaleString("vi-VN");
  };

  const leaveHistoryDetail = () => {
    setData(null);
    setUrl("");
    setVideoFrameError(false);

    window.scrollTo({
      top: 0,
      behavior: "smooth",
    });
  };

  const sentimentColors = ["#4CAF50", "#FFC107", "#F44336"];

  const emotionColors: any = {
    ANGER: "#F44336",
    DISGUST: "#9C27B0",
    ENJOYMENT: "#4CAF50",
    FEAR: "#FF9800",
    OTHER: "#9E9E9E",
    SADNESS: "#2196F3",
    SURPRISE: "#FFC107",
  };

  const pieData = data
    ? [
      { name: "Positive", value: data.summary?.positive || 0 },
      { name: "Neutral", value: data.summary?.neutral || 0 },
      { name: "Negative", value: data.summary?.negative || 0 },
    ]
    : [];

  const barData = data?.emotions
    ? Object.entries(data.emotions).map(([k, v]) => ({
      name: k,
      value: v as number,
    }))
    : [];

  // ============================================================
  // ABSA DATA
  // ============================================================

  const absaSummary = data?.absa_summary || null;

  const absaSentimentData = absaSummary
    ? [
      {
        name: "Positive",
        value: absaSummary.sentiments?.POSITIVE || 0,
        key: "POSITIVE",
      },
      {
        name: "Neutral",
        value: absaSummary.sentiments?.NEUTRAL || 0,
        key: "NEUTRAL",
      },
      {
        name: "Negative",
        value: absaSummary.sentiments?.NEGATIVE || 0,
        key: "NEGATIVE",
      },
    ]
    : [];

  const topAspects = Array.isArray(absaSummary?.top_aspects)
    ? absaSummary.top_aspects
    : [];

  const aspectChartData = topAspects.slice(0, 8).map((item: any) => ({
    name: item.term,
    value: item.count,
  }));

  const absaSentimentColor = (sentiment: string) => {
    switch (sentiment) {
      case "POSITIVE":
        return "#16a34a";
      case "NEGATIVE":
        return "#dc2626";
      case "NEUTRAL":
        return "#d97706";
      default:
        return "#64748b";
    }
  };

  const compareEmotionChartData = compareData
    ? [
      {
        name: "Positive",
        A: compareData.emotion_summary?.positive?.a || 0,
        B: compareData.emotion_summary?.positive?.b || 0,
      },
      {
        name: "Neutral",
        A: compareData.emotion_summary?.neutral?.a || 0,
        B: compareData.emotion_summary?.neutral?.b || 0,
      },
      {
        name: "Negative",
        A: compareData.emotion_summary?.negative?.a || 0,
        B: compareData.emotion_summary?.negative?.b || 0,
      },
    ]
    : [];

  const compareABSAChartData = compareData
    ? [
      {
        name: "Positive",
        A: compareData.absa?.sentiments?.POSITIVE?.a || 0,
        B: compareData.absa?.sentiments?.POSITIVE?.b || 0,
      },
      {
        name: "Neutral",
        A: compareData.absa?.sentiments?.NEUTRAL?.a || 0,
        B: compareData.absa?.sentiments?.NEUTRAL?.b || 0,
      },
      {
        name: "Negative",
        A: compareData.absa?.sentiments?.NEGATIVE?.a || 0,
        B: compareData.absa?.sentiments?.NEGATIVE?.b || 0,
      },
    ]
    : [];

  const trendEmotionData = Array.isArray(trendData?.points)
    ? trendData.points.map((point: any) => ({
      label: trendPointLabel(
        point.created_at,
        point.analysis_id
      ),
      analysis_id: point.analysis_id,
      Positive: point.emotion?.positive || 0,
      Neutral: point.emotion?.neutral || 0,
      Negative: point.emotion?.negative || 0,
    }))
    : [];

  const trendABSAData = Array.isArray(trendData?.points)
    ? trendData.points.map((point: any) => ({
      label: trendPointLabel(
        point.created_at,
        point.analysis_id
      ),
      analysis_id: point.analysis_id,
      Positive: point.absa?.positive || 0,
      Neutral: point.absa?.neutral || 0,
      Negative: point.absa?.negative || 0,
      "Tổng aspect": point.absa?.total_aspects || 0,
    }))
    : [];

  const trendConsistencyData = Array.isArray(trendData?.transitions)
    ? trendData.transitions.map((transition: any) => ({
      label: `#${transition.from_analysis_id}→#${transition.to_analysis_id}`,
      "Comment overlap": transition.comment_overlap_percent,
      "Emotion agreement": transition.emotion_agreement_percent,
      "ABSA agreement": transition.absa_agreement_percent,
    }))
    : [];

  const contextKeywords = Array.isArray(data?.context?.keywords)
    ? data.context.keywords
    : [];

  const contextSourceLabel =
    data?.context?.source === "gemini_flash_vision"
      ? "Gemini Flash Vision"
      : data?.context?.source === "local_fallback"
        ? "Local fallback"
        : data?.context?.source || "Không xác định";

  const downloadJSON = () => {
    if (!data) return;

    const blob = new Blob(
      [JSON.stringify(data.comments, null, 2)],
      { type: "application/json" }
    );

    const url = window.URL.createObjectURL(blob);

    const a = document.createElement("a");
    a.href = url;
    a.download = "tiktok_comments.json";
    a.click();

    window.URL.revokeObjectURL(url);
  };

  const downloadCSV = () => {
    if (!data) return;

    const headers = [
      "comment",
      "label",
      "all_labels",
      "confidence",
      "aspect_terms",
      "aspect_sentiments",
    ];

    const rows = data.comments.map((c: any) => {
      const aspects = Array.isArray(c.absa?.aspects)
        ? c.absa.aspects
        : [];

      return [
        `"${c.text.replace(/"/g, '""')}"`,
        c.label,
        `"${(c.all_labels || []).join("|")}"`,
        c.confidence ?? "",
        `"${aspects.map((a: any) => a.term).join("|").replace(/"/g, '""')}"`,
        `"${aspects
          .map((a: any) => `${a.term}:${a.sentiment}`)
          .join("|")
          .replace(/"/g, '""')}"`,
      ];
    });

    const csvContent = [
      headers.join(","),
      ...rows.map((r: any) => r.join(",")),
    ].join("\n");

    const blob = new Blob([csvContent], {
      type: "text/csv;charset=utf-8;",
    });

    const url = window.URL.createObjectURL(blob);

    const a = document.createElement("a");
    a.href = url;
    a.download = "tiktok_comments.csv";
    a.click();

    window.URL.revokeObjectURL(url);
  };
  return (
    <div className="container" style={{ padding: 20, position: "relative" }}>

      {/* INPUT */}
      <div className="card" style={{ marginBottom: 20, position: "relative" }}>
        <button
          className="icon-btn top-right"
          onClick={() => setModelOpen(true)}
          title="Chọn model"
          type="button"
        >
          <EllipsisVertical size={22} />
        </button>
        <h2>Phân tích video TikTok</h2>

        {selectedModel && (
          <p style={{ margin: "4px 44px 14px 0", color: "#64748b", fontSize: 13 }}>
            Model: {selectedModel.name}
          </p>
        )}

        <div style={{ display: "flex", gap: 10 }}>
          <input
            className="input"
            placeholder="Dán link TikTok..."
            value={url}
            onChange={(e) => setUrl(e.target.value)}
          />

          <button
            className="btn"
            onClick={handleAnalyze}
            disabled={loading}
          >
            {loading && !refreshingContext
              ? "Đang xử lý..."
              : "Analyze"}
          </button>

          <button
            className="btn"
            type="button"
            onClick={handleRefreshContext}
            disabled={
              loading ||
              refreshingContext ||
              !url
            }
            title="Gọi Gemini Vision lại và cập nhật Context Cache"
            style={{
              background: "#d97706",
              whiteSpace: "nowrap",
            }}
          >
            {refreshingContext
              ? "Đang refresh..."
              : "Refresh Context"}
          </button>

          <button
            className="btn"
            type="button"
            onClick={openHistory}
            style={{
              background: "#0f172a",
              whiteSpace: "nowrap",
            }}
          >
            Lịch sử
          </button>

          {data?.video_id && (
            <button
              className="btn"
              type="button"
              onClick={() =>
                openTrend(
                  String(data.video_id)
                )
              }
              disabled={trendLoading}
              style={{
                background: "#0f766e",
                whiteSpace: "nowrap",
              }}
            >
              {trendLoading
                ? "Đang tải Trend..."
                : "Trend video này"}
            </button>
          )}
        </div>

        {data?.history_saved && data?.analysis_id && (
          <div
            style={{
              marginTop: 10,
              color: "#64748b",
              fontSize: 12,
            }}
          >
            Đã lưu phiên phân tích #{data.analysis_id}

            {data?.context_cache?.status && (
              <>
                {" · "}
                Context:
                {" "}
                <b>{data.context_cache.status}</b>
              </>
            )}
          </div>
        )}
      </div>

      {loading && <div className="card">Đang phân tích...</div>}

      {modelOpen && (
        <div className="modal-backdrop" onClick={() => setModelOpen(false)}>
          <div className="model-modal" onClick={(event) => event.stopPropagation()}>
            <div className="modal-header">
              <h3>Chọn model</h3>
              <button
                className="icon-btn"
                onClick={() => setModelOpen(false)}
                title="Đóng"
                type="button"
              >
                <X size={20} />
              </button>
            </div>

            <div className="model-section">
              <h4>Inference</h4>
              {groupedModels.inference.map((model) => (
                <label
                  className={`model-option ${model.available === false ? "disabled" : ""}`}
                  key={model.id}
                >
                  <input
                    type="radio"
                    name="model"
                    checked={selectedModelId === model.id}
                    disabled={model.available === false}
                    onChange={() => setSelectedModelId(model.id)}
                  />
                  <span>
                    <b>{model.name}</b>
                    <small>{model.filename}</small>
                    {model.note && <small>{model.note}</small>}
                  </span>
                </label>
              ))}
            </div>

            <div className="model-section">
              <h4>Sequence</h4>
              {groupedModels.sequence.map((model) => (
                <label
                  className={`model-option ${model.available === false ? "disabled" : ""}`}
                  key={model.id}
                >
                  <input
                    type="radio"
                    name="model"
                    checked={selectedModelId === model.id}
                    disabled={model.available === false}
                    onChange={() => setSelectedModelId(model.id)}
                  />
                  <span>
                    <b>{model.name}</b>
                    <small>{model.filename}</small>
                    {model.note && <small>{model.note}</small>}
                  </span>
                </label>
              ))}
            </div>

            <button className="btn" onClick={() => setModelOpen(false)}>
              Áp dụng
            </button>
          </div>
        </div>
      )}

      {historyOpen && (
        <div
          className="modal-backdrop"
          onClick={() => setHistoryOpen(false)}
        >
          <div
            className="model-modal"
            onClick={(event) => event.stopPropagation()}
            style={{
              width: "min(920px, calc(100vw - 32px))",
              maxWidth: 920,
              maxHeight: "82vh",
              overflowY: "auto",
            }}
          >
            <div className="modal-header">
              <div>
                <h3 style={{ marginBottom: 4 }}>
                  Lịch sử phân tích
                </h3>
                <div
                  style={{
                    color: "#64748b",
                    fontSize: 12,
                  }}
                >
                  Các lần phân tích gần nhất được lưu trong SQLite
                </div>
              </div>

              <button
                className="icon-btn"
                onClick={() => setHistoryOpen(false)}
                title="Đóng"
                type="button"
              >
                <X size={20} />
              </button>
            </div>

            <div
              style={{
                display: "flex",
                justifyContent: "space-between",
                gap: 10,
                alignItems: "center",
                flexWrap: "wrap",
                marginBottom: 12,
              }}
            >
              <div
                style={{
                  color: "#64748b",
                  fontSize: 12,
                }}
              >
                Chọn 2 phiên:
                {" "}
                <b>
                  {compareSelection.length}/2
                </b>
              </div>

              <div
                style={{
                  display: "flex",
                  gap: 8,
                  flexWrap: "wrap",
                }}
              >
                <button
                  className="btn"
                  type="button"
                  onClick={runCompare}
                  disabled={
                    compareSelection.length !== 2 ||
                    compareLoading
                  }
                  style={{
                    padding: "8px 12px",
                    fontSize: 12,
                    background:
                      compareSelection.length === 2
                        ? "#7c3aed"
                        : "#94a3b8",
                  }}
                >
                  {compareLoading
                    ? "Đang so sánh..."
                    : "So sánh 2 phiên"}
                </button>

                <button
                  className="btn"
                  type="button"
                  onClick={loadHistory}
                  disabled={historyLoading}
                  style={{
                    padding: "8px 12px",
                    fontSize: 12,
                  }}
                >
                  {historyLoading ? "Đang tải..." : "Làm mới"}
                </button>
              </div>
            </div>

            {historyError && (
              <div
                style={{
                  background: "#fef2f2",
                  color: "#991b1b",
                  border: "1px solid #fecaca",
                  borderRadius: 10,
                  padding: 10,
                  marginBottom: 12,
                  fontSize: 13,
                }}
              >
                {historyError}
              </div>
            )}

            {historyLoading && historyItems.length === 0 ? (
              <div
                style={{
                  padding: 24,
                  textAlign: "center",
                  color: "#64748b",
                }}
              >
                Đang tải lịch sử...
              </div>
            ) : historyItems.length === 0 ? (
              <div
                style={{
                  padding: 24,
                  textAlign: "center",
                  color: "#64748b",
                }}
              >
                Chưa có phiên phân tích nào được lưu.
              </div>
            ) : (
              <div
                style={{
                  display: "flex",
                  flexDirection: "column",
                  gap: 10,
                }}
              >
                {historyItems.map((item: any) => {
                  const summary = item.summary || {};
                  const absa = item.absa_summary || {};
                  const sentiments = absa.sentiments || {};

                  return (
                    <div
                      key={item.analysis_id}
                      style={{
                        border:
                          compareSelection.includes(item.analysis_id)
                            ? "2px solid #8b5cf6"
                            : data?.analysis_id === item.analysis_id && isHistoryDetail
                              ? "2px solid #60a5fa"
                              : "1px solid #e2e8f0",
                        borderRadius: 12,
                        padding: 14,
                        background:
                          compareSelection.includes(item.analysis_id)
                            ? "#f5f3ff"
                            : data?.analysis_id === item.analysis_id && isHistoryDetail
                              ? "#eff6ff"
                              : "#ffffff",
                      }}
                    >
                      <div
                        style={{
                          display: "flex",
                          justifyContent: "space-between",
                          gap: 14,

              <h3>Sentiment</h3>
              <PieChart width={300} height={250}>
                <Pie data={pieData} dataKey="value" outerRadius={100}>
                  {pieData.map((_, i) => (
                    <Cell key={i} fill={sentimentColors[i]} />
                  ))}
                </Pie>
                <Tooltip />
              </PieChart>
            </div>

            {/* BAR FIX LABEL */}
            <div className="card" style={{ flex: 1 }}>
              <h3>Emotions</h3>
              <BarChart width={400} height={250} data={barData}>
                <CartesianGrid strokeDasharray="3 3" />

                {/* FIX LABEL FULL */}
                <XAxis
                  dataKey="name"
                  interval={0}
                  tick={{ fontSize: 10 }}  // giảm size chữ
                />

                <YAxis />
                <Tooltip />

                <Bar dataKey="value">
                  {barData.map((entry: any, index: number) => (
                    <Cell
                      key={index}
                      fill={emotionColors[entry.name] || "#8884d8"}
                    />
                  ))}
                </Bar>
              </BarChart>
            </div>
          </div>

          {/* ABSA DASHBOARD */}
          {absaSummary && (
            <div className="card" style={{ marginBottom: 20 }}>
              <h3 style={{ marginBottom: 6 }}>
                ABSA - Phân tích khía cạnh
              </h3>

              <p
                style={{
                  marginTop: 0,
                  color: "#64748b",
                  fontSize: 13,
                }}
              >
                Aspect Term Extraction + Aspect Sentiment Classification
              </p>

              {/* ABSA SUMMARY CARDS */}
              <div
                style={{
                  display: "grid",
                  gridTemplateColumns: "repeat(auto-fit, minmax(150px, 1fr))",
                  gap: 12,
                  marginTop: 16,
                  marginBottom: 22,
                }}
              >
                <div
                  style={{
                    background: "#f8fafc",
                    border: "1px solid #e2e8f0",
                    borderRadius: 12,
                    padding: 14,
                  }}
                >
                  <div style={{ color: "#64748b", fontSize: 12 }}>
                    Comments có aspect
                  </div>
                  <div style={{ fontSize: 24, fontWeight: 700, marginTop: 4 }}>
                    {absaSummary.comments_with_aspects || 0}
                  </div>
                  <div style={{ color: "#94a3b8", fontSize: 12 }}>
                    / {absaSummary.comments_analyzed || data.comments?.length || 0} comments
                  </div>
                </div>

                <div
                  style={{
                    background: "#f8fafc",
                    border: "1px solid #e2e8f0",
                    borderRadius: 12,
                    padding: 14,
                  }}
                >
                  <div style={{ color: "#64748b", fontSize: 12 }}>
                    Tổng aspect
                  </div>
                  <div style={{ fontSize: 24, fontWeight: 700, marginTop: 4 }}>
                    {absaSummary.total_aspects || 0}
                  </div>
                </div>

                <div
                  style={{
                    background: "#f0fdf4",
                    border: "1px solid #bbf7d0",
                    borderRadius: 12,
                    padding: 14,
                  }}
                >
                  <div style={{ color: "#166534", fontSize: 12 }}>
                    Positive
                  </div>
                  <div style={{ fontSize: 24, fontWeight: 700, marginTop: 4 }}>
                    {absaSummary.sentiments?.POSITIVE || 0}
                  </div>
                </div>

                <div
                  style={{
                    background: "#fffbeb",
                    border: "1px solid #fde68a",
                    borderRadius: 12,
                    padding: 14,
                  }}
                >
                  <div style={{ color: "#92400e", fontSize: 12 }}>
                    Neutral
                  </div>
                  <div style={{ fontSize: 24, fontWeight: 700, marginTop: 4 }}>
                    {absaSummary.sentiments?.NEUTRAL || 0}
                  </div>
                </div>

                <div
                  style={{
                    background: "#fef2f2",
                    border: "1px solid #fecaca",
                    borderRadius: 12,
                    padding: 14,
                  }}
                >
                  <div style={{ color: "#991b1b", fontSize: 12 }}>
                    Negative
                  </div>
                  <div style={{ fontSize: 24, fontWeight: 700, marginTop: 4 }}>
                    {absaSummary.sentiments?.NEGATIVE || 0}
                  </div>
                </div>
              </div>

              {/* ABSA CHARTS */}
              <div
                style={{
                  display: "flex",
                  gap: 20,
                  flexWrap: "wrap",
                }}
              >
                <div
                  style={{
                    flex: "1 1 320px",
                    minWidth: 0,
                  }}
                >
                  <h4 style={{ marginTop: 0 }}>
                    Aspect Sentiment
                  </h4>

                  {absaSummary.total_aspects > 0 ? (
                    <PieChart width={300} height={240}>
                      <Pie
                        data={absaSentimentData}
                        dataKey="value"
                        nameKey="name"
                        outerRadius={90}
                      >
                        {absaSentimentData.map((entry: any) => (
                          <Cell
                            key={entry.key}
                            fill={absaSentimentColor(entry.key)}
                          />
                        ))}
                      </Pie>
                      <Tooltip />
                    </PieChart>
                  ) : (
                    <p style={{ color: "#94a3b8", fontSize: 13 }}>
                      Chưa phát hiện aspect trong các comment đã phân tích.
                    </p>
                  )}
                </div>

                <div
                  style={{
                    flex: "1 1 420px",
                    minWidth: 0,
                  }}
                >
                  <h4 style={{ marginTop: 0 }}>
                    Top Aspects
                  </h4>

                  {aspectChartData.length > 0 ? (
                    <BarChart
                      width={430}
                      height={240}
                      data={aspectChartData}
                      margin={{
                        top: 5,
                        right: 12,
                        left: 0,
                        bottom: 45,
                      }}
                    >
                      <CartesianGrid strokeDasharray="3 3" />
                      <XAxis
                        dataKey="name"
                        interval={0}
                        angle={-25}
                        textAnchor="end"
                        tick={{ fontSize: 11 }}
                      />
                      <YAxis allowDecimals={false} />
                      <Tooltip />
                      <Bar dataKey="value" fill="#6366f1" />
                    </BarChart>
                  ) : (
                    <p style={{ color: "#94a3b8", fontSize: 13 }}>
                      Chưa có aspect để thống kê.
                    </p>
                  )}
                </div>
              </div>

              {/* TOP ASPECT DETAIL */}
              {topAspects.length > 0 && (
                <div style={{ marginTop: 18 }}>
                  <h4 style={{ marginBottom: 10 }}>
                    Chi tiết aspect nổi bật
                  </h4>

                  <div
                    style={{
                      display: "flex",
                      gap: 8,
                      flexWrap: "wrap",
                    }}
                  >
                    {topAspects.slice(0, 10).map((item: any) => (
                      <div
                        key={item.term}
                        style={{
                          border: "1px solid #e2e8f0",
                          borderRadius: 10,
                          padding: "8px 10px",
                          background: "#ffffff",
                          fontSize: 12,
                        }}
                      >
                        <b>{item.term}</b>
                        <span style={{ color: "#64748b" }}>
                          {" "}× {item.count}
                        </span>

                        <div
                          style={{
                            display: "flex",
                            gap: 6,
                            marginTop: 5,
                            flexWrap: "wrap",
                          }}
                        >
                          {(["POSITIVE", "NEUTRAL", "NEGATIVE"] as const).map(
                            (sentiment) => {
                              const count =
                                item.sentiments?.[sentiment] || 0;

                              if (!count) return null;

                              return (
                                <span
                                  key={sentiment}
                                  style={{
                                    color: absaSentimentColor(sentiment),
                                    fontWeight: 600,
                                  }}
                                >
                                  {sentiment}: {count}
                                </span>
                              );
                            }
                          )}
                        </div>
                      </div>
                    ))}
                  </div>
                </div>
              )}
            </div>
          )}

          {/* VIDEO + COMMENTS */}
          <div style={{ display: "flex", gap: 40, marginBottom: 20 }}>

            {/* VIDEO */}
            <div className="card" style={{ flex: 1 }}>
              <div
                style={{
                  display: "flex",
                  justifyContent: "space-between",
                  alignItems: "center",
                  marginBottom: 10,
                }}
              >
                <h3 style={{ margin: 0 }}>Video</h3>
                <a
                  href={data.video_url || url}
                  target="_blank"
                  rel="noreferrer"
                  style={{ color: "#2563eb", fontWeight: 600, fontSize: 13 }}
                >
                  Mở trên TikTok ↗
                </a>
              </div>

              {!videoFrameError ? (
                <video
                  key={data.video_id}
                  src={`${API_BASE_URL}/video/${data.video_id}?url=${encodeURIComponent(
                    data.video_url || url
                  )}`}
                  controls
                  preload="metadata"
                  playsInline
                  style={{
                    width: "100%",
                    height: 500,
                    borderRadius: 8,
                    background: "#000",
                    objectFit: "contain",
                  }}
                  onError={() => setVideoFrameError(true)}
                />
              ) : (
                <div
                  style={{
                    border: "1px solid #e5e7eb",
                    borderRadius: 8,
                    padding: 18,
                    color: "#475569",
                    lineHeight: 1.6,
                  }}
                >
                  <p>Không tải được video qua proxy backend.</p>
                  <a
                    href={data.video_url || url}
                    target="_blank"
                    rel="noreferrer"
                    style={{ color: "#2563eb", fontWeight: 600 }}
                  >
                    Mở video trên TikTok
                  </a>
                </div>
              )}

              <p style={{ marginTop: 8, fontSize: 12, color: "#94a3b8" }}>
                Video được phục vụ qua backend proxy để bypass lỗi 403 từ
                TikTok CDN. Lần phát đầu có thể chậm do server đang tải video.
              </p>
            </div>

            {/* COMMENTS SCROLL FIX */}
            <div
              className="card"
              style={{
                flex: 1,
                height: 600,          // 👈 FIX cứng bằng video
                overflowY: "auto",    // 👈 SCROLL DỌC
              }}
            >
              <h3>Comments</h3>

              {data.comments?.map((c: any, i: number) => {
                const labels: string[] =
                  Array.isArray(c.all_labels) && c.all_labels.length > 0
                    ? c.all_labels
                    : c.label
                      ? [c.label]
                      : [];

                const labelColor = (lb: string) => {
                  switch (lb) {
                    case "ENJOYMENT":
                      return "#4CAF50";
                    case "SURPRISE":
                      return "#19D3F3";
                    case "OTHER":
                      return "#FFC107";
                    case "ANGER":
                      return "#FF4B4B";
                    case "DISGUST":
                      return "#AB63FA";
                    case "SADNESS":
                      return "#636EFA";
                    case "FEAR":
                      return "#FFA15A";
                    default:
                      return "#9E9E9E";
                  }
                };

                return (
                  <div
                    key={i}
                    style={{
                      padding: 10,
                      borderBottom: "1px solid #eee",
                      display: "flex",
                      justifyContent: "space-between",
                      gap: 10,
                      alignItems: "flex-start",
                    }}
                  >
                    <div style={{ flex: 1, minWidth: 0 }}>
                      <div>{c.text}</div>

                      {Array.isArray(c.absa?.aspects) &&
                        c.absa.aspects.length > 0 && (
                          <div
                            style={{
                              display: "flex",
                              flexWrap: "wrap",
                              gap: 6,
                              marginTop: 8,
                            }}
                          >
                            {c.absa.aspects.map(
                              (aspect: any, aspectIndex: number) => (
                                <span
                                  key={`${aspect.term}-${aspectIndex}`}
                                  title={
                                    aspect.confidence !== undefined
                                      ? `ABSA confidence: ${Math.round(
                                          Number(aspect.confidence) * 100
                                        )}%`
                                      : undefined
                                  }
                                  style={{
                                    display: "inline-flex",
                                    alignItems: "center",
                                    gap: 5,
                                    padding: "3px 7px",
                                    borderRadius: 999,
                                    border: `1px solid ${absaSentimentColor(
                                      aspect.sentiment
                                    )}`,
                                    color: absaSentimentColor(
                                      aspect.sentiment
                                    ),
                                    background: "#ffffff",
                                    fontSize: 11,
                                    fontWeight: 600,
                                  }}
                                >
                                  <span>{aspect.term}</span>
                                  <span>·</span>
                                  <span>{aspect.sentiment}</span>
                                </span>
                              )
                            )}
                          </div>
                        )}
                    </div>

                    <div
                      style={{
                        display: "flex",
                        flexWrap: "wrap",
                        gap: 4,
                        justifyContent: "flex-end",
                        maxWidth: 220,
                      }}
                      title={
                        c.probabilities
                          ? Object.entries(c.probabilities)
                              .map(([k, v]) => `${k}: ${Number(v).toFixed(3)}`)
                              .join("\n")
                          : undefined
                      }
                    >
                      {labels.map((lb, idx) => (
                        <span
                          key={`${lb}-${idx}`}
                          style={{
                            padding: "4px 8px",
                            borderRadius: 6,
                            fontSize: 12,
                            color: "white",
                            background: labelColor(lb),
                            fontWeight: idx === 0 ? 600 : 400,
                            opacity: idx === 0 ? 1 : 0.85,
                          }}
                        >
                          {lb}
                          {c.probabilities && c.probabilities[lb] !== undefined
                            ? ` ${Math.round(c.probabilities[lb] * 100)}%`
                            : ""}
                        </span>
                      ))}
                    </div>
                  </div>
                );
              })}
            </div>
          </div>

          {/* INSIGHT */}
          <div className="card">
            <div
              style={{
                display: "flex",
                justifyContent: "space-between",
                alignItems: "center",
                marginBottom: 16,
              }}
            >
              <h3>Nhận định AI</h3>

              <div style={{ display: "flex", gap: 10 }}>
                <button className="btn" onClick={downloadCSV}>
                  Download CSV
                </button>
                <button className="btn" onClick={downloadJSON}>
                  Download JSON
                </button>
              </div>
            </div>

            <p
              style={{
                whiteSpace: "pre-line",
                lineHeight: 1.8,
                color: "#1f2937",
                fontSize: 15,
              }}
            >
              {data.insight}
            </p>
          </div>
        </>
      )}
    </div>
  );
}

// FILE: frontend\services\api.ts
// START ------------------------------
export const API_BASE_URL =
  process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_API_BASE_URL || "http://127.0.0.1:8000";

export async function analyzeVideo(url: string, modelId?: string) {
  const res = await fetch(`${API_BASE_URL}/analyze`, {
    method: "POST",
    headers: {
      "Content-Type": "application/json",
    },
    body: JSON.stringify({ url, model_id: modelId }),
  });

  return res.json();
}

export async function getModels() {
  const res = await fetch(`${API_BASE_URL}/models`);
  return res.json();
}

// FILE: tiktok_mfc_d3\tests\test_tooling.py

from pathlib import Path
import json
import tempfile
import unittest

from tools.contract_guard import normalize_system_response
from tools.phase14_adapter import import_phase14_response
from tools.validate import validate_dataset
from tools.qc import run_qc


class ToolingTests(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_failure_never_becomes_nei(self):
        payload = {
            "claims": [{
                "evidence": [],
                "verification": {
                    "verdict": "NEI",
                    "evidence_ids": [],
                    "rationale": "Không có bằng chứng truy xuất đủ để xác minh claim.",
                }
            }]
        }
        normalized = normalize_system_response(payload)
        v = normalized["claims"][0]["verification"]
        self.assertIsNone(v["verdict"])
        self.assertEqual(v["system_status"], "INSUFFICIENT_COLLECTION")
        self.assertEqual(v["raw_verdict"], "NEI")

    def test_adapter_and_schema(self):
        src_root = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]
        payload = json.loads((src_root / "examples" / "phase14_response_minimal.json").read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
        with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as tmp:
            dst = Path(tmp) / "dataset"
            import shutil
            shutil.copytree(src_root / "dataset", dst)
            result = import_phase14_response(payload, dst)
            self.assertEqual(len(result["imported_claim_ids"]), 1)
            self.assertTrue(result["contract_violations"])
            schema_result = validate_dataset(dst)
            self.assertTrue(schema_result["valid"], schema_result["errors"])
            qc_result = run_qc(dst)
            self.assertEqual(qc_result["summary"]["errors"], 0)
            self.assertEqual(qc_result["summary"]["warnings"], 1)


if __name__ == "__main__":
    unittest.main()

// END ------------------------------

// FILE: tiktok_mfc_d3\tools\common.py
// START ------------------------------
from __future__ import annotations

import json
from pathlib import Path
from typing import Any, Iterable


def read_json(path: Path) -> Any:
    with path.open("r", encoding="utf-8") as f:
        return json.load(f)


def write_json(path: Path, data: Any) -> None:
    path.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    with path.open("w", encoding="utf-8") as f:
        json.dump(data, f, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2)
        f.write("\n")


def append_jsonl(path: Path, record: dict[str, Any]) -> None:
    path.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    with path.open("a", encoding="utf-8") as f:
        f.write(json.dumps(record, ensure_ascii=False) + "\n")


def iter_jsonl(path: Path) -> Iterable[dict[str, Any]]:
    if not path.exists():
        return
    with path.open("r", encoding="utf-8") as f:
        for line_no, line in enumerate(f, start=1):
            line = line.strip()
            if not line:
                continue
            try:
                obj = json.loads(line)
            except json.JSONDecodeError as exc:
                raise ValueError(f"Invalid JSONL at {path}:{line_no}: {exc}") from exc
            if not isinstance(obj, dict):
                raise ValueError(f"Expected object at {path}:{line_no}")
            yield obj

// END ------------------------------

// FILE: tiktok_mfc_d3\tools\contract_guard.py
// START ------------------------------
from __future__ import annotations

from copy import deepcopy
from typing import Any

SEMANTIC_VERDICTS = {"SUPPORTED", "REFUTED", "NEI"}
FAILURE_MARKERS = (
    "no usable text or image evidence",
    "không có bằng chứng truy xuất đủ",
    "evidence retrieval returned no usable",
    "evidence retrieval không trả về",
    "timeout",
    "timed out",
    "unavailable",
    "api error",
    "failed",
)
NON_SUCCESS_STATUSES = {"FAILED", "UNAVAILABLE", "SKIPPED", "INSUFFICIENT_COLLECTION"}


def _contains_failure_marker(value: Any) -> bool:
    if value is None:
        return False
    if isinstance(value, str):
        s = value.casefold()
        return any(m.casefold() in s for m in FAILURE_MARKERS)
    if isinstance(value, list):
        return any(_contains_failure_marker(x) for x in value)
    if isinstance(value, dict):
        return any(_contains_failure_marker(v) for v in value.values())
    return False


def detect_verdict_contract_violation(claim_item: dict[str, Any]) -> list[str]:
    errors: list[str] = []
    evidence = claim_item.get("evidence") or []
    verification = claim_item.get("verification") or {}
    verdict = str(verification.get("verdict") or "").upper()
    status = str(verification.get("status") or verification.get("system_status") or "").upper()

    no_evidence = len(evidence) == 0 and len(verification.get("evidence_ids") or []) == 0
    if verdict == "NEI" and no_evidence and (_contains_failure_marker(verification) or status in NON_SUCCESS_STATUSES):
        errors.append(
            "SYSTEM_FAILURE_AS_NEI: backend returned NEI although evidence retrieval/verification failed or produced no usable evidence."
        )
    if verdict in SEMANTIC_VERDICTS and status in NON_SUCCESS_STATUSES:
        errors.append(
            f"NON_SUCCESS_WITH_VERDICT: verification status={status} must not emit semantic verdict={verdict}."
        )
    return errors


def normalize_system_response(response: dict[str, Any]) -> dict[str, Any]:
    """Protect dataset ingestion from technical failure being converted into a semantic verdict.

    It never changes Gold annotations because backend outputs are SYSTEM data only.
    """
    out = deepcopy(response)
    for item in out.get("claims") or []:
        violations = detect_verdict_contract_violation(item)
        if not violations:
            continue
        verification = item.setdefault("verification", {})
        verification["raw_verdict"] = verification.get("verdict")
        verification["verdict"] = None
        verification["system_status"] = verification.get("status") or "INSUFFICIENT_COLLECTION"
        verification["contract_violations"] = violations
        verification["confidence"] = 0
    return out

// END ------------------------------

// FILE: tiktok_mfc_d3\tools\duplicate_checker.py
// START ------------------------------
from __future__ import annotations

from difflib import SequenceMatcher
from pathlib import Path
from typing import Iterable

from .hash_utils import sha256_file


def exact_video_duplicate(candidate: Path, known_hashes: Iterable[str]) -> tuple[bool, str]:
    digest = sha256_file(candidate)
    return digest in set(known_hashes), digest


def text_near_duplicate(a: str, b: str, threshold: float = 0.92) -> tuple[bool, float]:
    score = SequenceMatcher(None, a.casefold().strip(), b.casefold().strip()).ratio()
    return score >= threshold, score


def average_hash(image_path: Path, hash_size: int = 8) -> str:
    """Simple perceptual hash for near-duplicate keyframes."""
    from PIL import Image

    with Image.open(image_path) as img:
        img = img.convert("L").resize((hash_size, hash_size))
        pixels = list(img.getdata())
    avg = sum(pixels) / len(pixels)
    bits = "".join("1" if p >= avg else "0" for p in pixels)
    return f"{int(bits, 2):0{hash_size * hash_size // 4}x}"


def hamming_hex(a: str, b: str) -> int:
    if len(a) != len(b):
        raise ValueError("Hashes must have equal length")
    return (int(a, 16) ^ int(b, 16)).bit_count()

// END ------------------------------

// FILE: tiktok_mfc_d3\tools\hash_utils.py
// START ------------------------------
from __future__ import annotations

import hashlib
from pathlib import Path


def sha256_file(path: Path, chunk_size: int = 1024 * 1024) -> str:
    h = hashlib.sha256()
    with path.open("rb") as f:
        while True:
            chunk = f.read(chunk_size)
            if not chunk:
                break
            h.update(chunk)
    return h.hexdigest()


def sha256_text(text: str) -> str:
    return hashlib.sha256(text.encode("utf-8")).hexdigest()

// END ------------------------------

// FILE: tiktok_mfc_d3\tools\id_generator.py
// START ------------------------------
from __future__ import annotations

from pathlib import Path
from .common import read_json, write_json


class IdGenerator:
    def __init__(self, state_file: Path):
        self.state_file = state_file
        self.state = read_json(state_file)

    def _next(self, key: str) -> int:
        if key not in self.state:
            raise KeyError(f"Unknown ID namespace: {key}")
        self.state[key] += 1
        write_json(self.state_file, self.state)
        return self.state[key]

    def video_id(self) -> str:
        return f"TK_{self._next('TK'):06d}"

    def frame_id(self, video_id: str, index: int) -> str:
        return f"FR_{video_id.removeprefix('TK_')}_{index:03d}"

    def transcript_span_id(self, video_id: str, index: int) -> str:
        return f"TS_{video_id.removeprefix('TK_')}_{index:03d}"

    def claim_id(self, video_id: str, index: int) -> str:
        return f"CL_{video_id.removeprefix('TK_')}_{index:02d}"

    def document_id(self) -> str:
        return f"DOC_{self._next('DOC'):06d}"

    def evidence_id(self, evidence_type: str) -> str:
        evidence_type = evidence_type.upper()
        if evidence_type == "TEXT":
            return f"EV_TXT_{self._next('EV_TXT'):06d}"
        if evidence_type == "IMAGE":
            return f"EV_IMG_{self._next('EV_IMG'):06d}"
        raise ValueError("Only TEXT/IMAGE evidence is supported in v1 tooling")

    def verification_id(self, video_id: str, claim_index: int) -> str:
        return f"VR_{video_id.removeprefix('TK_')}_{claim_index:02d}"

    def explanation_id(self, video_id: str, claim_index: int) -> str:
        return f"EX_{video_id.removeprefix('TK_')}_{claim_index:02d}"

    def annotation_id(self) -> str:
        return f"AN_{self._next('AN'):06d}"

// END ------------------------------

// FILE: tiktok_mfc_d3\tools\ingest_phase14_response.py
// START ------------------------------
from __future__ import annotations

import argparse
import json
from pathlib import Path

from .manifest import refresh_manifest
from .phase14_adapter import import_phase14_response
from .qc import run_qc


def main() -> None:
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description="Import current Phase 1-4 backend JSON into TikTok-MFC candidate records.")
    parser.add_argument("response_json", type=Path)
    parser.add_argument("--dataset-root", type=Path, default=Path("dataset"))
    args = parser.parse_args()

    with args.response_json.open("r", encoding="utf-8") as f:
        response = json.load(f)

    result = import_phase14_response(response, args.dataset_root)
    manifest = refresh_manifest(args.dataset_root)
    qc = run_qc(args.dataset_root)

    print(json.dumps({"import": result, "manifest": manifest, "qc": qc}, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2))


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

// END ------------------------------

from __future__ import annotations

from pathlib import Path
from .common import iter_jsonl, read_json, write_json


def refresh_manifest(dataset_root: Path) -> dict:
    manifest_path = dataset_root / "manifest.json"
    manifest = read_json(manifest_path)

    videos = list(iter_jsonl(dataset_root / "records" / "videos.jsonl"))
    claims = list(iter_jsonl(dataset_root / "records" / "claims.jsonl"))
    evidence = list(iter_jsonl(dataset_root / "records" / "evidence.jsonl"))
    verifications = list(iter_jsonl(dataset_root / "records" / "verifications.jsonl"))

    gold_claim_ids = {
        v.get("claim_id") for v in verifications
        if v.get("gold_verdict") in {"SUPPORTED", "REFUTED", "NEI"}
    }
    manifest["statistics"] = {
        "videos": len(videos),
        "claims": len(claims),
        "gold_claims": len(gold_claim_ids),
        "text_evidence": sum(1 for e in evidence if e.get("type") == "text"),
        "image_evidence": sum(1 for e in evidence if e.get("type") == "image"),
    }
    write_json(manifest_path, manifest)
    return manifest

// END ------------------------------

// FILE: tiktok_mfc_d3\tools\phase14_adapter.py
